Springs, lake edges and snow patches determined winter camps, and tracks followed the gaps between dunes and ridges. Biger therefore belongs to a fragile chain of lakes and dry plains where movement, not permanent cultivation, allowed communities to live across a difficult part of the Gobi.
simp_chinese:
比格尔位于蒙古西南部杭爱山与戈壁阿尔泰山之间的湖泊谷地，这是一条狭长洼地。谷底以沙砾平原为主，盐碱土和龟裂地同干草原交替出现。海拔约一千至一千四百米，冬季严酷、降雨有限。牧民必须长距离迁徙，才能抵达水源和季节牧场。

发源于杭爱山的河流补给博翁查干湖、奥罗格湖等一串浅湖。湖水随季节和年份大幅变化，有些湖泊会完全干涸。夏季水面退缩后，盐沼沿岸扩展，谷地边缘则出现新月形沙丘。鱼类、鸭类与岸鸟聚集在仍保有明水和湿地之处。

牧民家庭赶着绵羊、山羊、牛、马和骆驼，在荒漠边缘与山地补给水源的较湿牧场之间迁徙。泉眼、湖岸和残雪决定冬季营地，道路沿沙丘与山脊之间的空隙延伸。比格尔因而属于湖泊与旱原组成的脆弱地带；流动性而非永久耕作，使社群能够在戈壁的艰难部分生活。水源因此决定营地。

english: Bigge Island lies off the northern Kimberley coast, between York Sound and Montague Sound. Its sandstone shores form part of Wunambal country, and rock shelters on the island contain paintings including Wandjina figures. Across the surrounding channels, large tides wash a rugged coast of islands and inlets.
simp_chinese: 比格岛位于金伯利北岸外，处在约克湾和蒙塔古湾之间。岛上的砂岩海岸属于乌南巴尔人的土地，岩棚中保存着包括万吉纳形象在内的绘画。周围水道潮差巨大，潮水冲刷着岛屿和海湾交错的崎岖海岸。

english: The Bighorn Mountains rise between the Bighorn Basin and the Powder River country. Their high ridges and forested slopes send streams toward the Yellowstone drainage, including the Tongue and Little Bighorn rivers. The Apsaalooke name for the range refers to bighorn sheep, animals deeply associated with its rugged cliffs and mountains. The range forms a prominent eastern outlier of the Rocky Mountains.
simp_chinese: 比格霍恩山脉耸立于比格霍恩盆地与保德河地区之间。高耸的山脊和森林覆盖的山坡孕育出流向黄石河流域的溪流，包括通河与小比格霍恩河。阿普萨卢克人对山脉的称呼与大角羊有关，这种动物同此地崎岖的峭壁与山峦关系深厚。山脉是落基山系东侧醒目的支脉。

english: At the head of the Gulf of Siam, a shallow bight receives the waters of the Chao Phraya, Tha Chin, Mae Klong and Bang Pakong rivers. The rivers spread sediment across a low coast of mudflats and estuaries, where tides push inland against their flow. The Chao Phraya provided access from the sea to the rich central plain and the royal city of Ayutthaya, making these waters the maritime approach to the heart of Siam.
simp_chinese: 暹罗湾北端的浅湾汇集湄南河、他钦河、湄功河和邦巴功河的河水。河流在低平的海岸沉积泥沙，形成广阔的泥滩和河口；潮水则逆着河流，沿水道向内陆推进。湄南河由海上通往富饶的中央平原和王城阿瑜陀耶，因此这片水域也是从海上进入暹罗腹心的重要通道。

english:
Beside the Katonga River, Bigo bya Mugenyi is marked by an extraordinary system of earthen banks and ditches. The outer trenches curve around a ridge to meet the river, enclosing a group of smaller, interconnected enclosures. The outer ditches are broken by numerous openings, while four inner enclosures open into one another. The scale of the works speaks of a community able to organise considerable labour in the Great Lakes country.

The earthworks date broadly to the fourteenth to sixteenth centuries. Oral traditions connect Bigo with the Bachwezi and their rulers Ndahura and Wamala, who also feature in stories of long-horned cattle. The ditches served several purposes, including protection and the display of authority, and the enclosures gave the community a place for gathering, herding and ritual.
simp_chinese:
卡通加河畔的比戈比亚穆根尼，留有一组规模非凡的土垒与壕沟。外侧壕沟环绕山脊，与河岸相接，并围出一组相互连通的小围场；外侧壕沟上有许多缺口，四个内部围场彼此相通。这些工程的规模，显示大湖地区一个能够组织大量劳力的社群。

这些土工建筑大致建于十四至十六世纪。口述传统将比戈与巴奇韦齐人及其统治者恩达胡拉、瓦马拉联系起来，他们也出现在长角牛的传说中。壕沟兼具防护与展示权威的功能，围场则是聚集、放牧和举行仪式的场所。

english: Bih, also known as Geh, lies in the hills of western Makran, inland from the coast. The Geh River waters an oasis amid the dry surrounding country, where date palms and cultivated ground mark the course of the valley. A fort stood above the cultivated land and served as the seat of the local chief. The river and its tributaries join the drainage that crosses the Makran ranges towards the sea, giving this inland settlement a place in the geography of both the mountains and the coast.
simp_chinese: 比赫又称盖赫，位于西马克兰的内陆山地。盖赫河在干旱群山之间浇灌一片绿洲，椰枣树与耕地沿山谷分布。耕地上方的堡垒曾是当地首领的驻地。河流及其支流汇入穿越马克兰山脉流向海洋的水系，使这处内陆聚落同时与山地和海岸相连。

sources.title: 1937 Archaeological Reconnaissances in North-Western India and South-Eastern Iran by Stein s.pdf

english:
Bihać stands on the Una in the northwestern Bosnian borderlands. A royal charter of 1260 records the town on Saint Ladislaus's island, then a possession of the abbey of Topusko. Two years later King Béla IV granted it the privileges of a free royal town. Water and a deep ditch protected its walls, while its position made it an important stronghold of the Una valley.

Bihać resisted Ottoman attacks for more than a century before Hasan Pasha's army captured it in 1592. The church of Saint Anthony was converted into the Fethija Mosque for the new garrison; its old tower served the call to prayer before a minaret was built. Bihać became the seat of an Ottoman captaincy and judicial district, and in 1616 the centre of a sanjak. Its walls continued to face sieges during the wars that followed.
simp_chinese:
比哈奇坐落在波斯尼亚西北边境的乌纳河畔。1260年的王室文书记载，这座城镇位于圣拉迪斯劳斯岛上，当时属于托普斯科修道院。两年后，国王贝拉四世授予它自由王城的特权。河水与深壕保护着城墙，它也成为乌纳河谷的重要要塞。

比哈奇抵御奥斯曼人的进攻超过一个世纪，直到1592年被哈桑帕夏的军队攻占。圣安东尼教堂被改为费提希耶清真寺，供新驻军使用；建造宣礼塔以前，旧塔楼用于召唤礼拜。比哈奇成为奥斯曼军区和法官治所，1616年又成为桑贾克的中心。在此后的战争中，城墙继续承受围攻。

english:
Bihar was an early administrative county of the Kingdom of Hungary, centered first on the earthwork castle at present-day Biharia and later on Nagyvárad, later Oradea. Its land crossed the upper Körös rivers, joining the Pannonian Plain to the mountain valleys of Transylvania. Wet meadows and oak woods covered the lowland, while the eastern valleys opened routes through the Apuseni Mountains.

The fortress at Bihar was the center of Menumorut’s duchy when Hungarian forces entered the Carpathian Basin in the 890s. Earth ramparts enclosed a rectangular stronghold near the Berettyó, and the site became the first seat of the county founded in the eleventh century. The bishop’s residence later moved to Várad, where the shrine of Saint Ladislaus drew pilgrims and royal gifts.

Slavic place names, Hungarian tribal names and warrior graves show that several communities occupied the river corridors. Pecheneg and Ouz raids in 1068 tested the county’s defenses, and local troops later served in royal conflicts. Fortified churches, market villages and river crossings knit the plain and mountains together. Bihar’s identity rested on control of those routes and on the ecclesiastical authority radiating from Várad.
simp_chinese:
比哈尔是匈牙利王国早期的一个行政县，最初以后世比哈里亚的土垒城堡为中心，后来转向纳吉瓦拉德，即奥拉迪亚。县域横跨克勒什河上游诸支流，把潘诺尼亚平原同特兰西瓦尼亚山谷连接起来。低地覆盖湿草甸与橡树林，东部谷地则向阿普塞尼山地打开通道。

八九〇年代匈牙利人进入喀尔巴阡盆地时，比哈尔堡垒是梅努莫鲁特公国的中心。贝雷蒂奥河附近的长方形土垒围住城堡，并在十一世纪成为新设县的第一个治所。主教驻地后来移至瓦拉德，圣拉斯洛圣髑吸引朝圣者与王室赠礼，使当地宗教地位上升。

斯拉夫地名、匈牙利部族名和武士墓说明多条河谷由不同社群共同占据。一〇六八年佩切涅格人与乌兹人的袭扰考验县域防御，地方军队后来也参加王室战争。设防教堂、集市村庄与河流渡口把平原和山地联系起来。比哈尔的身份来自对这些通道的控制，也来自从瓦拉德向外辐射的教会权威。

english:
Bihar Sharif is an old town of Magadha, known for the tomb of the Sufi teacher Sharafuddin Yahya Maneri. His shrine stands beside the Panchana River and has long drawn visitors to a place revered for learning and devotion. The town’s mosques and tombs preserve the religious and political history of medieval Bihar.

Sharafuddin settled at Bihar after years spent in retreat and became a celebrated spiritual guide. He died in 1380, leaving letters and teachings that circulated among his followers. His tomb incorporates carved stone and pillars from older buildings. In the fifteenth century Bihar also came under the Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur; inscriptions from the town record buildings commissioned during their reigns. These monuments testify to the succession of patrons who shaped its sacred landscape.
simp_chinese:
比哈尔谢里夫是摩揭陀的古城，以苏菲导师沙拉夫丁·叶海亚·马内里的陵墓闻名。圣祠位于潘查纳河畔，长期吸引访客前来，这里因学术与虔修受到尊崇。城镇的清真寺和陵墓保存着中世纪比哈尔的宗教与政治历史。

沙拉夫丁在多年隐修后定居比哈尔，成为著名精神导师。他于1380年去世，留下在追随者之间流传的书信与教导。陵墓使用了旧建筑的雕刻石材和柱子。十五世纪，比哈尔也处于焦恩布尔沙尔基统治者之下，城中铭文记录了他们在位时兴建的建筑。这些纪念物见证历代赞助者如何塑造当地宗教景观。

english: Bihariganj lies in the Kosi plain of northeastern Bihar, amid the villages and cultivated land of Mithila. The river has shifted its course repeatedly across this low country, leaving old channels and altering the land around settlements. Local accounts remember Bihariganj by the earlier name Nishankhpur Kodha and describe a channel called Ha-ha Dhar near the settlement. The neighbouring Gamail Gola market served the exchange of produce from the surrounding villages.
simp_chinese: 比哈里根杰位于比哈尔东北部的戈西河平原，周围是弥萨罗地区的村庄与农田。戈西河在这片低地上屡次改道，留下旧河道，也改变了聚落周围的土地。地方记载称比哈里根杰旧名尼尚克普尔科达，并提到聚落附近名为哈哈达尔的河道。附近的加迈尔戈拉集市供周围村庄交换农产。

english: Bii-Khem, the “great river” in Tuvan, rises in the mountain country of eastern Tuva. Flowing from Lake Kara-Balik through the broad Todzha basin, it gathers tributaries including the Toora-Khem, Khamsara and Systyg-Khem. Its course continues west to meet the Little Yenisei, forming the Upper Yenisei. Forests, lakes and volcanic highlands surround the upper river and its many streams.
simp_chinese: 比河在图瓦语中称比—赫姆，意为“大河”，发源于图瓦东部山地。河水从卡拉巴雷克湖流出，穿过宽广的托贾盆地，接纳托拉赫姆、哈姆萨拉和瑟斯特格赫姆等支流，向西与小叶尼塞河汇合，形成上叶尼塞河。上游河流和众多溪流周围是森林、湖泊与火山高地。

english: Bijagarh belongs to Nimar, the country south of the Vindhya Range that includes parts of the Narmada and Tapti valleys. Historical accounts name Bija Gawli, also called Bija Singh Ahir, as a ruler in Nimar during the fourteenth century. In the following century Gawli or Ahir chiefs established small centres in southern Nimar, including the fort of Bijagarh. The Ain-i-Akbari also records Khargao as a mahal associated with Bijagarh.
simp_chinese: 比贾加尔属于温迪亚山脉以南的尼马尔地区，其中包括纳尔默达河与塔普蒂河谷的一部分。历史记载称，比贾·高利，也就是比贾·辛格·阿希尔，曾于十四世纪统治尼马尔。下个世纪，高利或阿希尔首领在南尼马尔建立若干小中心，比贾加尔堡便是其中之一。《阿克巴纪》还记载了与比贾加尔有关的哈尔高马哈尔。

english:
Bijapur was the capital of the Adil Shahi sultans, a city of mosques, gardens, palaces and enormous tombs on the open plateau of the northern Deccan. Its skyline is dominated by the Gol Gumbaz, the mausoleum of Muhammad Adil Shah, whose dome is among the largest in the world, and by the finely carved Ibrahim Rauza. Walls and a moat enclosed the city, and conduits and tanks brought water to its gardens.

The Bahmani sultans took the area in 1347 and made Bijapur a provincial capital. As Bahmani rule broke up, Yusuf Adil Shah founded an independent sultanate here around 1490. The Adil Shahis fought Vijayanagara, but in 1565 Ali Adil Shah joined the other Deccan sultans in the victory at Talikota that destroyed the Hindu empire. He raised the Jami Masjid and new walls with the wealth that followed. Ibrahim Adil Shah II, who ruled from 1580 to 1627, was a poet and musician who wrote on the nine rasas, drew Persian and Deccani artists to his court, and was buried in the Ibrahim Rauza. His successor Muhammad began the Gol Gumbaz.

Bijapur's rulers also fought the rising Marathas, and in 1659 the general Afzal Khan was killed by Shivaji at Pratapgad. The Mughals pressed from the north, and in 1686 Aurangzeb took the city after a long siege, ending the dynasty. Disease and war thinned the population. The Nizam held the area briefly, and from 1760 it passed to the Marathas.
simp_chinese:
比贾布尔是阿迪勒沙希素丹的都城，在德干北部开阔的高原上，满是清真寺、花园、宫殿和巨大的陵墓。城市天际线由戈尔·贡巴兹主宰，这是穆罕默德·阿迪勒沙的陵墓，穹顶是世界上最大的之一，旁边还有雕饰精美的伊布拉欣·拉乌扎。城墙与护城河环绕全城，水渠和蓄水池把水送到花园里。

巴赫曼尼素丹国在1347年取得该地，使比贾布尔成为一个省会。巴赫曼尼统治瓦解后，优素福·阿迪勒沙约在1490年于此建立独立素丹国。阿迪勒沙希诸王同毗奢耶那伽罗作战，1565年阿里·阿迪勒沙联合其他德干素丹，在塔利科塔取得了摧毁这个印度教帝国的胜利。他用随之而来的财富建起大清真寺和新城墙。1580至1627年在位的伊布拉欣·阿迪勒沙二世是诗人和乐师，写过论九种情味的著作，吸引波斯和德干的艺术家来到宫廷，死后葬于伊布拉欣·拉乌扎。继位的穆罕默德开始修建戈尔·贡巴兹。

比贾布尔的统治者也同崛起的马拉塔人作战，1659年将领阿夫扎尔汗在普拉塔加德被西瓦吉杀死。莫卧儿从北面步步紧逼，1686年奥朗则布经长期围攻攻占此城，终结了这个王朝。疾病与战争使人口骤减。尼扎姆曾短暂占有该地，1760年起它归于马拉塔人。

english:
Bijar lies high in the rugged country of Garrus, on the old road between Hamadan and Tabriz. The district's mountains rise above the valleys of the Sefidrud and Talvar, and severe winters shape a landscape of grain fields and sheep pastures. To the northeast stands the ancient mountain fortress of Qamcheqay, whose commanding position was used through several historical periods.

Bijar was recorded as a village associated with the property of Shah Ismail, the first Safavid ruler. Only in the nineteenth century did it grow into a town. Garrus became known for its carpets, woven in Bijar and many villages around it, where household looms complemented farming and animal husbandry. The sturdy textiles brought the name of this highland district to markets far beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese:
比贾尔坐落在加鲁斯崎岖的高地上，位于哈马丹与大不里士之间的古道。当地群山高出塞菲德鲁德河与塔尔瓦尔河谷，严寒冬季塑造了谷物田地与绵羊牧场交错的景观。东北方耸立着古老的卡姆切盖山堡，这处险要位置在多个历史时期都曾得到利用。

记载称比贾尔曾是与萨法维首任统治者沙阿伊斯玛仪的产业有关的村庄，直到十九世纪才发展为城镇。加鲁斯以地毯闻名，比贾尔和周围许多村庄都设有家庭织机，编织业补充农业与畜牧业。结实的织物使这片高地的名字传到了远方市场。

english:
Bijni lies in the Chirang district of Assam, among the Eastern Duars that open from the Brahmaputra lowlands toward the Himalayan foothills. Its position at roughly fifty metres above sea level places it in a wet, low-lying corridor crossed by the Dolani River and flanked by tributaries of the Manas. This corridor links the plain with the rising country to the north.

From the early seventeenth century, Bijni formed part of the Kingdom of Bhutan. Bhutanese rulers divided the local administration among Bijni, Banska and Chapagur, treating these foothill territories as gateways rather than as remote appendages. That history explains why a settlement beside the Brahmaputra lowlands can be understood through both Assamese plains networks and mountain government, and why the town long served as a passage between ecological and cultural zones.
simp_chinese:
比杰尼位于阿萨姆奇朗县，处在通往喜马拉雅山麓的东部杜阿尔门户地带。城镇海拔约五十米，坐落在湿润低地中，多拉尼河从附近经过，马纳斯河的支流从两侧环抱。这条走廊把布拉马普特拉平原同北面逐渐升高的山地连接起来。

十七世纪初，比杰尼成为不丹王国的一部分。不丹统治者把地方行政分为比杰尼、班斯卡和恰帕古尔，将这些山麓领地视为通达平原的门户。正因如此，这处位于布拉马普特拉低地边缘的聚落，既可通过阿萨姆平原网络理解，也同山地政权的治理相连，并长期承担不同生态与文化区域之间的通道作用。

english: Bijnot, also called Winjhrot, was a fort in the Cholistan desert. It formed part of a chain of strongholds spread across the arid country around the old course of the Hakra River, alongside forts such as Derawar and Islamgarh. Local traditions attributed its foundation to Raja Wanjho or Bija Bhati, while another named Tunno, an ancestor of the founder of Derawar. The same traditions recalled its destruction by Shahab al-Din Ghori in the twelfth century.
simp_chinese: 比杰诺特又称温杰罗特，是焦利斯坦沙漠中的一座堡垒。它与德拉瓦尔、伊斯兰加尔等堡垒一道，构成散布在哈克拉河旧河道附近干旱地带的防御网络。当地传说将其创建归于拉贾万杰或比贾·巴蒂；另一种传说则称建造者是德拉瓦尔创建者的祖先通诺。传说还记载，十二世纪沙哈布丁·古里摧毁了此堡。

sources.title: The Imperial Gazetteer of India Volume VIII.pdf

english: Bikar is a remote coral atoll in the northern Ratak chain, its low islets enclosing a lagoon. It lies beyond the more densely inhabited atolls farther south, in a maritime landscape known to Marshallese navigators. People from other northern atolls visited Bikar to gather birds, eggs and turtles, under the authority of the high chief of the Ratak chain.
simp_chinese: 比卡尔是拉塔克岛链北部偏远的珊瑚环礁，低矮小岛环绕潟湖。它位于南方居民较多的环礁之外，处在马绍尔航海者熟悉的海洋景观中。北方其他环礁的居民造访比卡尔，采集海鸟、鸟蛋和海龟，这些活动受拉塔克岛链最高首领的管理。

english: Bikar's six low islets enclose a shallow lagoon in the northern Ratak chain. The reef is almost continuous, with a narrow opening on the western side. Traditionally the atoll belonged to the paramount chief of Ratak; islanders from elsewhere visited to gather seabirds, eggs and turtles under customary rules. Otto von Kotzebue's brig Rurik called here in 1817.
simp_chinese: 比卡尔的六座低矮小岛在拉塔克群岛北部围成一片浅潟湖。礁缘几乎连续，只有西侧有一处狭窄缺口。环礁传统上属于拉塔克最高酋长，其他岛民依照习俗来此采集海鸟、鸟卵和海龟。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布的双桅船“留里克”号到访此地。

english:
Bikini Atoll occupies a remote coral platform at the northern end of the Ralik Chain. Twenty-three islets enclose a lagoon of 229.4 square miles, while the largest, Bikini Island, reaches only about seven feet above low tide. Rainwater, shallow wells and salt-tolerant plants made this low ground habitable. The Marshallese name Pikinni means “surface of coconuts,” a description of land made from sand, limestone and groves rather than dense soil.

Before colonial contact, Bikini’s families grew coconut, pandanus, breadfruit, taro, arrowroot and bananas, and raised pigs and chickens. They fished with shell hooks and coconut-fibre lines, using more than twenty-five techniques, and sailed two-hulled proas between the islets and neighbouring atolls. Clans held land through maternal descent; chiefs regulated tenure and resource use, while clan heads supervised daily work.

The lagoon provided sheltered water and an unusually broad horizon within a narrow ring of land. Knowledge of winds, reefs and currents made those passages possible and tied Bikini to the wider Marshallese world. In 1946 the United States removed 167 residents for nuclear testing, after which repeated displacement severed the community from regular life on the atoll.
simp_chinese:
比基尼环礁位于拉利克岛链北端，是远离主要岛屿的珊瑚礁体。二十三座小岛围出约五百九十四平方公里的潟湖，其中最大的比基尼岛仅高出低潮线约两米。雨水、浅井和耐盐植物使这片低地能够维持生活。马绍尔语名称“皮金尼”意为椰树之地，点明了这里由沙、石灰岩和椰林构成的低矮土地。

在欧洲接触以前，岛上家庭种植椰子、露兜树、面包果、芋头、竹芋和香蕉，也饲养猪与鸡。居民用贝壳鱼钩和椰纤维渔线，以二十多种方法捕鱼，并驾驶双体帆船往返各小岛和邻近环礁。氏族沿母系传承土地，首领掌握土地使用并处理纠纷，氏族头人负责日常，各岛周围的海域也是生活的一部分。

宽阔潟湖在狭小陆环内提供避风水域，风向、礁脉与洋流的知识使航行成为可能，也把比基尼同马绍尔群岛的其他社会联结起来。1946年，美国为核试验迁走167名居民；此后多次迁移割断了社群与环礁的日常联系。

english: The waters near Bikini Coast lie within the Ralik Chain, the western island group of the Marshall Islands. Ralik means “sunset,” a name that pairs the chain with Ratak, or sunrise, on the eastern side of the country. Its islands extend across a broad expanse of ocean, with Bikini near the northern end and many other atolls scattered southward. Although Ratak and Ralik occupy different halves of the archipelago, their Marshallese dialects remain mutually intelligible and differ mainly in vocabulary and regular sound changes. Travel and kinship have long connected their communities across horizons broken by small islands. Along the Bikini coast, the main marks on movement are reef edges, passes and navigational knowledge rather than a continuous shoreline. The two chain names turn direction into geography: sunset in the west, sunrise in the east. Marshallese land tenure links families to clans and to particular islets, even when communities are displaced. Bikini’s twenty-three islands make ownership far more detailed than a single outline of the lagoon can show. The chain’s name therefore records an orientation that islanders experience every day. Canoe pilots used swells and reef colours to find the passes.
simp_chinese: 比基尼海岸附近的水域属于马绍尔群岛西部的拉利克岛链。拉利克意为“日落”，同东侧的拉塔克，即“日出”，互为东西两半的名称。岛链跨越广阔海域，比基尼位于其北端，其他许多环礁则向南方散布。尽管拉塔克与拉利克分处群岛两侧，两地的马绍尔方言仍能互通，差别主要在词汇和部分有规律的字音变化。航行与亲属关系长期把隔着遥远海面的社区连接起来。在比基尼海岸一带，决定通行的主要是礁缘、水道和航海知识，而非连续海岸。两道岛链之名把太阳起落转化为地理方向：西为日落，东为日出。马绍尔土地制度把家庭、氏族和具体小岛相连，即使社群被迫迁离，这些权利仍然存在。比基尼的二十三座小岛说明，实际土地关系远比潟湖的一圈轮廓复杂。岛链名称记录了居民每日经历的方向感。

english:
Bikinka belongs to the Ussuri basin, a long river system that rises in the Sikhote-Alin mountains of Northeast Asia. The Ussuri flows about 897 kilometres northward and joins the Amur near Khabarovsk. For most of that course it forms a boundary between Russian territory and northeastern China. Rain supplies roughly sixty percent of the river’s water, while melting snow contributes thirty to thirty-five percent and springs make up the remainder.

This mixture produces a powerful seasonal pulse and a reputation for severe floods. Ice covers the river from November until April, temporarily interrupting navigation. Beneath the water live grayling, sturgeon, chum salmon, humpback salmon and many other fish. The river’s basin covers 193,000 square kilometres and receives several large tributaries, including the Bikin.

Bikinka’s place in this drainage connects it to forested mountains, floodplains and a major northward passage toward the Amur. The river also supports migrations of salmon and offers habitat for the Ussuri brown bear and Ussurian tiger in its wider catchment. Winter ice and spring melt strongly affect routes on both banks. Ice and flood cycles rule its seasonal rhythm.
simp_chinese:
比金卡属于乌苏里江流域。这条大河发源于东北亚锡霍特山脉，向北流约八百九十七公里，在哈巴罗夫斯克附近汇入黑龙江。其大部分河段构成俄罗斯与中国东北之间的边界，雨水约占乌苏里江来水的六成，融雪占三成至三成五，其余来自地下水。

多种补给造成强烈的季节变化，也使河流以严重洪水闻名。每年十一月河面封冻，直到四月仍处于冰层之下，航运因此中断。水中生活着茴鱼、鲟鱼、大马哈鱼、驼背大马哈鱼等鱼类。乌苏里江流域面积约十九万三千平方公里，比金河等大支流汇入其中。

比金卡所在的水系由此连通森林山地、洪泛平原和向北通往黑龙江的通道。河流还支持鲑鱼洄游，其较大流域为乌苏里棕熊和东北虎提供生境。冬季冰封与春季融水强烈影响两岸的往来道路。封冻与洪水周期支配着河流的季节节奏。

english: Bikoro lies near the lower Kwilu, west of its meeting with the Kwango and Kasai. The Kwilu winds north from the Angolan highlands past Kikwit and Bulungu; near its mouth its sandy channel becomes remarkably broad. Across the Kasai, the Fimi brings water from Lake Mai-Ndombe towards the same great river system.
simp_chinese: 比科罗位于奎卢河下游附近，在它与宽果河、开赛河汇合处以西。奎卢河从安哥拉高地向北蜿蜒，流经基奎特和布隆古；临近河口时，沙质河道变得十分宽阔。开赛河对岸，菲米河将马伊恩东贝湖的水带入同一大水系。

english:
Bikrampur was an ancient centre of power and learning in eastern Bengal, set amid the waterways south of the Brahmaputra. It served the Chandra and Sena rulers, and is associated with the Buddhist teacher Atisha. Rivers and low-lying land linked its settlements with the wider delta, where changing channels could alter the position of towns and estates.

Under the Mughals, Bikrampur formed a pargana of the Sonargaon sarkar. Its landholders Chand Rai and Kedar Rai belonged to the powerful chiefs who contested imperial expansion in eastern Bengal. In the early seventeenth century the Mughal governor Man Singh campaigned against Kedar Rai, who was killed during the struggle. The incorporation of Bikrampur brought an old political centre into the expanding administrative order of Mughal Bengal.
simp_chinese:
比克拉姆布尔是孟加拉东部古老的权力与学术中心，位于布拉马普特拉河以南的水道之间。钱德拉和西纳统治者曾以此为中心，这里也与佛教导师阿底峡相联系。河流和低地把各聚落同更广阔的三角洲相连，变化的水道则可能改变城镇与领地的位置。

莫卧儿时代，比克拉姆布尔是索纳尔冈萨尔卡尔下的一个帕尔加纳。当地领主钱德·拉伊与凯达尔·拉伊属于抵抗帝国向东孟加拉扩张的强大首领。十七世纪初，莫卧儿总督曼·辛格征讨凯达尔·拉伊，后者在斗争中身亡。比克拉姆布尔被纳入莫卧儿孟加拉不断扩大的行政体系，古老的政治中心由此进入新的秩序。

english:
Bila belongs to the Nuomin country within the broad historical region called Manchuria in Northeast Asia. The term covers China’s three northeastern provinces and, in wider usage, parts of the Russian Far East as far as the Amur basin. Its northern limits are mountain country, while the lowlands and river valleys offer routes between forest, steppe and coast. Many peoples have lived in this region, including Manchus, Mongols, Koreans, Nanai, Nivkhs, Ulchs and their Jurchen predecessors.

Early communities combined hunting, fishing, livestock raising and agriculture, adapting differently to dense woodland and open plains. The Jurchens formed the Jin dynasty in 1115, and their descendants became the Manchus who founded the Later Jin in 1616 and then the Qing. Bila therefore sits within a layered frontier of old routes, varied livelihoods and changing state power.

The term itself is an exonym of Japanese origin and became associated with later imperial projects. The land’s older identities are better traced through its many peoples, watersheds and routes than through a single fixed boundary.
simp_chinese:
必喇属于东北亚广义历史区域满洲境内的诺敏地区。这一区域通常包括中国东北三省，较宽泛的用法还涉及俄罗斯远东直到黑龙江流域的部分地方。北面以山地为界，低地与河谷则在森林、草原和海岸之间提供通道。这里长期生活着满族、蒙古族、朝鲜族、那乃族、尼夫赫族、乌尔奇族以及更早的女真等群体。

早期居民结合狩猎、捕鱼、畜牧和农业，根据密林与平原的不同条件调整生计。女真人在1115年建立金朝，其后裔满洲人又于1616年建立后金，继而建立清朝。必喇因此处在旧道路、多样生计与变动政权层层交叠的边疆。

“满洲”一词源自日语外来称谓，后来又同日本的帝国计划相联系。这片土地更早的身份，应从众多民族、流域和道路中理解，而非依赖单一固定边界。

english:
Bila Tserkva stands on the Ros, in the old defensive belt south of Kyiv. Founded as Yuriiv under Yaroslav the Wise, it guarded the lands of Rus' against steppe raiders. Its later name means White Church, perhaps recalling the pale walls of the medieval cathedral that once stood here.

In 1550 the Kyiv voivode Fryderyk Proński built a castle on this exposed frontier. The town grew around it, and by 1616 many of its households were Cossack. King Sigismund III granted Magdeburg rights in 1620. Bohdan Khmelnytsky's forces captured the castle in 1648; three years later the town gave its name to a treaty between the Cossacks and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. It became the centre of a Cossack regiment, and in 1702 Semen Palii seized the castle during his uprising against Polish rule. In 1774 the estate passed to Hetman Franciszek Ksawery Branicki. His family built a residence and laid out the landscape park of Oleksandriia. The town entered the Russian Empire in the second partition of Poland in 1793.
simp_chinese:
白采尔克瓦坐落在罗斯河畔，位于基辅以南古老的防御地带。智者雅罗斯拉夫时期，这里以尤里夫之名建城，守护罗斯诸地免受草原袭击。后来的名称意为“白色教堂”，或许令人想起曾矗立于此的中世纪主教座堂浅色墙壁。

1550年，基辅省长弗雷德里克·普龙斯基在这处暴露的边境修建城堡。城镇围绕城堡成长，到1616年许多住户是哥萨克。齐格蒙特三世国王于1620年授予马格德堡法权。博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基的军队于1648年夺取城堡；三年后，哥萨克与波兰立陶宛联邦在此签订条约。白采尔克瓦成为哥萨克团的中心，1702年谢缅·帕利又在反波兰起义中夺取城堡。1774年，地产归盖特曼弗朗齐谢克·克萨韦雷·布拉尼茨基所有。他的家族建造府邸并规划亚历山德里亚园林。1793年第二次瓜分波兰时，城镇归入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Bilah lies in the eastern Sumatran river country below the Batak highlands. The Bilah joins the Barumun, whose waters reach the Malacca Strait through the Panai estuary. A sultanate bearing the name Bilah developed among the Malay courts of the region during the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 比拉位于巴塔克高地下方的苏门答腊东部河流地带。比拉河汇入巴鲁蒙河，河水经帕奈河口流向马六甲海峡。17世纪，同名苏丹国在这一地区的马来宫廷之间发展起来。

english: Bilanga lies north of Fada N’Gourma in the savanna country of the Gourmantché. It was the seat of a chiefly lineage counted among the regional powers of Gulmu, the wider Gourma political world. Traditions connect these ruling houses to the descendants of Diaba Lompo, the remembered founder of the kingdom. Villages around Bilanga combined cultivation with the use of seasonal pasture, while their chiefs maintained relationships with other courts across the eastern Volta basin.
simp_chinese: 比兰加位于法达恩古尔马以北，处在古尔曼切人的草原地区。它是一个首领世系的驻地，属于古尔马广大政治世界古尔穆的地区势力之一。传统将这些统治家族与王国的传说奠基者迪亚巴·隆波的后裔相联系。比兰加周围村落结合耕种和季节性牧场使用，首领则与伏尔塔河流域东部其他宫廷保持关系。

english: Bilasuvar lies on the Mughan plain, a low-lying country between the Aras and the Caspian. The Persian geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi attributed the foundation of the medieval town to a tenth-century Buyid emir named Pilasuvar. By the fourteenth century it had declined amid local conflicts. Nearby mounds and the remains of fortified settlements testify to a longer history of habitation on the plain, where routes crossed the open country between the Iranian plateau and the Caucasus.
simp_chinese: 比拉苏瓦尔位于穆甘平原，这片低地处于阿拉斯河与里海之间。波斯地理学家哈姆达拉·穆斯陶菲称，中世纪城镇由一位名叫皮拉苏瓦尔的十世纪白益王朝埃米尔建立。到十四世纪，它在地方争斗中衰落。附近的土丘和设防聚落遗迹见证了平原更悠久的居住历史；道路穿过这片开阔地带，连接伊朗高原与高加索。

english:
The northern Bilauktaung forms a long wall within the Tenasserim Hills on the Myanmar-Thailand border. It begins from the Dawna Range and continues for roughly four hundred kilometres toward the Kra Isthmus. The ridge is part of the skeleton of the peninsula: its high ground separates river systems and makes east-west travel through this forested frontier difficult.

The northern section rises above the surrounding country at Myinmoletkat Taung, whose summit reaches 2,072 metres. Its prominence of 1,857 metres makes it one of Southeast Asia's ultra-prominent peaks. A series of lesser summits follows the line, including Ngayanni Kyauk Taung, Palan Taung and Baulu Taung, each forming a step in a range that is continuous but uneven.

This is country of heavy tropical rain forest rather than dense settlement. Monsoon winds release more rain on the western mountain sides, so their cover is usually thicker than that of the eastern slopes. Sparse habitation follows the margins of this difficult upland. The northern Bilauktaung is best understood through its altitude, long north-south alignment and rain-bearing western face.
simp_chinese:
比劳山脉北段横贯缅甸与泰国边境，是丹那沙林山系中的一道长墙。它从栋那山脉起步，沿边境延伸约四百公里，直至克拉地峡方向。山脊构成半岛地形的重要骨架，高地将不同水系隔开，也使东西向穿越这片森林边疆十分困难。

北段最醒目的地标是敏莫莱卡山，峰顶达到2072米。其相对高度约1857米，属于东南亚突出的高峰之一。沿线还有一道道略低的山峰，包括额延尼觉山、帕兰山和包卢山，峰线连续却高低起伏，构成山脉北端的轮廓。

这里覆盖着浓密的热带雨林，居民点稀少。季风在西侧山腹释放更多雨水，因此西坡森林通常比东坡更茂密。少量聚落只能沿高地边缘分布。北段的特征集中体现在海拔、南北向延伸和迎风的西坡上。

english: The Bilauktaung Range rises along the Malay Peninsula between the Andaman Sea and the Gulf of Siam. Forested ridges and deep valleys separate the Tenasserim coast from the plains of Siam. Routes across the mountains linked the port of Mergui and the town of Tenasserim with settlements on the eastern shore, allowing goods and travellers to cross the narrow peninsula. The rivers of the western slopes descend towards the Andaman Sea.
simp_chinese: 比劳山脉沿马来半岛耸立，介于安达曼海与暹罗湾之间。森林覆盖的山岭与深谷，将德林达依海岸与暹罗平原隔开。横越山脉的道路把丹老港、丹那沙林镇与东岸聚落连接起来，使货物和旅人能够穿越狭窄的半岛。西坡的河流则流向安达曼海。

english: The southern Bilauktaung ridges run through the narrow country of the Malay Peninsula. On their western slopes the Lenya River rises in the hills, flowing north before turning west towards the Andaman Sea. Forest covers the broken mountain terrain, and streams cut valleys between the ridges. Across the watershed to the east lies the coast of the Gulf of Siam, separated from the Tenasserim shore by a rugged but comparatively narrow stretch of land.
simp_chinese: 比劳山脉南段纵贯马来半岛狭长的陆地。西坡山间发源的兰雅河先向北流，随后转向西方，注入安达曼海。森林覆盖崎岖山地，溪流在山岭间切出河谷。分水岭以东是暹罗湾海岸，一段崎岖却相对狭窄的陆地将其与德林达依海岸隔开。

english:
Bilbeis lies at the eastern edge of the Nile Delta, on the route between Egypt and the lands of Syria. Its position made the fortified town a gateway to the Delta and brought it into the struggles for control of Egypt in the twelfth century.

In 1164 the Syrian commander Shirkuh held Bilbeis against a three-month siege by the combined forces of the Egyptian vizier Shawar and Amalric, king of Jerusalem. Four years later Amalric returned with a crusading army, captured the town and killed many of its inhabitants. Centuries afterward, during the French military occupation of Egypt, Napoleon ordered the fortifications repaired in 1798. The town remained a place where the cultivated Nile Delta met the approaches across the eastern desert.
simp_chinese:
比勒拜斯位于尼罗河三角洲东缘，处在埃及与叙利亚之间的道路上。它的位置使这座设防城镇成为通向三角洲的门户，也使其卷入十二世纪争夺埃及的斗争。

1164年，叙利亚将领希尔库在比勒拜斯抵抗埃及维齐尔沙瓦尔和耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克联军长达三个月的围攻。四年后，阿马尔里克率十字军返回，攻占城镇并杀害许多居民。几个世纪后，法国占领埃及期间，拿破仑于1798年下令修复这里的防御工事。城镇仍处于耕作的三角洲与东部沙漠通道的交界处。

english:
Bilecik stands among the hills and valleys of northwestern Anatolia, close to the early Ottoman frontier. Its Byzantine fortress, known as Belekoma, guarded a settlement on the approaches between the Sakarya valley and the lands around Bursa. The town became closely associated with the beginnings of the Ottoman dynasty and with Şeyh Edebali, a religious figure linked by marriage and tradition to Osman Bey.

Ottoman accounts place the capture of Bilecik by Osman around 1299. The conquest gave the emerging principality a stronghold beyond Söğüt. Edebali maintained a lodge at Bilecik, supported by endowments recorded under Osman and renewed in the time of Orhan. His tomb became a place of remembrance for the dynasty's origins. Muslim and Greek communities lived in different parts of the town, their neighbourhoods reflecting its long history as a meeting point on the Anatolian frontier.
simp_chinese:
比莱吉克坐落在安纳托利亚西北部的丘陵与河谷间，靠近奥斯曼早期边疆。拜占庭堡垒贝莱科马守护着萨卡里亚河谷与布尔萨周边地区之间的通道。城镇与奥斯曼王朝的起源以及谢赫埃德巴勒紧密相连；传统记载这位宗教人物与奥斯曼贝伊有姻亲关系。

奥斯曼史书记载，奥斯曼约于1299年攻占比莱吉克，使新兴公国在瑟于特之外获得一处要塞。埃德巴勒在此设有修道场所，其基金会见于奥斯曼时期记录，并在奥尔汗时期得到续立。埃德巴勒之墓成为人们追忆王朝起源的地方。穆斯林和希腊社群居住在城镇不同部分，街区反映了这里作为安纳托利亚边疆交会处的漫长历史。

english: Bilghah is a well of sweet water in the high Najd country south of an-Nuqrah. It lies in Wadi Raghwah, whose floodwaters drain toward Wadi Sahuq, near a group of hills including Aaj, Mawan and Arik. Old grinding stones, pottery and traces of mining in the surrounding country testify to human activity in this otherwise dry landscape.
simp_chinese: 比勒加是努格拉以南内志高地的一处淡水井，位于拉格瓦谷地，洪水由此流向萨胡格谷。附近山丘包括阿杰、马万和阿里克。周围发现的古老磨石、陶器和采矿遗迹，见证了人们曾在这片干旱地区活动。

english:
Bilgram stands on a bluff that once formed the eastern bank of the Ganges. Tradition attributes its foundation to the Raikwar Raja Sri Ram, who is said to have called it Srinagar and built a fort, temple and tank. In the thirteenth century Sayyid families from Wasit in Iraq settled here and established estates whose descendants became influential landholders in Awadh.

In 1540 Sher Shah Suri defeated the Mughal emperor Humayun at the Battle of Bilgram. Under Akbar the town became the centre of a pargana. Its Sayyid families supplied officials and commanders to later Mughal rulers, and counted the scholar Azad Bilgrami among their notable figures in the eighteenth century. His home town remained a place of learning as well as local landed power.
simp_chinese:
比尔格拉姆坐落在一处高崖上，这里曾是恒河东岸。相传赖克瓦尔人的斯里·拉姆王建立了城镇，称其为斯里讷格尔，并修建堡垒、神庙和水池。十三世纪，来自伊拉克瓦西特的赛义德家族在此定居，建立庄园，其后裔成为阿瓦德有影响力的地主。

1540年，舍尔沙·苏里在比尔格拉姆战役中击败莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍。阿克巴在位时，此城成为一个帕尔加纳的中心。当地赛义德家族为后来的莫卧儿统治者提供官员和将领，十八世纪的学者阿扎德·比尔格拉米也是其中的知名人物。比尔格拉姆既有地方地主势力，也以学术闻名。

english: The Biligiriranga Hills rise where the Eastern and Western Ghats meet in southern India. Their forested slopes range from dry scrub and deciduous woodland to wetter forest and high grassland. A temple of Ranganathaswamy stands on a hill overlooking this rugged country, giving the range its name. The Soliga people have long lived among these forests, whose connected ridges also provide habitat for elephants, tigers and many other animals.
simp_chinese: 比利吉里兰加丘陵耸立在印度南部东、西高止山交汇之处。山坡林地由干燥灌丛和落叶林，逐渐过渡为湿润森林与高地草原。俯瞰崎岖山地的岭上有一座兰加纳塔斯瓦米神庙，山脉也由此得名。索利加人长期生活在这些森林中，相连的山岭也是大象、老虎和许多其他动物的栖息地。

english: Bilikol is a freshwater lake at the northern foot of the Karatau Mountains. The Asa River flows into it from the southeast and continues north toward Akkol, while rain and melting snow also replenish its waters. Reeds grow along the shores, sheltering waterbirds among the surrounding steppe. Fish inhabit the lake, and its level rises and falls with the changing flow from the mountains.
simp_chinese: 比利科尔湖是卡拉套山北麓的一座淡水湖。阿萨河从东南注入湖中，再向北流往阿科尔湖；降雨和融雪也补充湖水。湖岸边的芦苇丛为水鸟提供栖身之处，周围则是一片开阔草原。湖中栖息着鱼类，湖面水位随着来自群山的水流变化而涨落。

english:
Bilinarra country lies in the Victoria River District of Australia's Northern Territory. Its remembered extent includes the Moray Range, Delamere, the Victoria River Downs area and the junction of the Victoria and Armstrong rivers. Blacksoil plains, limestone gorges and sandstone outcrops give this country a varied surface: water collects and spreads across the plains, while stone rises in ridges and gorges between them. The name itself may describe the land, for bili means rock or hill.

Bilinarra people maintain a distinct identity even though the language is closely related to Gurindji and Ngarinyman and mutually intelligible with both. Speakers regard their own speech as separate, preserving a distinction that outsiders did not treat as a strict boundary. Pastoral settlement transformed this world.

Dispossession brought killings, disease, forced work and the mixing of people from different language groups on stations. The landscape and language together carry the history of both enduring attachment and colonial violence.
simp_chinese:
比林纳拉人的故土位于澳大利亚北领地维多利亚河地区。其传统范围包括莫雷岭、德拉米尔、维多利亚河唐斯一带，以及维多利亚河与阿姆斯特朗河交汇处。黑色土平原、石灰岩峡谷和砂岩露头构成多样地表：水会在平原上汇集铺开，岩层则在周围隆起成山脊和峡壁。地名本身可能描述这片土地，因为“bili”意为岩石或山丘。

比林纳拉语与古林吉语、恩加林曼语关系密切且可互通，但使用者仍把自己的语言视为独立语言，保留着外部观察者未必采用的身份区分。牧业扩张改变了这里。失地带来杀戮、疾病、强制劳动，也使不同语言群体在牧场中混杂。

地貌与语言共同承载着深厚归属和殖民暴力相交的历史。

english:
Bellingham lies on the North Tyne in Northumberland, where Hareshaw Burn descends from the moors to join the river. The surrounding country combines valley pasture, heather moor and small cultivated patches. The river provided fish, water and a route through the northern uplands, while the moors supplied grazing and peat.

Angles settled the site, and the name probably means the home of Billa's people. The village lay within the border country disputed and raided during the medieval wars between England and Scotland. In the twelfth century, the de Bellingham family held land here and built a motte and bailey castle. The earthworks survive near the town, though the castle itself disappeared.

St Cuthbert's Church was consecrated in 1180. Its stone barrel-vaulted roof and massive slabs provided protection against the frequent fires of border warfare. The church became the religious centre of a wide parish, while markets, mills and inns served drovers and travellers crossing the moors. Bellingham developed as a small market town of the North Tyne valley, a place whose stone buildings and defensible church grew from the practical demands of the border.
simp_chinese:
贝灵厄姆位于诺森伯兰郡北泰恩河畔，哈雷肖溪自荒原流入河中。周围兼有谷地牧场、石南荒原和小块耕地。河流提供鱼类、饮水和穿越北部高地的路线，荒原则供给牧草与泥炭。

盎格鲁人定居此地，地名通常解释为“比拉族人的家”。村庄位于英格兰和苏格兰战争与边地劫掠频繁的区域。十二世纪，德贝灵厄姆家族占据土地并修建土丘与城郭结合的城堡，土垒保留在城镇附近，城堡建筑后来消失。

圣卡斯伯特教堂一一八〇年祝圣。石砌筒形拱顶和厚重石板保护建筑免受边地战火引发的大火。教堂成为广大堂区中心，市场、磨坊和旅店服务穿越荒原的赶畜人。贝灵厄姆发展为北泰恩谷的小集市中心，石屋与坚固教堂都源于边境生活的实际需要。

english:
Bilma is an oasis beneath the Kaouar cliffs, amid the sands of the central Sahara. Date palms and gardens grow where water reaches the surface, while evaporation pans yield the salt and natron for which the oasis is renowned. Bilma belongs to a chain of settlements that offered caravans a passage between the Lake Chad basin and the Fezzan.

Kanem and later Bornu sought control of the Kawar oases and their valuable mineral production. In the late sixteenth century Mai Idris Aloma campaigned against Bilma and other oasis towns, bringing their rulers into Bornu's sphere. In the eighteenth century Tuareg forces gained control of Kawar. Salt caravans carried Bilma's produce westward across the Ténéré to Aïr, and onward toward the Hausa markets, in exchange for grain and other supplies.
simp_chinese:
比尔马是撒哈拉中部沙海中的一处绿洲，坐落在卡瓦尔断崖之下。水从地下涌出的地方生长着枣椰树和园圃，蒸发池则产出使绿洲闻名的盐与泡碱。比尔马与一系列相邻聚落共同构成通道，供商队往来乍得湖盆地和费赞。

加涅姆以及后来的博尔努都力图控制卡瓦尔诸绿洲和宝贵的矿盐生产。十六世纪后期，迈伊德里斯·阿卢马征讨比尔马等绿洲城镇，使当地统治者进入博尔努势力范围。十八世纪，图阿雷格势力取得卡瓦尔。运盐商队将比尔马的物产向西穿过泰内雷沙漠，运到阿伊尔，再通往豪萨市场，换取粮食和其他补给。

english: Bilo lies in the western Ethiopian highlands, in country associated with the Oromo communities of Wellega. Along with nearby Lieka it was known as a regional market before the rise of Nekemte. Lieka stood on a plain bearing the name Bilo, a landscape in which markets connected settlements across the western uplands. Oromo farming communities and their gadaa institutions shaped the region after their settlement from the late sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 比洛位于埃塞俄比亚西部高地，处于与沃莱加奥罗莫社群相关的地区。在内格姆特兴起之前，它与附近的列卡都是地区市场。列卡坐落在以比洛命名的平原上，市场将西部高地的聚落联系起来。十六世纪末起，定居的奥罗莫农耕社群及其加达制度塑造了这一地区。

english: Bilodeau Point lies on the southern shore of Anticosti Island, facing the waters of the Honguedo Strait. Just west of the point, the Maccan River reaches the Gulf of St. Lawrence through coastal marsh. Reefs and shoals along the island's southern side make its long shoreline hazardous to passing ships, while only a few bays offer shelter. In 1680 Louis Jolliet received Anticosti as a seigneury, bringing the island into the network of French possessions along the St. Lawrence.
simp_chinese: 比洛多角位于安蒂科斯蒂岛南岸，面向翁盖多海峡。岬角稍西处，马坎河穿过沿海沼泽，注入圣劳伦斯湾。岛屿南侧遍布礁石与浅滩，漫长海岸对过往船只颇为危险，只有少数海湾可供避风。1680年，路易·若利埃获封安蒂科斯蒂领地，将此岛纳入法国人在圣劳伦斯沿岸的产业。

english: Bilokorovychi lies in the wooded lowlands of Polesia, in the country between Olevsk and Korosten. Archaeological traces around the village attest to settlement in the region long before the modern town. An icon of the Mother of God associated with Bilokorovychi is traditionally said to have appeared in 1545, and became an object of Orthodox devotion in the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 比洛科罗维奇位于波列西亚森林低地，处在奥列夫斯克与科罗斯坚之间。村庄周围的考古遗迹表明，这一地区远在近代城镇出现之前就有人居住。与比洛科罗维奇相关的圣母圣像据传统说法于1545年显现，成为周围乡村东正教信徒敬奉的对象。

english: Bilovodsk lies beside the Derkul, east of the Aidar in the Siverskyi Donets basin. Springs emerging from chalk give the river water a pale colour associated with the settlement's name, meaning White Waters. Founded in 1686, it attracted Cossacks and fugitives from serfdom to the frontier. Its inhabitants took part in the Bulavin rebellion, and in 1708 a punitive expedition sent by the tsar burned the settlement.
simp_chinese: 比洛沃茨克坐落在德尔库尔河畔，位于北顿涅茨河流域艾达尔河以东。白垩地层中涌出的泉水使河水呈浅白色，聚落“白水”之名与此相联系。这里建立于1686年，吸引哥萨克和逃离农奴制的人来到边疆定居。居民参加了布拉文起义，1708年沙皇派来的惩罚部队烧毁了聚落。

english:
Biloxi lies on the northern Gulf coast, facing Mississippi Sound and the barrier islands beyond. The name comes from the Biloxi people, who lived near the coast when the French arrived. They cultivated maize, beans and squash, hunted and fished throughout the year; an epidemic had already devastated one of their villages before Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville encountered them in 1699.

Iberville founded Fort Maurepas at Old Biloxi in 1699. A later settlement developed around Fort Louis, and in 1720 the capital of French Louisiana moved there from Mobile. The stay was brief: concerns about the exposed coast helped persuade Governor Bienville to transfer the capital to New Orleans in 1722. Biloxi people later moved west into Louisiana, where they joined other Indigenous communities.
simp_chinese:
比洛克西位于墨西哥湾北岸，面向密西西比湾及更远处的障壁岛。地名来自比洛克西人；法国人到来时，他们生活在附近海岸，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，也狩猎捕鱼。1699年皮埃尔·勒穆瓦纳·迪贝维尔遇见他们之前，一场疫病已经重创了他们的一座村庄。

1699年，迪贝维尔在旧比洛克西建立莫尔帕堡。后来路易堡周围形成聚落，1720年法属路易斯安那首府从莫比尔迁至此处。首府在此停留不久，对海岸环境的担忧促使比安维尔总督于1722年将行政中心迁往新奥尔良。比洛克西人后来向西迁入路易斯安那，加入其他原住民社群。

english:
Biloxi Bay opens onto the sheltered waters of Mississippi Sound, behind the barrier islands of the northern Gulf coast. Rivers and marshes border its shores, while the islands provide a screen from the open sea. The bay takes its name from the Biloxi people, who lived in the region when French explorers arrived.

In 1699 Pierre Le Moyne d’Iberville sailed to this coast seeking the mouth of the Mississippi. After exploring the river with help from local inhabitants, he ordered a fort built on the eastern side of Biloxi Bay. Fort Maurepas became an early foothold of French Louisiana. The shallow coast and its channels shaped the colony’s search for a suitable harbor, while relations with Indigenous communities were essential to the newcomers.
simp_chinese:
比洛克西湾通向密西西比海湾水道的受庇护水域，外侧是墨西哥湾北岸的沙障岛。河流与沼泽分布在湾岸，岛屿则遮挡外海。海湾得名于比洛克西人；法国探险者抵达时，他们居住在这一地区。

1699年，皮埃尔·勒莫因·迪贝维尔来到这里寻找密西西比河口。在当地居民帮助下探查大河后，他下令在比洛克西湾东岸修筑堡垒。莫勒帕堡成为法属路易斯安那早期的立足点。浅岸及其水道影响了殖民者寻找港口的过程，他们也依靠与原住民社群的关系。

english:
Bilyar was a great city of Volga Bulgaria on the Little Cheremshan River. Known in Russian chronicles as the Great City, it was a major center of trade and, in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, served among the capitals of the Bulgar state. Its fortified site and extensive remains testify to the scale of a city that drew people and goods through the middle Volga region. Batu Khan's army sacked it in 1236, destroying its monumental buildings.

Although the city was rebuilt after the Mongol conquest, it never recovered its former size or power. The old earthworks remained a reminder of the earlier Bulgar center. In 1654, as the Russian state fortified its southeastern frontier, a new Russian fort called Bilyar was established near the ancient site. The later settlement thus stood in a landscape marked both by the remains of Volga Bulgaria and by a new line of frontier defenses.
simp_chinese:
比利亚尔是伏尔加保加利亚的一座大城，位于小切列姆尚河畔。俄罗斯编年史称其为“大城”，它是重要的贸易中心，十二至十三世纪也曾是保加利亚国家的都城之一。设防遗址和广阔的遗迹体现了这座中伏尔加城市昔日的规模。1236年，拔都汗的军队洗劫此城，宏伟建筑遭到摧毁。

蒙古征服后，城市虽然重建，却再未恢复旧有规模和力量。古老土垒仍令人想起昔日的保加利亚中心。1654年，俄罗斯国家加强东南边防，在古城遗址附近建立了一座同名的新堡垒。后来的聚落因此处于既留有伏尔加保加利亚遗迹、又有新边防线的土地上。

english:
Bima, known locally as Mbojo, is a kingdom on eastern Sumbawa. Its harbour and fertile lands made it an important centre in the seas between Java, Sulawesi and Flores. Early Portuguese accounts describe exports of horses, cloth, enslaved people and dyewood. Bima's rulers developed close ties with Makassar, while their influence reached across the strait to Manggarai on Flores.

Makassarese expeditions attacked Sumbawa in the early seventeenth century, and Bima's ruling house adopted Islam. The sultanate's court drew on Makassarese models and maintained marriage ties with Sulawesi's nobility. After the Dutch East India Company defeated Makassar, Bima accepted an agreement with the company in 1669. The Dutch sought a monopoly over sappanwood, but the sultan continued to govern locally and to pursue interests in Flores. In 1815 the immense eruption of Mount Tambora devastated Sumbawa, bringing destruction and famine to the lands of Bima and its neighbours.
simp_chinese:
比马当地称为姆博佐，是松巴哇东部的王国。港口与肥沃土地使它成为爪哇、苏拉威西和弗洛勒斯之间海域的重要中心。早期葡萄牙记载提到这里出口马匹、布匹、奴隶和染料木。比马统治者与望加锡关系密切，其影响也越过海峡到达弗洛勒斯的曼加莱。

十七世纪初，望加锡远征军数次进攻松巴哇，比马统治家族随后接受伊斯兰教。苏丹国王廷借鉴望加锡制度，并与苏拉威西贵族保持婚姻关系。荷兰东印度公司击败望加锡后，比马于1669年与公司订立协议。荷兰人力求垄断苏木贸易，但苏丹仍在当地统治，并继续经营在弗洛勒斯的利益。1815年，坦博拉火山猛烈喷发，摧毁松巴哇大片地区，给比马及邻国带来灾难和饥荒。

english:
Bimbia lay on the forested lowlands south of Mount Cameroon and west of the Wouri estuary, in the country of the Isubu. Its principal settlement overlooked the eastern coast of the Limbé district and formed part of a landscape of rivers, estuaries and nearby islands. Three villages—Dikolo, Bona Ngombe and Bona Bille—continued to mark the old political territory into later times.

Isubu oral history links the people to Mboko, southwest of Mount Cameroon. It remembers Isuwu na Monanga as the leader who brought them to the west bank of the Wouri estuary, and King Mbimbi as the ruler whose name came to identify the state. Portuguese traders reached the estuary in 1472. Over the following decades Isubu merchants became intermediaries, carrying ivory, kola nuts and peppers from inland while also participating in the slave trade.

Bimbia became the primary Isubu settlement and, by the sixteenth century, was second only to the Duala in regional trade. British influence grew during the nineteenth century. Bimbia sheltered repatriated and escaped captives.
simp_chinese:
宾比亚位于喀麦隆山以南、武里河口以西的森林低地，属于伊苏布人的地区。主要聚落濒临林贝区东岸，周边交织着河流、河口和近岸岛屿。迪科洛、博纳恩戈姆贝和博纳比莱三个村庄，延续着旧政权所覆盖的地域。

伊苏布口述史把族人渊源追溯到喀麦隆山西南的姆博科，记得伊苏武·纳·莫南加带领人群迁至武里河口西岸，也记得姆宾比王的名字后来成为政权称号。1472年，葡萄牙商人抵达河口。此后数十年，伊苏布商人充当区域贸易中介，把象牙、可乐果和胡椒运出内陆，同时也参与奴隶贸易。

宾比亚逐渐成为主要伊苏布聚落，到十六世纪时，其贸易地位仅次于杜阿拉。十九世纪英国影响增强，宾比亚也接纳获释和逃离奴役的人。

english: Bimbilla is the capital of Nanung, a kingdom in the savanna country of northern Ghana. Its ruler, the Bimbilla Naa, stands at the head of a hierarchy of chiefs and elders. Nanung tradition traces the kingdom to Naa Ŋmantambo, a son of Naa Gbewaa who moved south after his brother Sitobu established Dagbon. The name Bimbilla is explained as “Little Bing,” recalling a place associated with followers of the founder. Neighboring towns such as Nakpa, Dakpam and Wulensi formed part of the kingdom's political world.
simp_chinese: 宾比拉是纳农王国的都城，位于加纳北部草原地区。统治者宾比拉纳居于酋长和长老组成的等级体系之首。纳农传统将王国起源追溯到纳·曼坦博，他是纳·格贝瓦之子，在兄弟西托布建立达格邦后向南迁徙。宾比拉之名被解释为“小宾”，纪念创建者追随者所联系的一处地方。纳克帕、多克帕姆和武伦西等邻镇也属于王国的政治世界。

english: The Bimini islands stand at the western edge of the Great Bahama Bank, across the Florida Straits from the mainland. Shallow water spreads over the bank east of the islands, while the deep channel to the west carries the Gulf Stream northward. Reefs and shoals surround the low cays, making the transition from the ocean channel to the bank a notable feature of this western approach to the Bahamas.
simp_chinese: 比米尼群岛坐落在大巴哈马浅滩西缘，与大陆之间隔着佛罗里达海峡。岛屿以东是覆盖浅滩的浅水，以西的深水海峡则有墨西哥湾流向北流过。低平礁岛周围分布着礁石和浅滩，从大洋水道进入浅滩的变化，是巴哈马西侧航路的显著特征。

english: Binalatongan was an important settlement in the Pangasinan plain of western Luzon. Dominican missionaries established a town and accepted its mission as a vicariate in 1588, with a church dedicated to Saint Dominic. The people of the district spoke Pangasinan, and the town became a centre of both colonial administration and resistance to it. In 1660 Andrés Malong, a leader from Binalatongan, led an uprising that spread across Pangasinan and proclaimed himself its king. Spanish forces defeated the revolt and captured him in 1661. A century later Juan de la Cruz Palaris led another rising, taking advantage of Spain's war with Britain. The town was eventually moved and became known as San Carlos, but the name Binalatongan remained associated with these struggles.
simp_chinese: 比纳拉通安是吕宋西部邦阿西楠平原的重要聚落。多明我会传教士在此建立城镇，其传教站于1588年获准成为代牧区，并建有奉献给圣多明我的教堂。当地居民使用邦阿西楠语，城镇既成为殖民行政中心，也成为反抗统治的中心。1660年，来自比纳拉通安的安德烈斯·马隆领导起义，席卷邦阿西楠，并自称当地国王。西班牙军队击败起义，于1661年将他俘获。一个世纪后，胡安·德拉克鲁斯·帕拉里斯趁西班牙与英国交战之际领导另一场起义。城镇后来迁移并改称圣卡洛斯，但比纳拉通安的名字仍与这些斗争相联系。

english: Binalbagan lies on the western coast of Negros, facing the waters between the island and Panay. Known earlier as Inabangan, it was among the first settlements on Negros drawn into the Spanish mission system in the sixteenth century. Augustinian missionaries worked there with Ilog as an outstation, and a Recollect convent was established in 1622. The coastal communities had long maintained connections across the narrow sea to neighbouring Panay, from which the early missionaries also came.
simp_chinese: 比纳尔巴甘位于内格罗斯岛西岸，面向它与班乃岛之间的水域。这里早先称为伊纳班甘，是十六世纪内格罗斯最早纳入西班牙传教体系的聚落之一。奥斯定会传教士以伊洛为外站在此活动，1622年又建立了一座雷科莱托会修院。沿海社群早已跨过狭窄海域与邻近的班乃岛保持联系，早期传教士也从那里而来。

english: Binandere country lies in eastern New Guinea, in the river valleys north of the Owen Stanley Range. Its language gives its name to a family whose members include Orokaiva and Baruga. Communities occupied both inland forest and coastal country, with the Gira and other rivers carrying water from the mountains towards the Solomon Sea.
simp_chinese: 比南德雷地区位于新几内亚东部欧文斯坦利山脉以北的河谷。当地语言为一个语族命名，奥罗凯瓦语与巴鲁加语也属于这个语族。社群分布在内陆森林和沿海地带，吉拉河等河流则将山中之水送往所罗门海。

english: Binangonan de Lampon lies on the eastern coast of Luzon, facing the Pacific beyond Lamon Bay. Mountains rise inland behind the coastal plain. Local history credits the chief Diego Mangilaya with developing the settlement in 1696. In 1803 Captain Pedro de León attached Binangonan de Lampon to Nueva Ecija. Its name distinguishes it from the other Binangonan on the shore of Laguna de Bay, across the mountains to the west.
simp_chinese: 拉姆蓬的比南戈南位于吕宋东岸，隔拉蒙湾面向太平洋，海岸平原背后山峦耸立。地方史将1696年发展这一聚落的功劳归于首领迭戈·曼伊拉亚。1803年，佩德罗·德·莱昂将拉姆蓬的比南戈南划归新怡诗夏。它的名称使之与西面群山另一侧、拉古纳德巴伊湖畔的同名地点相区别。

english: Binawangan lies on the coast of Lamon Bay in northern Bicol, where the peninsula of southeastern Luzon meets the Pacific. Its shore belongs to the country west of Paracale, an area long known for gold. Mining in the region predates Spanish rule, and a substantial deposit near Paracale drew renewed attention in the seventeenth century. The bay and the hills behind it form part of the varied landscape between the Tagalog lands and the Bicol peninsula.
simp_chinese: 比纳旺安位于比科尔北部的拉蒙湾海岸，吕宋东南部半岛在此面向太平洋。这片海岸属于帕拉卡莱以西的地区，附近土地长期以黄金闻名。当地采矿早于西班牙统治，十七世纪帕拉卡莱附近的大型矿床又引起关注。海湾及其背后的丘陵构成他加禄地区与比科尔半岛之间多样地貌的一部分。

english: Binayakpur was a pargana in the country between Basti and Gorakhpur, in the eastern plains of Hindustan. The wider region lay near the ancient Buddhist centres of Kapilavastu and Shravasti; later accounts describe much of the country as forest inhabited by Bhar and Tharu communities. The Nawab of Awadh ceded the Gorakhpur region to the British East India Company in 1801, bringing its parganas under a new authority.
simp_chinese: 比纳亚克普尔是印度斯坦东部平原、伯斯蒂与戈勒克布尔之间的一个帕尔加纳。更广阔的地区靠近古代佛教中心迦毗罗卫与舍卫城；后来的记述称，这一带大片森林中居住着巴尔人和塔鲁人。1801年，阿瓦德纳瓦布将戈勒克布尔地区割让给英国东印度公司，地方行政区域也随之转入新的统治之下。

english: Binchuan lies east of Dali beneath the peaks of Jizu Mountain, one of the great Buddhist sacred places of southwestern China. Its monasteries and shrines drew pilgrims from distant provinces, among them the monk Jingwen, who died before reaching the mountain. The traveler Xu Xiake carried his companion's remains to Jizu in 1638, fulfilling his wish to be buried there. Xu returned in 1639, examining the mountain's springs, cliffs and temples and helping compile a gazetteer of the sacred mountain.
simp_chinese: 宾川位于大理以东，鸡足山群峰耸立于境内。这里是西南佛教圣地，寺院吸引远方香客前来。僧人静闻立愿朝山，却未能抵达便病逝途中。1638年，旅行家徐霞客携其遗骨来到鸡足山，完成了友人的遗愿。次年他再次登山，考察泉水、崖壁与寺庙，并参与编修《鸡足山志》。

english: Bindal country extends through coastal north Queensland from the Burdekin River toward Cape Cleveland and inland to the Leichhardt Range. Rivers, estuaries and the coast lie within this country, adjoining that of the Wulgurukaba. The Bindal are one of the Aboriginal peoples whose ties to these lands reach back long before colonial settlement.
simp_chinese: 宾达尔人的土地位于昆士兰北部沿海，从伯德金河延伸至克利夫兰角，并向内陆到达莱卡特岭。河流、河口与海岸都在这片土地之内，邻近乌尔古鲁卡巴人的区域。宾达尔人与这片土地的联系远早于殖民定居。

english: Bindals Fjord cuts into Nordland’s rugged coast at the southern end of Norway’s Northern Norway region. The county faces the Norwegian Sea and stretches roughly five hundred kilometers from Trøndelag toward Troms. Steep mountains, a narrow coastal shelf, thousands of islands and branches of narrow water define the approach to the land. At the head of such fjords, valleys and rivers often provide the only continuous level ground. The fjord belongs to a cold maritime landscape with strong seasonal contrasts. Ocean currents temper winter temperatures along the outer coast, while mountains and distance from open water bring colder conditions inland. Snow can persist on high ground, and glaciers feed streams toward the sea. The sheltered channels provide routes through difficult terrain, with boats serving as practical transport for fishing and settlement throughout much of the region’s history. People lived along these coasts, islands and straits as early as 10,500 years ago, relying on abundant marine products. Cod fishing became the foundation of trade, especially after stockfish could be shipped south. In 1432, survivors of a shipwreck on Røst described local families fishing cod and halibut, keeping cattle and trading fish for grain. Bindals Fjord’s inward passage reflects this long dependence on the sea.
simp_chinese:
宾达尔斯峡湾切入诺尔兰崎岖的海岸，位于挪威北部南端。诺尔兰面向挪威海，从特伦德拉格向特罗姆斯方向延伸约五百公里。陡峭山地、狭窄海岸平台、成千上万座岛屿和深入陆地的水道共同构成入岸通道；在峡湾尽头，山谷与河流往往提供唯一较连续的低地。

 这里属于寒冷海洋环境，季节差异强烈。洋流使外海冬季相对温和，山地和距海远近则让内陆更为寒冷。高地积雪可长期存在，冰川融水向海汇流。受地形限制，避风水道承担交通作用，船只长期服务于捕鱼和聚落往来。

 早在一万零五百年前，人群就在海岸、岛屿和海峡附近生活，利用丰富的海洋资源。鳕鱼捕捞后来成为贸易基础，尤其当鱼干可以南运之后。1432年，在勒斯特岛失事船只的幸存者记下当地人捕捞鳕鱼和比目鱼、饲养牛，并用鱼换粮的生活。宾达尔斯峡湾向内延伸的水路正是这种海洋生计的一部分。

english: Binder lies in the Mayo-Kebbi country, where the Moundang established communities along the river valley. Their traditions tell of Damba, a hunter remembered as the founder of the ruling line at Léré. The region later became a scene of struggle between Moundang and expanding Fulbe powers; the loss of Binder and the fighting around Léré prompted movements of people farther south along the Mayo Podoué.
simp_chinese: 宾代尔位于马约凯比地区，蒙当人在河谷沿线建立了社群。他们的传统讲述了猎人丹巴的故事，后人将他记作莱雷统治家族的创建者。此后，该地区成为蒙当人与扩张的富尔贝势力争斗的场所；宾代尔失守及莱雷周围的战事促使居民向南迁往马约波杜埃沿岸。

english: Bindjali is a name associated with the Bodaruwitj people and language of southeastern South Australia. Their country extends across inland plains and dunes east of the Coorong, near the borderlands of western Victoria. Wetlands and seasonal water places formed part of a landscape occupied by neighbouring Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 宾贾利是与南澳大利亚东南部博达鲁维吉人及其语言有关的名称。他们的土地横跨库隆以东的内陆平原与沙丘，接近维多利亚西部边缘。湿地与季节性水源地是邻近原住民社群所居土地的一部分。

english: Bingin lies beside the Musi River in southern Sumatra, near rapids that once made this stretch a stopping point for river traffic. The site of Bingin Jungut preserves the remains of brick temples and Buddhist images, including a four-armed Avalokiteshvara. A settlement stood on a hill protected by an earthen bank and ditch. Pottery, beads and traces of ironworking show that the riverbank was a place of both religious life and exchange in the early centuries of the second millennium.
simp_chinese: 宾银位于苏门答腊南部穆西河畔，附近急流曾使这一河段成为河运停靠之处。宾银琼古特遗址保留砖造寺庙和佛教造像遗存，其中包括一尊四臂观音像。聚落曾坐落在丘上，以土垒和壕沟保护。陶器、珠饰和炼铁痕迹表明，公元第二个千年的最初几个世纪，这处河岸兼具宗教生活与交换的意义。

english:
Bingöl was long known as Çapakçur or Chapaghjur, an Armenian name meaning “spread out water.” It lies in eastern Anatolia within the historic region of Sophene and among mountains reaching three thousand meters. The city itself stands about 1,120 meters above sea level on a plateau overlooking the Sağyer, a tributary of the Gonik Stream, which later joins the Murat River. Hot dry summers alternate with cold, snowy winters. Stepanos Asoghik mentioned Chapaghjur in the eleventh century while describing the 995 earthquake.

The name is sometimes linked with the Roman fortress-town of Citharizum. In the Middle Ages the settlement was also called Romanoupolis after Emperor Romanos I Lekapenos, who brought it into the Byzantine Empire in 942. It first belonged to the theme of Mesopotamia and was later elevated into a separate theme. From the thirteenth century, the Suwaydid dynasty ruled autonomously within the wider Ottoman world.

Its mountain pastures supported livestock, while roads through Elazığ linked the town to eastern Anatolia.
simp_chinese:
宾格尔旧称恰帕克丘尔或查帕格朱尔，这是亚美尼亚语名称，意为“铺展开的水”。城镇位于东安纳托利亚的索菲尼历史地区，周围山地可达三千米。城区在海拔约一千一百二十米的高原上俯瞰萨耶尔溪，这条溪经戈尼克溪流向穆拉特河。夏季炎热干燥，冬季寒冷多雪。

十一世纪史家斯特帕诺斯·阿索吉克在记述995年地震时提到恰帕克丘尔。另一些说法把这里与罗马要塞城奇塔里祖姆相联系。中世纪时，拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯一世·利卡潘诺斯于942年将其并入帝国，城镇因而又有罗曼努波利斯之名，起先隶属美索不达米亚军区，后升为独立军区。十三世纪起，苏韦迪王朝在奥斯曼势力扩大的背景下半独立统治此地。

山间牧场适合畜牧，经埃拉泽的道路把城镇与东安纳托利亚相连。

english: Bình Lâm lies in the mountainous upper Lô River country of Hà Giang. Its Buddhist temple preserves a bronze bell cast in 1295 under the Trần king Anh Tông. The local chief and his wife joined elders and other believers in contributing to its making. The inscription on the bell records a community and its religious life in a frontier region of Đại Việt.
simp_chinese: 平林位于河江多山的泸江上游地区。当地佛寺保存着一口铜钟，铸于陈英宗统治下的1295年。地方首领及其妻子与当地长者、男女信众共同捐献钱财，促成了这口钟的铸造。钟上的铭文留下了大越北方边疆一处社群及其佛教信仰生活的珍贵记录。

english: Bình Nguyên lay in the mountainous country of the upper Lô River, where the valleys of Vị Xuyên open southward from Hà Giang. Its old name appears in records of the Lý and Trần periods; under the Lê it became Vị Xuyên. Forested hills and streams surround the cultivated land along the river, linking this northern frontier with Tuyên Quang farther downstream.
simp_chinese: 平原位于泸江上游山区，渭川谷地从河江向南展开。李朝和陈朝时期的记载使用平原之名，黎朝时改称渭川。森林覆盖的山丘和大小溪流环绕着沿江村落与耕地，泸江则将这片北方边疆与更下游的宣光及其通往平原的水路连接起来。

english: North of the broad Helena Valley, the Missouri River cuts between steep limestone walls at the Gates of the Mountains. The narrow passage opens into a country of mountains and wooded slopes above the river. In July 1805 Meriwether Lewis and William Clark brought their expedition upstream through the gorge. Lewis gave the passage its name because the cliffs seemed to swing apart like gates as the boats approached them.
simp_chinese: 海伦娜河谷以北，密苏里河在高耸的石灰岩壁之间穿行，这段狭窄峡谷被称为群山之门。河道两侧山峦起伏，山坡上生长着林木。1805年7月，刘易斯与克拉克率探险队沿河逆流经过这里。刘易斯看到船只前方的峭壁仿佛大门般渐渐打开，便为这条峡谷起了这个名字。

english: Binongko Island faces the tropical seas off Butung in Indonesia’s eastern archipelago. Indonesia comprises roughly thirteen to seventeen thousand islands between the Indian and Pacific oceans, and open water is the connective tissue of that world. Small craft and larger vessels link coasts where roads cannot, while sea and air transport remain the principal means of joining distant islands. For Binongko, currents, reefs, landing places and the seasonal safety of crossing the strait determine when people can reach markets, relatives and inland products. The wider area has long been part of maritime exchange. Regional networks connected Indonesia with South and East Asia from around 500 BCE, and the spice-producing islands of Maluku were already integrated into Asian trade before Portuguese and Dutch competition intensified in the early later period. Coastal communities dealt in goods carried across several seas, while inland groups supplied local products through ports and river routes. Binongko’s island setting therefore carries both isolation and connection: a small landfall in a wide tropical sea, dependent on boats, weather and the routes that bind scattered communities together.
simp_chinese:
比农科岛濒临印度尼西亚东部布顿外海。印尼由约一万三千至一万七千座岛屿组成，横亘于印度洋和太平洋之间，开阔水域因此成为全国联系的重要纽带。小船和较大船舶把没有道路相连的海岸接在一起，海运与空运仍是连接遥远岛屿的主要方式。对这座岛屿而言，海流、珊瑚礁、登陆点和横渡海峡的季节安全性，共同决定人们何时能够前往市场、探访亲友或取得内陆资源。

 周边海域早已进入海洋交换网络。大约公元前五世纪起，区域贸易越来越紧密地把群岛与南亚、东亚相连；早在葡萄牙和荷兰争夺贸易之前，马鲁古的香料便已通过亚洲海上网络流通。沿海社群经营跨海商品，内陆人口则借港口和河道输出本地物产。比农科岛因此兼具隔绝与联系：它是热带大海中的一处小型登陆地，生活依赖船只、天气以及把分散社群串接起来的海上路线。

english: Bintang stands beside a tidal creek connected to the lower Gambia River. Mangroves line the waterways, which link the settlement with the broad river and its Atlantic mouth. Portuguese traders established contact with communities along the Gambia from the fifteenth century, and Bintang became one of the places associated with their commerce. Local merchants and rulers remained central to exchange between the river settlements and visiting ships.
simp_chinese: 宾坦位于与冈比亚河下游相连的潮汐河汊旁。红树林沿水道生长，河汊将聚落与宽阔河流及其大西洋河口相连。十五世纪起，葡萄牙商人与冈比亚河沿岸社群建立联系，宾坦成为与这种贸易有关的地点之一。地方商人和统治者仍是河上聚落与来访船只之间交换的核心。

english: Biobio lies in Ngulumapu, the Mapuche country west of the Andes, in the valley of the Biobío River. Forests, valleys and river crossings shaped the lives and connections of Indigenous communities before Spanish expansion. After the Mapuche uprising beginning in 1598, Spanish settlements south of the Biobío were destroyed and the river became a major colonial frontier. At the parliament of Quilín in 1641, Spanish and Mapuche representatives agreed to a peace that recognised the river as the northern boundary of Mapuche territory. Warfare resumed at times, while later frontier relations also involved diplomacy, trade and missionary activity.
simp_chinese: 比奥比奥位于安第斯山脉以西的马普切地区恩古卢马普，地处比奥比奥河谷。西班牙势力扩张以前，森林、河谷和渡河地点已影响原住民社群的生活与联系。1598年开始的马普切起义后，比奥比奥河以南的西班牙聚落被摧毁，河流成为重要的殖民边界。1641年，西班牙与马普切代表在基林议会上达成和平，承认该河为马普切领地的北界。此后战争时有再起，边境关系也包括外交、贸易和传教活动。

english: Bir, also known as Beed, lies in the Deccan country south of the Godavari. Its Kankaleshwar temple stands within a tank, with carved stone shrines associated with the Yadava period. The town also became home to Muslim religious buildings and the tomb of the Chishti saint Shahinshah Wali. According to the local history Tarikh-i Bir, Muhammad bin Tughluq fortified the town and built wells here. In the early eighteenth century an Eidgah and a new settlement on the eastern heights added to the town’s fabric.
simp_chinese: 比尔又称比德，位于戈达瓦里河以南的德干地区。坎卡莱什瓦尔神庙坐落在水池中，雕刻精美的石殿与耶达瓦时期有关。城镇也有穆斯林宗教建筑，以及奇什蒂派圣人沙欣沙·瓦利之墓。地方史《比尔史》称，穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克曾在此修筑堡垒和水井。十八世纪初，城镇又增添了一座开斋节礼拜场以及东侧高地上的新聚落。

english: Bir al-Qurr lies in the rocky country southwest of Hala al-Badr, a volcanic cone in northwestern Arabia. The cone stands at the edge of Jabal Thadra, a table mountain of sandstone capped by basalt. Below it lies al-Jaww, a broad eroded basin between the lava fields of Harrat ar-Rahah and Harrat al-Uwayrid. Ancient lava spread across parts of this basin.
simp_chinese: 古尔井位于阿拉伯西北部哈拉巴德尔火山锥的西南方。火山锥耸立在萨德拉台地边缘；这座方山由砂岩构成，顶部覆盖玄武岩。山下的贾乌是广阔的侵蚀盆地，介于拉哈和乌韦里德两片熔岩地之间；古老熔岩曾流过盆地的一部分。

english: Bir belongs to the forested country of the upper Amur and its southern tributaries. Oroqen communities in the river valleys were known by names linked to the places where they lived; those along the rivers farther east were called Bilarchen. Hunting, fishing and gathering drew upon the forests and streams. In Qing times some Oroqen entered the Buteha banner organization, while others remained hunters required to supply sable pelts to officials sent to collect them.
simp_chinese: 毕喇尔属于黑龙江上游及南岸支流的森林地带。鄂伦春社群常以居住地区为名，东部沿江居民称毕拉千；他们在林间与溪流中狩猎、捕鱼和采集。清代部分鄂伦春人编入布特哈旗制，另有猎人仍在山林活动，向前来征收的官员交纳貂皮。

english:
Bir el Alter lies in the Aurès, the rugged mountain country of eastern Algeria whose ridges separate the northern Tell from the Sahara. Deep valleys, high plateaus and difficult passes concentrate settlement around springs and defensible sites. Sparse pasture supports sheep and goats, while grain and fruit grow in favored basins. Travel follows ridge routes and wadis rather than broad plains.

The region belonged to ancient Numidia, and Roman writers knew the range as Mons Aurasius. Byzantine Procopius described a mountain with abrupt outer slopes but fertile valleys within. Berber communities preserved their language and local institutions through Roman, Vandal, Byzantine and Arab rule. The Aurès became a refuge when plains were threatened, and authority remained tied to clans, villages and control of passes.

Bir el Alter belonged to this highland world of seasonal movement and fortified settlement. Families moved livestock between elevations, cultivated small terraces and stored grain for winter. Fortified houses and watch points overlooked routes toward Biskra, Batna and the desert edge. The scattered place remained important for its wells and pasture rather than monuments, while the mountains protected local customs and political autonomy.
simp_chinese:
比尔阿尔特位于阿尔及利亚东部崎岖的奥雷斯山地，山脊分隔北部泰勒与撒哈拉。深谷、高原和难行山口把聚落集中到泉水与易守地点附近。稀疏牧场供养绵羊和山羊，谷物、水果在条件较好的盆地生长。通行沿山脊和干河谷展开，而不是穿越宽阔平原。

奥雷斯属于古努米底亚，罗马作家称其为奥拉修斯山。拜占庭学者普罗科皮乌斯描述这里外侧陡峭、内部却有肥沃谷地。柏柏尔社群在罗马、汪达尔、拜占庭与阿拉伯统治更替中保存语言和地方制度。平原受到威胁时，山地成为避难处，权威则继续系于氏族、村庄和山口控制。

比尔阿尔特属于这种以季节迁徙和设防聚落构成的高地世界。家庭在不同海拔间移动牲畜，耕种小梯田并为冬季储粮。设防住宅和瞭望点监视通往比斯克拉、巴特纳及沙漠边缘的道路。聚落因水井与牧场而重要，却少有宏大建筑；群山则保护了地方习俗和政治自主。

english: Bi’r Fajr lies near Wadi Fajr in the desert east of Tabuk. The wadi descends from the mountains of al-Dahikiyah and al-Labdah toward the sands of Nufud al-Rushaydan. Its long course cuts through a region of rocky uplands, sandy tracts and shallow desert basins. Wadi Abu Ghada and the depression of Nuqrat al-Rushaydan lie nearby.
simp_chinese: 法杰尔井位于塔布克以东的荒漠，靠近法杰尔河谷。河谷从达希基亚山和拉布达山向鲁沙伊丹沙地延伸，漫长的水道穿过岩石高地、沙地和浅洼地。附近还有阿布加达河谷和鲁沙伊丹洼地。

english: Between the Basithah plain and Wadi Sirhan, the northern Arabian plateau forms a broad stretch of dry country. Basithah lies west of the valley and was known to medieval writers for its scarcity of water. Along the depression of Wadi Sirhan, scattered watering places and grazing lands have supported movement between the al-Jawf oases and the lands to the northwest.
simp_chinese: 巴西塔平原与锡尔汉谷之间，阿拉伯北部高原展开为广阔的干旱地带。巴西塔位于谷地以西，中世纪作者曾因其缺水而提及。沿锡尔汉洼地分布的水源与牧场，支撑着焦夫绿洲同西北方地区之间的往来。

english:
The Taymā' Corridor threads northern Arabia between the dunes of the Nafud and the approaches to the Red Sea and Hejaz. Travellers could avoid the deepest sand by following firm ground, shallow valleys and wells where water and pasture made stages possible. The oasis of Tayma supplied dates and grain, making it a practical goal and resting point for caravans crossing the surrounding desert.

Tayma was already an important oasis in the first millennium BCE. The Babylonian king Nabonidus established himself there for about a decade in the sixth century BCE, controlling Arabian trade and building works while his son ruled in Babylon. Inscriptions and monuments show that the town maintained links with Dadan, the Levant and Mesopotamia. Its prosperity depended on that junction between cultivated land and long-distance routes.

Later caravans carried incense, spices, metals and textiles along the same passages. The corridor was a bundle of tracks adapted to wind, water and seasonal grazing. Wells and oasis settlements imposed the rhythm of travel, and small armed groups could control movement through what appeared to be an empty expanse.
simp_chinese:
泰马走廊沿阿拉伯北部沙漠中的坚实地面前行，一侧是内夫得沙丘，另一侧通向红海与汉志方向。旅人避开最深的沙丘，沿浅谷、井泉和可放牧的地段分段通过。泰马绿洲出产椰枣和谷物，既是商队目的地，也是穿越荒原的补给站。

公元前一千纪，泰马已是重要绿洲。公元前六世纪，巴比伦国王那波尼德在此驻留约十年，一边控制阿拉伯贸易，一边营建工程，由其子留在巴比伦执政。铭文和遗迹显示，泰马同达丹、黎凡特与美索不达米亚保持往来，繁荣来自耕地与远途道路的交会。

后来，商队继续沿这些通道运送乳香、香料、金属和织物。走廊由多条根据风沙、水井和季节草场调整的路径组成。井泉与绿洲决定每日行程，小股武装也能控制看似空旷的区域。内夫得既是障碍，又通过泰马和北汉志把商旅引向可通行之处。

english: Bir ibn Hermas is a well north of Tabuk, in the arid interior of the northern Hejaz. Its fresh water provides a valuable stopping place in a landscape of dry plains and scattered hills. To the north lies Dhat al-Hajj, a station on the route by which the Syrian pilgrimage caravan travelled towards Tabuk, Medina and the holy city of Mecca.
simp_chinese: 伊本赫尔马斯井位于泰布克以北、汉志北部干旱的内陆。淡水使它成为干平原与零散丘陵之间珍贵的停驻地。北面的达特哈吉是叙利亚朝觐商队前往泰布克、麦地那和麦加圣城所经道路上的驿站。

english:
Bira lies in the Tunguska country of the lower Amur, within the wetland and grassland edge of historical Manchuria. The Amur lowlands hold deep fertile soils, while the Greater Khingan rises to the west.

At Bira, flat wet ground and grass make the seasonal contrast especially visible: winter freezes the landscape, and the warm monsoon brings heavy rain when river levels and access routes change quickly. Manchuria has long been a meeting place for Manchu, Mongol, Korean, Nanai, Nivkh, Ulch and other peoples. Its early economy combined hunting, fishing, livestock and agriculture, reflecting the different opportunities of forest, river and grassland.

The Qing dynasty organized the region through the Three Eastern Provinces, and its geography later attracted large migrations and competing imperial claims. Bira’s wheat potential sits within a livelihood system where wetland produce, grazing and river transport matter alongside cultivation.
simp_chinese:
比腊位于阿穆尔河下游的通古斯卡地区，处在历史意义上的满洲湿地与草地边缘。阿穆尔河低地拥有深厚肥沃的土壤，大兴安岭则矗立在西侧。

这里地势平坦而潮湿，草地广布，季节反差尤其鲜明：冬季冻结大地，温暖季风带来强降雨时，河水位和通行条件会迅速改变。满洲长期是满、蒙古、朝鲜、赫哲、尼夫赫、乌尔奇等民族交汇之地。早期经济兼有狩猎、捕鱼、畜牧和农耕，反映森林、河流与草原提供的不同机会。

清代以三东省体系组织这一地区，后来其地理又吸引大规模移民和大国竞争。比腊具备种植小麦的条件，但湿地资源、放牧与河运同样进入生计体系。

english:
Bīr ‘Alī, “Ali’s Well,” lies on the arid coast of Shabwah in eastern Yemen. Its sheltered landing faced the Indian Ocean, while wells and caravan tracks behind the beach made it a useful junction between sea and inland South Arabia. The older port was called Qanīʾ, known through inscriptions and the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea as a place where Indian and African goods entered Arabian trade.

Spices, aromatics and other luxuries moved inland by camel toward the towns of the south. Ships brought wine and manufactured goods from the Mediterranean world, carried over Egypt’s eastern desert to Red Sea ports before crossing to Arabia. Underwater finds include first-century amphorae inscribed in Palmyrene and Syriac, traces of merchants from distant communities using the shore.

A Greek inscription has been linked to an early synagogue, although its exact function remains debated. The surrounding desert supplied few products of its own; Qanīʾ prospered because it combined water, anchorage and access to caravan routes. By concentrating exchange at one exposed coast, the port tied South Arabia to a much larger maritime world without becoming a large agricultural city.
simp_chinese:
比拉里，阿拉伯语意为“阿里之井”，位于也门东部舍卜沃的干旱海岸。受遮蔽的登陆点面向印度洋，海滩后的井泉与商队道路又把它同南阿拉伯内陆连接起来。古港名为卡尼，铭文和《红海航行记》都记载它是印度、东非货物进入阿拉伯贸易网络的门户。

香料、芳香树脂和其他贵重品由骆驼运往南方城镇。船只则载来地中海世界的葡萄酒与制成品，这些货物先经埃及东部沙漠转往红海港口，再渡海抵达阿拉比亚。水下发现包括公元一世纪陶瓮，瓮上刻有巴尔米拉字母和叙利亚文字，显示远方商人在此经营。

一处希腊铭文建筑曾被解释为早期犹太会堂，用途仍有争议。周围荒漠物产有限，卡尼的繁荣依靠水井、锚地与商队路线的结合。货物集中在这段海岸，使南阿拉伯进入更广阔的海上世界，却没有把港口变成以农业为基础的大城。

english: Biram is remembered as one of the seven Hausa states of origin. In the story of Bayajidda, its ruler descends from the hero and a princess of Bornu, linking this eastern kingdom with both Hausa and Kanuri traditions. The name is associated with the country around Hadejia, where several older small kingdoms existed before the emirate arose. One local account identifies Biram with Garun Gabas, an influential old town whose rulers, according to tradition, held their titles under the Mai of Bornu. These accounts preserve the memory of a frontier between distinct political worlds.
simp_chinese: 比拉姆被视为豪萨传统中的七个原初国家之一。在巴亚吉达的传说中，这个东部王国的统治者是英雄与一位博尔努公主的后代，因而与豪萨及卡努里传统都有关联。比拉姆之名与哈代贾周边地区相连；在埃米尔国兴起之前，这里已有数个小王国。一种地方记载将比拉姆认作古城加伦加巴斯，传说其统治者在博尔努君主之下取得称号。这些说法保存了不同政治世界交界处的历史记忆。

english: Birampur lies in the plains of northern Bengal, in a country shaped by the river systems of Dinajpur. Archaeological remains in and around Birampur belong to a landscape of old settlements in the Jamuna and Karatoya basin. Nearby, at Sitakot, the remains of a Buddhist monastery recall the religious communities that flourished in this part of Bengal under the Pala rulers.
simp_chinese: 比拉姆布尔位于孟加拉北部平原，地处受迪纳杰布尔河流系统塑造的土地。比拉姆布尔一带的古迹属于贾木纳河与卡拉托亚河流域古老聚落的一部分。附近的锡塔科特留有佛教寺院遗址，令人想起波罗王朝统治时在这一带兴盛的宗教社群。

english:
Birao lies in the far north of the Central African Republic, near the borders with Chad and Sudan, on the rim of the Vakaga country. The land here turns from wooded hills and valleys toward dry savanna. Rain falls mostly between May and September, and the dry months leave the ground open to the wind. Wild game ranged through the bush, and the roads that linked this northern country to the Sahel were tracks used by herders and traders.

Before the nineteenth century the region lay outside the great states of the north and the forest kingdoms of the south. Its villages were small, scattered across the grassland and along seasonal watercourses. From the early nineteenth century, slave raiders from the Sudanese and Wadai states pushed into the Vakaga, carrying away many of its people and leaving the settlements thin. The distance from any centre of power made the region a frontier in every sense.
simp_chinese:
比劳位于中非共和国最北端，靠近乍得和苏丹边界，处在瓦卡加地区的边缘。这里的地貌由林地丘陵和河谷逐渐转为干燥的草原。降雨多集中于五月至九月，旱季时地面裸露，风沙较大。灌丛中有野生动物活动，连接北方与萨赫勒的道路，是牧人和商贩走出来的小径。

十九世纪以前，这片土地位于北方大国与南方森林王国之外。村落规模较小，散布在草原上和季节性河道旁。十九世纪初起，苏丹和瓦代国家的奴隶袭掠者深入瓦卡加，带走大量居民，使聚落变得稀疏。远离任何权力中心，使这里成为名副其实的边疆。

english: Denduu, or Birch Creek, flows from the ridges of interior Alaska into the broad Yukon Flats. Its watershed is the country of the Dendoo Gwich’in, the Birch Creek people. Rivers, wooded valleys and uplands formed part of a seasonal round of fishing and hunting, with families moving between places as animals and fish became available. The creek joins the Yukon in a landscape of wetlands and branching waterways.
simp_chinese: 登杜，即桦树溪，从阿拉斯加内陆山脊流向宽广的育空平原。其流域是登杜哥威迅人，即桦树溪人的土地。河流、森林谷地和高地构成季节性捕鱼与狩猎活动的场所，各家庭随着鱼类和猎物的出现而在不同地点之间迁徙。溪流在湿地与分岔水道交织的平原汇入育空河。

english: The Birch Mountains rise above the Athabasca lowlands as a broad, wooded northern upland. Their rolling heights contain many lakes, including Namur and Legend, as well as extensive bogs and peatlands. Spruce and pine forests cover the higher ground, while wet hollows lie among the slopes. Ospreys and bald eagles nest near the lakes, whose waters shelter whitefish, lake trout and Arctic grayling. From this upland, the Mikkwa River flows towards the Peace.
simp_chinese: 桦木山脉高出阿萨巴斯卡低地，是一片广阔的北方森林高地。起伏的地面上有纳穆尔湖、莱金德湖等众多湖泊，以及广阔的泥沼和泥炭地。云杉林与松林覆盖高处，山坡之间散布湿润洼地。鱼鹰和白头海雕在湖边筑巢，水中则有白鲑、湖红点鲑和北极茴鱼。米夸河从这片高地流向和平河。

english: Hochandochtla is a mountain in the highlands between the Yukon and Koyukuk rivers, near the headwaters of the Dulbi River. Its name was recorded from Koyukon speakers, whose homeland extends across this interior river country. The Dulbi flows northwest toward the Koyukuk, through hills and lowlands that form part of a much larger network of waterways. Spruce forest, rivers and seasonal hunting grounds characterize the country around the mountain, connecting the Yukon valley with the lands farther north.
simp_chinese: 霍昌多赫特拉是一座山，位于育空河与科尤库克河之间的高地，靠近杜尔比河源头。它的名称记录自科尤孔语使用者，这片内陆河流地区属于他们的家园。杜尔比河向西北流向科尤库克河，穿行于丘陵和低地之间，成为更广大水道网络的一部分。云杉林、河流和季节性猎场构成山地周围的景观，将育空河谷与北方的土地相连。

english:
Birecik stands on the Euphrates beneath a castle overlooking the river, at a meeting point of overland routes and river transport. Its walls and gates bear witness to its importance as a fortified town; two gates were built under the Mamluk sultan Qaytbay in the late fifteenth century. Goods arriving by caravan could be transferred here to boats bound down the Euphrates, tying the markets of northern Syria to Mesopotamia.

The Ottomans took Birecik in 1516 and made it the centre of a sancak. In the sixteenth century they established a shipyard here, supplying a river fleet that carried troops, provisions and military equipment as well as commercial cargo. Lightly armed vessels worked with the fortresses along the eastern frontier, while another Ottoman shipyard operated at Basra at the southern end of the river system. Timber, weapons and other supplies were stored at Birecik for shipment downstream, making the town an indispensable staging point for expeditions into Iraq.

The yard drew workers from other districts, and the river remained essential to local trade. Merchants also used rafts supported by inflated skins, known as keleks, for the downstream journey. Birecik's value came from both its strong position at a crossing and its ability to turn the Euphrates into a route for goods and armies.
simp_chinese:
比雷吉克位于幼发拉底河畔，城堡俯瞰河流，陆路与水运在此交汇。城墙和城门见证了这座设防城镇的重要地位；其中两座城门建于十五世纪末马穆鲁克苏丹盖特贝时期。商队运来的货物可在此转上船只，顺幼发拉底河而下，将叙利亚北部的市场与美索不达米亚连接起来。

奥斯曼人于一五一六年占领比雷吉克，并将其设为桑贾克中心。十六世纪，他们在此建立造船厂，为河上舰队提供船只，运送军队、粮秣、军需和商货。配备轻型火炮的船只与东部边疆的堡垒协同作战；奥斯曼人还在河系南端的巴士拉设有造船厂。木材、武器等物资在比雷吉克储存，再向下游输送，使这座城镇成为向伊拉克出兵的重要中转站。

船厂吸引了其他地区的工匠和劳工，河流也始终是地方贸易的重要通道。商人还使用以充气兽皮支撑的筏子，称为凯莱克，顺流而下。比雷吉克的价值既在于控制渡河地点，也在于借幼发拉底河运送货物和军队。

english:
Birgi lies on the slopes above the Küçük Menderes valley in western Anatolia. It was the first capital of the Aydınid principality, whose rulers left mosques, tombs and schools among its narrow streets. The great mosque, completed in 1312 by the dynasty's founder Mehmed Bey, combines stonework with a richly decorated mihrab and carved wooden pulpit.

Under the Aydınids, Birgi was a centre of political and religious patronage. Mehmed Bey's tomb stands near the mosque, and later generations added a bath and a school associated with the scholar Birgivi. The town remained inhabited after the principality passed into Ottoman hands. In the eighteenth century a leather merchant built the Çakırağa mansion, whose painted interiors and timber construction show the prosperity of a later household. These buildings preserve the changing character of a town that had once governed a much wider region.
simp_chinese:
比尔吉位于安纳托利亚西部小门德雷斯河谷上方的山坡，是艾登王朝公国的首个首都。统治者在狭窄街道之间留下清真寺、陵墓和学校。王朝创立者穆罕默德贝伊兴建的大清真寺于1312年竣工，石造建筑内有装饰精美的米赫拉布和雕刻木讲坛。

艾登王朝时期，比尔吉是政治与宗教赞助中心。穆罕默德贝伊之墓位于清真寺附近，后世又增建浴场和与学者比尔吉维有关的学校。公国转入奥斯曼统治后，城镇仍有人居住。十八世纪，一位皮革商建造恰克勒阿宅邸，其彩绘室内和木构展示了后世家庭的富裕。这些建筑保存了曾经统治广阔地区的城镇不断变化的面貌。

english: Biria, or Birri country, lies in the inland river country of north Queensland. The Bowen River runs north to meet the Burdekin, while the Clarke Range rises toward the east. Birri is also recorded under names including Birigaba and Perembba, reflecting the varied spellings used for the people and their language.
simp_chinese: 比里亚又称比里，是昆士兰北部的内陆河流地区。鲍恩河向北流入伯德金河，东边则耸立着克拉克山脉。比里人也被记作比里加巴和佩伦巴等名称，反映了这一人群及其语言名称的不同拼写。

english: Biripi country extends across the rivers and coast of the mid-north coast of eastern Australia, between the Hastings and Manning rivers. The Biripi are neighbors of the Dunghutti to the north and the Worimi to the south. Rivers, estuaries and the forested hinterland form part of their ancestral country.
simp_chinese: 比里皮人的土地位于澳大利亚东部中北海岸，横跨黑斯廷斯河与曼宁河之间的河流及海岸。他们北邻丹加蒂人，南邻沃里米人。河流、河口和森林覆盖的内陆都是其祖传土地的一部分。

english: Biriri lies in the dry plains of Bornu, in the country around Babban Gida. Sandy ground and sparse vegetation mark this part of the southern Sahel. The wider region belonged to the political world of Kanem-Bornu, whose rulers held court at Ngazargamu to the northeast. Their authority extended westward toward the Hausa lands, where Bornu's officials and neighbouring chiefs shared a changing frontier.
simp_chinese: 比里里位于博尔努干燥的平原上，在巴班吉达一带。沙地和稀疏植被是萨赫勒南部这一地区的特征。更广阔的土地属于加涅姆—博尔努的政治世界，统治者在东北面的恩加扎尔加穆设立宫廷。其权力向西延伸至豪萨地区，博尔努官员与邻近首领在不断变化的边疆相互接触。

english:
Birjand stands on low hills in the dry uplands of Quhistan, divided by the bed of the seasonal Shahrud. Two forts guarded the town, one on high ground to the south and another on the lower northern side. Gardens and fields lay around it, producing saffron, grain and fruit. The poet Nizari Quhistani, who died in 1321, and the astronomer Abd al-Ali Birjandi were among the scholars associated with the town.

The thirteenth-century geographer Yaqut named Birjand among the chief places of Quhistan. In the following century Hamdallah Mustawfi described a local centre surrounded by villages growing grapes and other fruits, with saffron as a notable crop. In 1732 Nader Shah appointed a member of the Khuzayma family governor of Qayenat, beginning the long association of the Alam family with Birjand and its district. His descendants faced conflicts with Afghan neighbours and local rulers of Sistan and Baluchistan.
simp_chinese:
比尔詹德坐落在库希斯坦干燥高地的低丘上，季节性沙赫鲁德河床穿过城镇。两座城堡守护着它，一座位于南面高地，另一座坐落在北面的低地。周围花园和田地出产藏红花、谷物与水果。1321年去世的诗人尼扎里·库希斯塔尼和天文学家阿卜杜勒阿里·比尔詹迪，都与这座城镇有关。

十三世纪地理学家雅库特将比尔詹德列为库希斯坦的主要地点之一。次世纪，哈姆达拉·穆斯陶菲描述了这座地方中心，周围村庄种植葡萄等水果，藏红花也是著名作物。1732年，纳迪尔沙阿任命胡扎伊马家族成员为加延纳特总督，开启阿拉姆家族与比尔詹德及其地区的长期联系。他的后代与阿富汗邻邦及锡斯坦、俾路支斯坦的地方统治者发生冲突。

english: Birkala, known in Finnish as Pirkkala, lies by the waters of Lake Pyhäjärvi in inland southwestern Finland. Its old parish embraced a much larger area than the settlement itself, including districts that later formed separate communities. Pirkkala was recorded in the fourteenth century, though its parish organisation and an early wooden church probably reached back into the preceding century.
