simp_chinese: 比尔卡拉的芬兰语名为皮尔卡拉，位于芬兰西南内陆的皮海耶尔维湖畔。古老的教区范围远大于聚落本身，包括后来形成独立社区的地区。皮尔卡拉见于14世纪的文献，但教区组织及早期木教堂可能可追溯到前一个世纪。

english:
Birkenfeld lies in the Hunsrück country near the Nahe. Its name, meaning a field of birches, appears in a document of 981. By the thirteenth century it belonged to the counts of Sponheim; its castle was recorded in 1293, and Emperor Louis the Bavarian granted town rights in 1332.

After the Sponheim line ended in 1437, its lands passed to the margraves of Baden and the counts of Veldenz. From 1584 Count Palatine Charles of Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld made the town his residence and began rebuilding the castle as a Renaissance palace. War and plague struck in 1635, when the epidemic alone claimed 416 lives. Birkenfeld later became a Baden administrative seat, then passed under French rule. In 1817 its territory was assigned to Oldenburg, whose rulers built a new residence here in 1821.
simp_chinese:
比肯费尔德位于纳厄河附近的洪斯吕克地区，地名意为「白桦树旁的田地」，见于981年的文献。十三世纪时，此地属于施蓬海姆伯爵；城堡于1293年见诸记载，皇帝巴伐利亚的路易于1332年授予城市权。

1437年施蓬海姆家族绝嗣，其领地归于巴登边境伯和费尔登茨伯爵。自1584年起，茨魏布吕肯—比肯费尔德的普法尔茨伯爵卡尔将城镇作为驻地，并开始把城堡改建为文艺复兴式宫殿。1635年，战争与瘟疫袭来，仅瘟疫便夺走416人的生命。比肯费尔德后来成为巴登的行政中心，随后归法国统治。1817年，该地区被分给奥尔登堡，统治者于1821年在此建造新宫邸。

english:
Birma belongs to the lower Zeya country, where that river enters the Amur basin in the forested far east of the Eurasian landmass. In broad historical usage, Manchuria extended beyond Northeast China into the Amur drainage and parts of the Russian Far East. The term itself varied in meaning, but the river system provides a useful geographical frame: tributaries such as the Zeya join the Amur across territory where forests, wetlands and frozen winters long dictated routes of travel.

The lower Zeya consequently belongs to a corridor linking inland Siberia with the Amur and the coast. Tungusic-speaking peoples formed a major part of the region's social world, while Manchus, Mongols, Koreans, Nanai, Nivkhs and Ulchs also inhabited lands understood as part of greater Manchuria.

Birma therefore sits where the natural geography of a tributary valley meets a much larger history of movement and imperial boundary-making. The lower Zeya remains a meeting point for communities adapted to cold forests and waterways.
simp_chinese:
比尔马位于下结雅地区，结雅河在这里汇入阿穆尔河流域，周围是欧亚大陆远东的森林地带。广义历史上的满洲不但包括中国东北，也延伸至阿穆尔河流域以及俄罗斯远东的一部分。这个称谓的范围曾不断变化，河流系统则提供了较清楚的地理框架：结雅河等支流穿过森林、湿地和严冬覆盖的土地，最终汇入阿穆尔河。

下结雅因此属于连接西伯利亚内陆、阿穆尔河与海岸的通道。通古斯语人群构成区域社会的重要部分，满洲人、蒙古人、朝鲜人、那乃人、尼夫赫人和乌尔奇人等也生活在广义满洲的范围内。

比尔马所在之处，正处在支流谷地的自然地理与更大的迁徙、边疆划界历史交会之地。下结雅仍是适应寒冷森林与水道的社群交汇之处。

english:
Birmingham grew from a Midlands market town into a centre of metalworking and manufacture. Its workshops made a remarkable variety of small metal goods, from buttons, buckles and watch chains to tools and fittings. Skilled masters and workers supplied markets far beyond the town, giving Birmingham a reputation for ingenuity and trade.

In the eighteenth century Matthew Boulton established the Soho Manufactory west of the town, bringing hundreds of workers together to produce metal goods for domestic and overseas buyers. His partnership with James Watt also helped develop and manufacture improved steam engines. Birmingham's manufacturers, inventors and thinkers exchanged ideas in circles such as the well-known Birmingham Lunar Society, linking practical industry with the intellectual currents of the eighteenth-century age.
simp_chinese:
伯明翰从英格兰中部的集镇发展为金属加工和制造业中心。作坊生产种类繁多的小型金属制品，从纽扣、带扣到工具和配件不一而足。熟练的师傅与工人向远方市场供货，使伯明翰以技艺和贸易闻名。

十八世纪，马修·博尔顿在镇西建立苏豪工场，集中众多工人生产金属制品。他与詹姆斯·瓦特合作，也帮助开发和制造蒸汽机。伯明翰的制造商、发明家和思想家在月光社等圈子交流思想，将实际工业与时代的学术思潮联系起来。

english: Bindal lies at the southern end of Helgeland, where fjords reach into a country of wooded hills and mountains. Vassås was an old church site in the district: a priest there is recorded in 1432, and by 1589 its church was attached to the parish of Brønnøy. A description from 1723 records Sámi from the Bindal mountains gathering at Vassås in summer. The old church was replaced by an octagonal timber building in 1733.
simp_chinese: 宾达尔位于海尔格兰南端，峡湾深入森林覆盖的丘陵与山地。瓦索斯是当地一处古老的教会所在地：1432年有此地牧师的记载，到1589年，其教堂隶属于布伦讷于堂区。1723年的一份记述提到，宾达尔山区的萨米人夏季在瓦索斯聚集。旧教堂于1733年由一座八角形木结构建筑取代。

english:
Birni Ader was a fortified centre of Adar, a Sahelian country southwest of the Aïr Mountains. The old settlement at Sakola became the seat of rulers known as the Sarkin Adar, or king of Adar. Its history brings together older local communities and dynasties whose authority reached into the region from neighbouring lands.

Before the rise of the Sakola dynasty, Adar had come under the influence of Kebbi. Rulers connected with Agadez subsequently established themselves at Birni Adar, where a fortified residence gave the dynasty a centre of power. In the early nineteenth century the region was drawn into the upheavals associated with the jihad and the expansion of Sokoto, transforming the political world in which the Sarkin Adar had ruled.
simp_chinese:
比尔尼阿代尔是阿代尔的一处设防中心。这片萨赫勒地区位于阿伊尔山脉西南，萨科拉的古老聚落曾是称为“萨尔金·阿代尔”的统治者的治所。当地历史既属于更早定居于此的社群，也与从邻近地区进入阿代尔的王朝息息相关。

萨科拉王朝兴起之前，阿代尔曾受到凯比的影响。后来，与阿加德兹有关的统治者在比尔尼阿代尔立足，并以设防居所作为权力中心。十九世纪初，圣战和索科托势力的扩张使这一地区卷入动荡，改变了萨尔金·阿代尔统治所依存的政治格局。

english:
Birnin Lalle was a capital of Gobir, one of the seven original Hausa kingdoms. Pressed by the Tuareg, who had founded the sultanate of Agadez in the Aïr early in the fifteenth century, the Gobirawa moved south, first to Maigali and then to Goran Rami, and in the early eighteenth century they made Birnin Lalle their capital. Leo Africanus described Gobir as a land of herdsmen's villages whose many artisans and linen weavers sent textiles and shoes as far as Timbuktu and Gao through Wangara traders.

Around 1715 Gobir joined Agadez to help Zamfara win its revolt against Kebbi. The sarkin Soba later laid siege to Zabarma for three years and carried his raids as far as Ilorin, and in the mid-eighteenth century his seven-year siege of Maradi left Goran Rami open to an Agadez attack. His successor Babari, who reigned from 1742 to 1770, raided Katsina, Kano and Shirra and ravaged Birnin Zamfara around 1756, then built a new walled capital, Alkalawa, on the Gulbin Rima. The Gobir of the early nineteenth century is remembered above all as the chief opponent of Usman dan Fodio.
simp_chinese:
比尔尼拉莱是戈比尔的都城之一，戈比尔是豪萨七个原初王国之一。图阿雷格人在15世纪初于艾尔山区建立了阿加德兹苏丹国，戈比尔人受其压迫南迁，先到迈加利，又到戈兰拉米，18世纪初把比尔尼拉莱定为都城。利奥·阿非利加努斯描述戈比尔是牧人村落之地，大量工匠和亚麻织工通过旺加拉商人，把纺织品和鞋子运往远至廷巴克图与加奥的地方。

约1715年，戈比尔与阿加德兹联手帮助赞法拉反抗凯比取得成功。后来的国王索巴围攻扎布尔马三年，并把劫掠推进到伊洛林；18世纪中叶，他对马拉迪长达七年的围困，使戈兰拉米遭到阿加德兹进攻。继任的巴巴里（1742至1770年在位）袭击卡齐纳、卡诺和希拉，约1756年洗劫了赞法拉的比尔尼扎姆法拉，随后在古尔宾里马河畔建起新的城墙都城阿尔卡拉瓦。19世纪初的戈比尔，最为人记住的是作为乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥的主要对手。

english: Birni-N'Konni, the walled town of Konni, stands west of the seasonal Maggia River in the northern reaches of Hausaland. It was the centre of a small Hausa state whose lands lay among the larger kingdoms of the savanna. Its position on routes through southern Niger connected it with other Hausa communities, while traditional granaries reflect the importance of the surrounding agricultural country. Around 1750 Konni came under the power of Gobir. Early in the nineteenth century forces of the Sokoto Caliphate overran and sacked it, another episode in the struggles that reshaped the Hausa states.
simp_chinese: 比尔尼恩孔尼意为孔尼的城墙之城，位于季节性河流马贾河以西，处在豪萨兰北部。它曾是一个小型豪萨国家的中心，周围是草原上更强大的诸王国。穿越尼日尔南部的道路将它与其他豪萨社群相连，传统粮仓则反映了周围农业乡野的重要性。约1750年，孔尼落入戈比尔的势力范围。十九世纪初，索科托哈里发国的军队攻占并洗劫了这里，豪萨诸国的政治格局也随之改变。

english: Birnin Gwari was a kingdom on the southwestern margins of Hausaland, in a region inhabited by Gwari and Kamuku communities. Its position placed it among a number of smaller states bordering Katsina and Zazzau. By the late eighteenth century Birnin Gwari was among the polities dependent on Katsina, whose people had migrated into the area. Around 1800, under a ruler remembered as Gwarin Waiki, much of the eastern Kamuku country came within the kingdom. The histories of these neighbouring peoples remained closely intertwined.
simp_chinese: 比尔宁格瓦里是豪萨兰西南边缘的一个王国，所在地区居住着格瓦里人和卡穆库人。它与若干小国一起，分布在卡齐纳和扎造的边缘。十八世纪末，比尔宁格瓦里已成为依附卡齐纳的政权之一，而卡齐纳人也曾迁入这一带。约1800年，在一位被记作格瓦林·瓦伊基的统治者治下，东部卡穆库地区的大部分土地被纳入王国。相邻族群的历史因此紧密交织。

english:
Birnin Kebbi stood beside the Sokoto River in the lower Rima valley, in the western reach of Hausaland. Its name means the walled town of Kebbi, and it was one of the fortified towns that Kanta Kotal drew together from scattered villages after Kebbi broke from Songhai in 1516–1517, serving as his base against Songhai's armies. Under Kanta and his successor Muhammad Kanta, Kebbi grew from a rebel province into a power that beat the army of Askia Muhammad Bunkan, took Agadez and exacted tribute from much of Hausaland, while Surame, with its great stone-and-earth walls, served as the royal capital.

After Kanta's death in 1556 the Hausa states stopped paying tribute, and by the early eighteenth century Gobir and Zamfara had thrown off Kebbi's rule. Birnin Kebbi nonetheless remained a seat of the Kebbi kings until the jihad of Usman dan Fodio, when his brother Abdullahi dan Fodio drove out the sarki, Muhammadu Hodi, and placed the country under the emirate of Gwandu. The Kebbawa went on fighting, first from the Zamfara valley and then from Argungu, which Karari made the kingdom's new seat. Silt and the shift of power to Gwandu and to Jega, at the head of navigation, left Birnin Kebbi a lesser river town.
simp_chinese:
比尔宁凯比位于索科托河畔，处在里马河下游谷地，是豪萨兰西部边缘的一座城镇。比尔宁意为设防城镇。1516至1517年凯比脱离桑海之后，坎塔·科塔尔把零散的村落合并成若干设防城镇，比尔宁凯比便是其中之一，成为他抵御桑海的基地。在坎塔及其继任者穆罕默德·坎塔治下，凯比由一个叛离的行省成长为强国：它击败桑海阿斯基亚穆罕默德·本坎的军队，夺取阿加德兹，向豪萨兰大部分地区征收贡赋，而以雄伟城墙闻名的苏拉梅则是王都。

1556年坎塔去世后，豪萨诸国不再纳贡，到18世纪初，戈比尔和扎姆法拉也摆脱了凯比的统治。比尔宁凯比仍是凯比国王的驻地之一，直到奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥的圣战爆发，他的兄弟阿卜杜拉希·丹·福迪奥驱逐国王穆罕默杜·霍迪，把这片土地划入关杜酋长国。凯比人继续抵抗，先在扎姆法拉河谷，后在阿尔贡古，卡拉里把那里建成王国新的驻地。淤积以及权力转向关杜和航运终点杰加，使比尔宁凯比降为一座次要的河镇。

english: Birnin Kudu stands among rocky hills in the country southeast of Kano. Shelters in its rocks contain paintings of cattle, including long-horned and short-horned animals, as well as other figures and signs. At Dutsen Mesa, painted images overlap in different colours, while stones that ring when struck are found within a shelter. The age of the paintings is uncertain, but they preserve evidence of an older world of cattle keeping in northern Nigeria. These images make the shelters a remarkable record of the people who once lived among the hills.
simp_chinese: 比尔宁库杜坐落在卡诺东南方的岩石山地间。岩棚中留有牛的画像，包括长角和短角的品种，另有其他图形与符号。杜岑梅萨的不同颜色画像互相覆盖，岩棚内还有敲击时能够发出响声的石头。壁画的年代尚不确定，但它们保存了尼日利亚北部古老养牛生活的痕迹。这些图像记录了曾经生活在群山之间的人们。

english:
Birnin Zamfara was the walled capital of the Hausa kingdom of Zamfara, built by its rulers a few miles north of Dutsi near the Gagare River. Tradition gives its wall a length of eleven miles with fifty gates, and the remains can still be traced east of Isa. The country around it was among the most fertile in Hausaland, which Heinrich Barth called almost the most flourishing in Negroland.

Around 1715, under Babba, Zamfara joined Gobir and Agadez in a revolt that drove back Kebbi and captured its king, and the victory made it a power of the first rank. Gobir settlers, welcomed as warriors, then turned on their hosts. Babari of Gobir attacked Zamfara despite having a sister married to its king Mairoki, and the army captains, tired of his taunts after each battle, abandoned the capital. Barth was told it fell about 1756; other accounts say 1762. Mairoki fled to the hill fort of Kiawa, where Bawa Jan Gwarzo besieged him, and Babari built his own capital at Alkalawa.
simp_chinese:
比尔宁扎姆法拉是豪萨人扎姆法拉王国的城墙都城，由王室在杜齐以北几英里、加加雷河附近建成。传说城墙长十一英里，设五十座城门，遗迹至今可在伊萨以东找到。周围的土地是豪萨兰最肥沃的一带，海因里希·巴特称之为黑人地区几乎最繁荣的国度。

约1715年，在巴巴统治期间，扎姆法拉与戈比尔、阿加德兹联手起义，击退凯比并俘虏了凯比国王，这一胜利使它跻身一流强国。作为武士受到欢迎的戈比尔移民随后反过来对付东道主。戈比尔的巴巴里不顾自己的姐妹嫁给了扎姆法拉国王迈罗基，仍然进攻扎姆法拉；军队将领们厌倦了国王每次战后的讥讽，撤出都城。巴特听说都城约在1756年陷落，另一些说法是1762年。迈罗基逃往基亚瓦山寨，后来巴瓦·扬·瓜尔佐在那里围困了他，巴巴里则另建都城阿尔卡拉瓦。

english: Birpara lies in the Dooars, the alluvial floodplain that runs along the foot of the Himalayas between the Teesta and the Dhansiri rivers, close to the Bhutanese border. Rivers come down from the Himalayan foothills across the low, forested ground, and the Dooars formed the gateway between the hills and the plains. The Dooars belonged to the Kamata kingdom under the Koch dynasty and served as a trade route between Assam and Bhutan. Goods such as woollen cloth, rock salt, musk and ponies came south from Bhutan, while Assamese silk and cloth went north. In the later eighteenth century Bhutan took control of much of the Dooars and administered it through officials called subahs, who answered to Bhutan's provincial governors.
simp_chinese: 比尔帕拉位于杜阿尔（Dooars）低地，这一冲积平原沿喜马拉雅山麓南侧延伸，西起蒂斯塔河，东抵丹西里河，与不丹边界相邻。山麓河流穿过低缓林地，杜阿尔因而成为山地与平原之间的门户。杜阿尔曾属于科赫王朝治下的卡马塔王国，是阿萨姆与不丹之间的贸易通道。毛织布、岩盐、麝香与小马自不丹南下，阿萨姆的丝绸与布匹则北运。十八世纪后期，不丹控制了杜阿尔的大部分地区，通过称为苏巴（subah）的官员加以治理，这些官员听命于不丹的地方总督。

english: Biru lies in the eastern part of Nagchu, a highland district of pasture, woodland and cultivated valleys. Bon and Tibetan Buddhist monasteries both formed part of its religious landscape. Among the Bon foundations was Sentsa, where around 1440 Kunga Wangden of the Dru family built a temple at the foot of a mountain considered auspicious. In 1732 Biru came under the direct authority of the Qing representatives stationed in Tibet. The area's monasteries continued to connect local patrons and religious teachers with the wider Bon tradition, while the mountain valleys sustained communities of herders and farmers.
simp_chinese: 比如位于那曲东部高地，牧场、林地与耕作河谷相间，苯教和藏传佛教寺院共同构成当地宗教景观。苯教森擦寺是其中之一；约1440年，朱氏家族的贡嘎旺丹在一处被认为吉祥的山麓建造殿宇。1732年，比如置于清朝驻藏官员直接管辖之下。当地寺院继续将施主和宗教师徒与更广阔的苯教传统相联系，山谷则维系着牧民与农户的生活。

english: Birugarh was the seat of the Biru chiefship in the forested country of the Chotanagpur plateau. Kharia traditions remember a kingdom centred here, and the name Biru itself is associated with a Kharia word for mountain. Near the settlement are the remains of the Satdharwa fort, attributed in local memory to Kharia ancestors. The surrounding uplands formed a landscape of villages and local chiefs alongside the larger domains of the Nagvanshi rulers.
simp_chinese: 比鲁加尔是乔塔纳格浦尔高原森林地区比鲁领地的驻地。卡里亚人的传统记得一个以此为中心的王国，而比鲁的名称与卡里亚语中的“山”相联系。聚落附近有萨特达尔瓦堡的遗迹，地方记忆将其归于卡里亚人的祖先。这片高地由村庄和地方首领的领地构成，与那格王朝统治者较大的领土相邻。

english: Biryuk Forest lies in the Upper Lena country of Eastern Siberia, where the Lena and its tributaries cut through boreal forest and interior plateau. Russian fur hunters led by Demid Pyanda sailed up the Lena in the 1620s and explored much of its course; the fort at Yakutsk was founded in 1632. The forest and river country here was used by Evenki hunters, who moved through the valleys with the seasons and paid their tribute in furs.
simp_chinese: 比留克森林位于东西伯利亚的上勒拿地区，勒拿河及其支流穿过寒带针叶林与内陆高原。1620年代，俄国皮毛猎人迪米德·皮安达率队沿勒拿河溯流，探查了大部分河段；雅库茨克堡于1632年建立。森林与河谷中的埃文基猎人随季节迁移，以毛皮缴纳贡赋。

english: The Biryusa rises on the northern slopes of the eastern Sayan Mountains and flows through the forested country of southern Siberia. Farther north it turns northwest and joins the Chuna, forming the Taseyeva, which in turn reaches the Angara. From mountain headwaters to the broad taiga, the river belongs to the extensive Yenisei drainage system, carrying water across a landscape of forest and long winters.
simp_chinese: 比留萨河发源于东萨彦岭北坡，流经西伯利亚南部的森林。河水向北后转向西北，与丘纳河汇合形成塔谢耶瓦河，后者再流入安加拉河。从山地源头到广阔泰加林，这条河属于庞大的叶尼塞河流域，穿行在森林覆盖、冬季漫长的土地上。

english:
Biržai lies in northern Lithuania near the Agluona and Apaščia rivers. The town first appears in writing in 1455, but its distinctive form emerged during the late sixteenth century. Around 1575 a dam at the two rivers' confluence created Lake Širvėna, intended to protect the castle from the north and regarded as Lithuania's oldest known artificial lake.

Work on Biržai Castle began in 1586, and Magdeburg rights followed in 1589. The Radziwiłł family made the town a centre of the Protestant Reformation, supporting a church and school. A Jewish community settled in the duchy at the end of the sixteenth century, while Lipka Tatars served the family. During the Swedish wars the castle was attacked and rebuilt; it was destroyed again in 1704 and remained in ruins for centuries.
simp_chinese:
比尔扎伊位于立陶宛北部的阿格卢奥纳河和阿帕什恰河附近。城镇最早见于1455年的文字记录，但它独特的形态形成于16世纪后期。约1575年，两河汇流处修建的水坝形成希尔韦纳湖，用于保护城堡北侧，被认为是立陶宛已知最古老的人工湖。

比尔扎伊城堡于1586年动工，城镇在1589年获得马格德堡权利。拉齐维乌家族使这里成为立陶宛新教改革的重要中心，并建立教堂和学校。犹太社群于十六世纪末在公国定居，利普卡鞑靼人也为该家族服务。瑞典战争期间，城堡多次遭攻击和重建；1704年再次被毁，此后长期荒废。

english: The Bisa country lies on the plateau between Lake Bangweulu and the escarpment above the Luangwa Valley. In the eighteenth century Bisa traders became important intermediaries for the kingdom of Kazembe on the Luapula. They carried copper and ivory eastward, exchanging ivory for cloth with Portuguese traders and, by around 1800, with Yao merchants who carried it towards Zanzibar. Competition over trade and salt accompanied the expansion of the neighbouring Bemba, who conquered plateau lands held by the Bisa in the late 1820s.
simp_chinese: 比萨人的土地位于班韦乌卢湖与卢安瓜河谷上方陡崖之间的高原上。十八世纪，比萨商人成为卢阿普拉河畔卡赞贝王国的重要贸易中间人。他们向东运送铜和象牙，以象牙向葡萄牙商人换取布匹；到1800年前后，也同将象牙运往桑给巴尔的瑶人商人交易。贸易和盐的争夺伴随着邻近本巴人的扩张，后者于1820年代末征服了比萨人在高原上的土地。

english:
Biscayne Bay is a shallow lagoon with estuary characteristics along the Atlantic shore of southern Florida, about thirty-five miles long and eight miles wide, averaging under two metres in depth. A chain of barrier islands, shoals and the northern Florida Keys shelters most of its water from the open ocean. Fresh water enters from the western shore through rivers and groundwater, while the eastern rim lies on an old coral reef.

Juan Ponce de León called these waters Chequescha in 1513, and Pedro Menéndez de Avilés used Tequesta in 1565, both names for the people living around the lagoon. A seventeenth-century map records the name Cayo de Biscainhos, from which the name Biscayne may derive. The southern waters, sheltered from the open sea, held broad mangrove, seagrass and coral-rock habitats.
simp_chinese:
比斯坎湾是南佛罗里达大西洋沿岸一片具有河口特征的浅水潟湖，长约35英里，最宽约8英里，平均水深不到2米。障壁岛、浅滩和佛罗里达群岛北端把大部分水面同外海隔开。西岸有河流与地下水补充淡水，东缘则建立在古老的珊瑚礁之上。

1513年，胡安·庞塞·德莱昂称这里为切克谢查；1565年，佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯使用特克斯塔一名，两者都指潟湖周边居民的名称。十七世纪的地图上记有比斯凯尼奥斯礁（Cayo de Biscainhos），“比斯坎”之名可能由此而来。较受遮蔽的南部水域分布着大片红树林、海草床和珊瑚岩栖息地。

english:
Bischofshofen lies in the Salzach valley of the Pongau, among mountains with a long history of copper mining. Its origins lie in the monastic cell of Saint Maximilian, founded in 711 or 712 and supplied with monks from Salzburg's Saint Peter's Abbey. Destroyed and rebuilt more than once, the foundation later became an Augustinian house and passed to the bishops of Chiemsee around 1216. Their estates gave the settlement its name.

Bischofshofen obtained market and toll rights in the fourteenth century. The Salzburg Peasants' War reached the village in 1525–1526, and later religious disputes brought further unrest. In 1732 thousands of Protestants were expelled from the districts of Bischofshofen and Werfen, many finding refuge in East Prussia. A flood of the Gainfeldbach killed sixteen people in the village in 1775. After Salzburg's ecclesiastical principality was secularised, the district passed to Austria in 1816.
simp_chinese:
比绍夫斯霍芬位于蓬高地区的萨尔察河谷，周围群山有着悠久的铜矿开采史。它起源于七一一或七一二年建立的圣马克西米利安修院，萨尔茨堡圣彼得修道院派遣修士到此。修院多次被毁又重建，后来成为奥斯定会修院，约一二一六年归基姆湖主教所有。聚落由主教的地产得名。

十四世纪，比绍夫斯霍芬获得集市和征税权。一五二五至一五二六年，萨尔茨堡农民战争波及村庄，后来的宗教争端又引发骚乱。一七三二年，比绍夫斯霍芬和韦尔芬辖区数千名新教徒被驱逐，许多人在东普鲁士避难。一七七五年，盖恩费尔德河洪水在村中夺去十六条生命。萨尔茨堡教会领地世俗化后，该地区于一八一六年归属奥地利。

english: Bisert grew around an ironworks on the Bisert River in the wooded Urals. Grigory Demidov obtained permission to build the works in 1760, and its first forging hammer began operating in November 1761. In January 1774 a force under Ivan Beloborodov, fighting in Pugachev's rebellion, took the works without a battle. The plant continued to produce bar iron in the decades that followed.
simp_chinese: 比谢尔特围绕乌拉尔林区比谢尔季河畔的一座铁工厂发展。格里戈里·杰米多夫于1760年获得建厂许可，第一座锻铁锤在1761年11月投入运转。1774年1月，参加普加乔夫起义的伊万·别洛博罗多夫所部不战而占领工厂。此后数十年，工厂继续生产条铁。

english:
Bishan lies among the hills west of Chongqing, between the ridges of central Sichuan and the Yangtze valley. Its name refers to the pale stone of a nearby mountain, said to shine like a jade disc. In 757 the Tang government carved Bishan County from Ba, Jiangjin and Wanshou, with its seat at Bishan town. Eleven years later the western portion was separated to form Yongchuan County, while Bishan continued under Yu Prefecture and its successors.

War depopulated Bishan, and the Yuan merged it into Ba County in 1285. The county was restored in 1483, when magistrate Zhang Ben cleared the ruined site and built its stone wall. That wall had a circumference of 684 zhang and five gates, enclosing three main streets and six lanes. In 1532 the written name was changed from the older form using bi for wall to the character meaning a jade disc, matching the local story of the bright stone.

Yongchuan administered the depopulated county from 1662, but the Qing restored a separate Bishan administration in 1729. Market towns and farm villages spread through its valleys and low hills, linked by roads toward Chongqing and the Chengdu plain. Bishan remained a small but durable county seat: repeatedly reduced during warfare, refounded around its wall, and sustained by the agricultural and commercial routes of western Chongqing.
simp_chinese:
璧山位于重庆西部丘陵之间，处在四川中部山岭与长江谷地之间。地名源于附近一座出产白石的山，相传石色明润如璧。757年，唐朝从巴县、江津和万寿析置璧山县，以当地城镇为治所。十一年后，西部辖地分出设置永川县，璧山则继续隶属渝州及其后继政区。

战乱和人口流失使元朝在1285年把璧山并入巴县。1483年，璧山恢复设县，知县张本清理废墟并修筑石城。城墙周长约六百八十四丈，设五门，城内有三街六巷。1532年，县名用字由原先表示墙壁的字改为“璧”，与当地白石如璧的说法相合。

清廷起初在1662年让永川兼管人口稀少的璧山，到1729年恢复独立县治。集镇和农业村落分布在山谷与低丘之间，道路把县境同重庆和成都平原连接起来。璧山因此是一处规模不大却延续长久的县城：屡经战乱而废置，又围绕城墙重建，并依靠重庆西部的农业与商路维持地方生活。

english:
Bishnupur was the capital of the Malla rulers of Mallabhum in western Bengal. The town is celebrated for temples built of brick and laterite, their walls adorned with scenes modelled in fired clay. Craftsmen adapted the curved roofs of Bengali huts to sacred buildings, joining local forms to towers and arched galleries. Royal patronage also supported music and weaving, making the court an important centre of Bengali culture.

At the turn of the seventeenth century, the Malla king Bir Hambir embraced Vaishnavism under the influence of the teacher Srinivasa. Tradition tells that Hambir’s men seized devotional manuscripts carried by Srinivasa and his companions; moved by the teacher’s exposition of the Bhagavata, the king became his patron. In 1600 Hambir commissioned the Rasmancha, a brick pavilion on a laterite platform where images of Krishna were brought together for the annual Ras festival. Its pyramidal roof rises above three surrounding galleries.

Hambir’s successors continued to build. The five-towered Shyam Rai temple dates to 1643, and the Jor Bangla temple of 1655 joins two structures shaped like village huts. Their terracotta reliefs turn temple walls into intricate pictures of religious stories and life at court. The flowering of art accompanied a less secure political position: the Malla kings became tributary rulers even as their capital gained its distinctive monuments.
simp_chinese:
毗湿奴普尔是孟加拉西部马拉布姆王国马拉诸王的都城。这里以砖石和红土建造的寺庙闻名，墙面装饰着烧制黏土制成的图景。工匠将孟加拉乡间房舍的曲线屋顶用于神庙，并与塔楼和拱廊相结合。王室还赞助音乐和织造，使都城成为孟加拉的重要文化中心。

十六至十七世纪之交，马拉王比尔·哈姆比尔受到导师斯里尼瓦萨的影响，皈依毗湿奴派。传说国王手下曾劫走斯里尼瓦萨一行携带的宗教手稿；国王听了导师讲解《薄伽梵往世书》后深受感动，转而成为他的庇护者。1600年，哈姆比尔修建拉斯曼恰，砖造殿阁立于红土台基之上，每年拉斯节时各寺的克里希纳神像都汇集于此。金字塔形屋顶之下环绕着三层回廊。

哈姆比尔的继承者继续营建。五塔的夏姆·拉伊神庙建于1643年，1655年的乔尔·邦拉神庙则将两座村舍形建筑相连。精巧的陶雕浮饰将宗教故事和宫廷生活铺陈于墙面。艺术繁盛的同时，马拉诸王的政治地位却不再稳固，他们成为纳贡的地方君主，都城仍留下了独具特色的建筑。

english: Bishreit lies in the steppe country near the Bayankhaan Mountains and Galshar. A well on the slope of Bayankhaan was associated with the noble Purevjav, and a Buddhist temple once stood nearby. In the wider Galshar country, a long row of natural white stone pillars is known as Chinggis Khan's mare tether: local tradition says he stopped there and ordered mares tied and milked.
simp_chinese: 比希雷特位于巴彦汗群山和嘎勒沙尔附近的草原地带。巴彦汗山坡上的一口井与贵族普日布扎布有关，附近曾有一座佛寺。在更广阔的嘎勒沙尔地区，一长列天然白色石柱被称为“成吉思汗的拴马桩”；当地传说他曾在此歇息，命人拴住母马挤奶。

english:
Biskra stands at the threshold of the Sahara in northeastern Algeria, where the Zibans oasis belt meets the uplands toward the Tell. The Sidi Zarzour stream crosses the city, and springs descending from the Aurès water palm groves and irrigated orchards. Dates, grain, fruit and livestock sustained the surrounding communities.

The settlement was known in antiquity as Vescera, a name whose origin is debated. Roman conflict, Berber resistance and the Arab conquests reshaped the region. Medieval writers described fortified villages, palm groves and gardens clustered around water at the desert’s edge. Control of channels and caravan roads gave local rulers influence over both oasis farmers and pastoral tribes.

Biskra connected the northern markets with Touggourt and the deep Sahara. Camel caravans carried dates, salt, wool and cloth, while seasonal workers moved between oasis gardens and the highlands. Its identity comes from the management of scarce water and from the passage between Mediterranean and Saharan worlds. Oasis labor cleared channels and pollinated palms. Caravans timed departures to water and market days. Women wove wool and palm products in oasis households.
simp_chinese:
比斯克拉位于阿尔及利亚东北撒哈拉入口，齐班绿洲带在这里同特勒山地相接。西迪扎尔祖尔溪穿过城市，奥雷斯山下来的泉水灌溉枣椰林和园圃。枣椰、谷物、水果与牲畜维系周边社群。

古代聚落称韦斯凯拉，名称起源仍有争论。罗马冲突、柏柏尔抵抗和阿拉伯征服重塑地区。中世纪作家描述沙漠边缘围绕水源聚集的设防村庄、枣椰林与园圃。对渠道和商道的控制，使地方统治者同时影响绿洲农民和游牧部落。

比斯克拉连接北方市场、图古尔特与撒哈拉腹地。骆驼商队运送枣椰、盐、羊毛和布匹，季节劳工在绿洲与高地间移动。其身份来自稀缺水源管理，也来自地中海与撒哈拉世界之间的通道。绿洲劳力维护渠道并为枣椰授粉，季节工人在北部高地与沙漠市场间往返。商队依据水源和集日安排出发，绿洲园圃依渠道逐块灌溉。绿洲家庭中的妇女编织羊毛和棕榈制品，市场连接牧民与农民。

english: In eastern Mindanao, Bislig lies beyond the mountains separating the Pacific coast from the Agusan basin. Manobo communities cultivated rice and root crops in this forested country and followed leaders known as #italic bagani#!. A local story tells of a ruler who survived a flooded river by grasping a strong vine.
simp_chinese: 在棉兰老岛东部，比斯利格位于分隔太平洋海岸与阿古桑河盆地的山脉之外。马诺博社群在这片森林地带种植稻米和块根作物，追随称为#italic 巴加尼#!的首领。当地故事讲述一位首领抓住坚韧藤蔓，得以从涨水的河流中脱险。

english: On New Ireland, the forested Schleinitz Range rises above a narrow island in the Bismarck Archipelago. Its rivers descend towards the coast, among them the Fissoa and Beram. New Ireland's inhabitants developed distinctive traditions including Malagan; in 1700 William Dampier recognised the island as separate from New Guinea.
simp_chinese: 在俾斯麦群岛的新爱尔兰岛上，林木覆盖的施莱尼茨山脉耸立于狭长的岛身之上。菲索阿河与贝拉姆河等河流从山间流向海岸。新爱尔兰岛民发展出马拉甘等独特传统；1700年，威廉·丹皮尔确认此岛与新几内亚并不相连。

english: The Bismarck Range rises in the central highlands of New Guinea, separating the valleys of the interior from river systems flowing towards the northern coast. Its high peaks include Mount Wilhelm, while forested slopes descend towards the Ramu basin. Communities on either side cultivated mountain valleys and maintained connections across a landscape divided by steep ridges.
simp_chinese: 俾斯麦山脉位于新几内亚中央高地，将内陆河谷与流向北岸的水系分隔。高峰中包括威廉山，森林山坡向拉穆河流域下降。山脉两侧的社群耕种山间河谷，并在陡峭山脊分隔的地带维持联系。

english: Bismuna Lagoon lies on Nicaragua's northeastern Caribbean coast, near the mouth of the Coco River. Mangroves and white-sand beaches surround the lagoon, which opens to the sea through the narrow Tukrun Channel. The Miskito settlement of Bismuna Tara stands near the Ibantara River; smaller lagoons and branches of the Coco spread through the low country around it.
simp_chinese: 比斯穆纳潟湖位于尼加拉瓜东北部加勒比海岸，靠近科科河口。红树林和白沙滩环绕着潟湖，狭窄的图克伦水道将它与大海相连。米斯基托人的比斯穆纳塔拉聚落位于伊班塔拉河附近，周围低地还散布着较小的潟湖与科科河支流。

english:
At Bisotun a limestone cliff rises above the ancient road between Mesopotamia and the Iranian plateau. High on its face, Darius I had a great relief and inscription cut in 521 BCE. The king stands with a bow over a fallen opponent, while the text recounts his victories over claimants to the throne. It is written in Old Persian, Elamite and Babylonian, a monument to the empire Darius brought under his rule.

The road beneath the mountain remained in use for centuries. A caravanserai built in the Safavid period provided shelter for travellers passing the ancient carvings. In 1836 the British officer Henry Rawlinson climbed to the ledge and began copying the Old Persian text; by September 1837 he had completed that part. His work on the multilingual inscription helped open the way to reading the cuneiform writings of the ancient Near East.
simp_chinese:
贝希斯敦的石灰岩峭壁高耸于美索不达米亚通往伊朗高原的古道之上。公元前521年，大流士一世命人在崖壁高处刻下巨大的浮雕与铭文。国王手持弓，脚踏倒下的对手；文字记述了他战胜王位觊觎者的经过。铭文以古波斯语、埃兰语和巴比伦语写成，是大流士重建帝国的纪念碑。

山下的道路延续使用了数个世纪。萨法维时期建造的商队旅舍，为经过古代雕刻的旅人提供庇护。1836年，英国军官亨利·罗林森攀上崖壁平台，开始抄录古波斯语文字；到1837年9月，他完成了这一部分。他对多语铭文的研究，为解读古代近东楔形文字开辟了道路。

english: The Bijagós Islands lie off the coast of Guinea-Bissau, formed from the ancient delta of the Geba and Grande de Buba rivers. Mangroves and sandbanks border tidal channels between islands of palm forest and savanna. Bijagó communities travelled these waters by canoe, joining fishing and rice cultivation with a long history of maritime trade. In 1535 the islanders destroyed an expedition sent by the Portuguese prince Dom Luís to conquer the archipelago. Trade with the Portuguese resumed around 1550, and Bijagó raiders later supplied captives from the mainland to the Atlantic slave trade. Despite rivalries among the islands, their fleets gave them considerable power along the neighbouring coast.
simp_chinese: 比热戈斯群岛位于几内亚比绍外海，由热巴河与大布巴河的古三角洲形成。红树林和沙洲沿潮汐水道分布，岛上则有棕榈林和稀树草原。比热戈社群乘独木舟穿行水域，以捕鱼和种稻为生，也有悠久的海上贸易传统。1535年，葡萄牙王子路易斯派远征队征服群岛，却被岛民击溃。约1550年，比热戈人与葡萄牙人恢复贸易，后来岛民袭击大陆，将俘虏卖入大西洋奴隶贸易。尽管岛屿之间存在竞争，他们的船队仍使他们在附近海岸拥有相当大的力量。

english: The Bissagos Islands lie off the mouths of the Geba and Grande rivers, where channels divide a broad Atlantic archipelago. Its inhabitants were skilled fishers, cultivators and builders of seagoing canoes. Islanders traded with the mainland and European ships, but also launched raids for captives along the coast. Their war canoes and knowledge of the channels helped them defend their independence against repeated Portuguese attempts to impose authority on the islands.
simp_chinese: 比热戈斯群岛位于热巴河和格兰德河口外，水道将宽广的大西洋群岛分割成众多岛屿。岛民擅长捕鱼、耕作和建造远航独木舟。他们与大陆及欧洲船只贸易，也曾沿海岸发动劫掠，俘获人口。战船与对水道的熟悉，使岛民得以抵御葡萄牙人反复试图在群岛建立统治的行动，保住自身独立。

english: Bissam Cuttack lies among the hills of southern Odisha, close to the forested Niyamgiri range. The hills are the country of the Dongria Kondh, who cultivate slopes and gather the produce of the forests. Their traditions honour Niyam Raja as a guardian of the hills. Numerous streams rise in this upland, feeding the Vamsadhara and Nagavali river systems as they descend towards the plains and the Bay of Bengal.
simp_chinese: 比瑟姆格德格位于奥里萨南部丘陵之中，靠近森林覆盖的尼亚姆吉里山脉。这里是东里亚孔达人居住的山地，他们耕种山坡并采集林产。当地传统尊奉尼亚姆拉贾为山地守护神。众多溪流从高地发源，汇入瓦姆萨达拉和纳加瓦利河系，再流向平原和孟加拉湾。

english: Bissau stands on the broad estuary of the Geba River, where tidal waters open towards the Atlantic. The Papel kingdom and other African communities controlled the surrounding coast and its trading connections. Portuguese merchants established a post here in the late seventeenth century and attempted to fortify their position, but their presence depended on relations with local rulers. The river linked the coast to inland markets and the wider commercial world of Upper Guinea.
simp_chinese: 比绍坐落在热巴河宽广的河口，潮汐水域向大西洋敞开。帕佩尔王国及其他非洲社群控制着周围海岸和贸易联系。十七世纪末，葡萄牙商人在此建立商站并试图巩固据点，但他们的存在依赖与地方统治者的关系。河流将海岸与内陆市场及上几内亚更广阔的商业世界连接起来。

english:
Bistrița, called Bistritz by its German inhabitants and Beszterce in Hungarian, was a fortified Saxon town in northeastern Transylvania. It grew beside the river from which it took its name, with merchants and craftsmen serving the surrounding country and routes toward the Carpathian passes.

In 1353 King Louis I granted the town a fifteen-day annual fair and a seal bearing an ostrich with a horseshoe in its beak. Its prosperity supported strong walls, gates and towers, whose defence was entrusted to the guilds. In 1465 work began on the town's fortifications. The Reformation changed the religious life of its Saxon community in the sixteenth century. Later wars brought further hardship, while Armenian merchants from Moldavia settled in Bistrița during the 1670s, adding another community to the town's commercial life.
simp_chinese:
比斯特里察是特兰西瓦尼亚东北部的设防萨克森城镇，德语称比斯特里茨，匈牙利语称拜斯泰尔采。它在同名河流旁发展，商人和工匠服务于周围地区及通向喀尔巴阡山口的道路。

1353年，路易一世国王授予城镇每年举办十五天集市的权利，并赐予一枚印章，图案是一只口衔马蹄铁的鸵鸟。繁荣支持了坚固城墙、城门和塔楼的修建，其防御由行会承担。1465年，城防工程开始。十六世纪的宗教改革改变了萨克森社区的信仰生活。后来的战争带来更多困难，而来自摩尔达维亚的亚美尼亚商人在1670年代定居比斯特里察，为城镇商业生活增添了新的社区。

english: Biswan lies in Awadh and is said to have been founded in the fifteenth century by a yogi named Bishwar, from whom the town took its name. Mosques and dargahs were among the buildings associated with Shekhbari. At the tomb of Gulzaar Shah Baba, an annual gathering honours the saint, bringing devotees together in the town.
simp_chinese: 比斯万位于阿瓦德，相传由一位名叫比什瓦尔的瑜伽师于十五世纪建立，城镇也因他得名。谢赫巴里建造的建筑中有清真寺和陵祠。古尔扎尔沙巴巴的陵墓每年举行纪念圣人的集会，信徒们在此汇聚。

english:
Bitburg began as Beda, a stop on the Roman road from Trier towards Cologne. Around 330 Emperor Constantine strengthened the settlement as a road fort, whose central area became the later town. The town came under the protection of the archbishop of Trier by treaty in 1239. In 1262 Count Henry V of Luxembourg granted Bitburg its town charter. Its position in the Eifel placed it between the lands of Trier and Luxembourg.

The town shared the changing fortunes of the Duchy of Luxembourg, passing under Burgundian rule in 1443 and later to the Austrian Netherlands. French administration began in 1794; a court and land registry were established during the ensuing reorganization. Following Napoleon's defeat, the Congress of Vienna assigned Bitburg to Prussia in 1815, ending centuries of association with Luxembourg.
simp_chinese:
比特堡最初名为贝达，是罗马道路从特里尔通往科隆途中的驿站。约330年，皇帝君士坦丁将聚落加强为道路堡垒，其中心成为后来城镇的核心。1239年，根据条约，城镇受到特里尔大主教保护。1262年，卢森堡伯爵亨利五世授予比特堡城市特许。它位于艾费尔地区，处在特里尔与卢森堡领地之间。

比特堡随卢森堡公国经历多次易主，1443年归勃艮第统治，后来又归于奥属尼德兰。1794年，法国开始管理此地，随后重组行政机构，设立法院和土地登记处。拿破仑战败后，1815年维也纳会议将比特堡交给普鲁士，结束了它与卢森堡数百年的联系。

english: Bitche lies among the forests and sandstone hills of the northern Vosges, beneath a rocky height long occupied by a castle. Its position near the borders of Lorraine made it a place of military importance. After Louis XIV took possession of the town, Vauban designed a citadel on the rock in 1680. The fortifications were demolished after France returned Bitche to Lorraine, but work on a new fortress began in 1737 after Lorraine again came under French control.
simp_chinese: 比什位于孚日山北部的森林与砂岩丘陵之间，城镇上方的岩顶很早便建有城堡。靠近洛林边界的位置使它具有军事价值。路易十四占领此地后，沃邦于1680年设计了岩顶上的要塞。法国将比什归还洛林后，防御工事遭到拆毁；洛林再次受法国控制后，新的堡垒于1737年开始修建。

english: The Bitki is a small river of the Lake Udyl basin, north of the lower Amur. It flows towards the lake through low country shared with the Bichi and Pilda rivers. Their mouths and the marshes around the lake form a network of wetland habitats, where waterbirds gather among river channels and shallow waters. Lake Udyl is connected in turn to the Amur by the Ukhta channel.
simp_chinese: 比特基河是黑龙江下游以北乌第尔湖流域的一条小河。它流经低地，注入乌第尔湖；比奇河和皮尔达河也汇入这座湖泊。诸河的河口与湖边沼泽构成相连的湿地，水鸟在水道与浅水间聚集。乌第尔湖又通过乌赫塔水道与黑龙江相通。

english:
Bitlis occupies a narrow valley southwest of Lake Van, where roads descend from the Armenian highlands towards Mesopotamia. A castle dominates the town and its streams, bridges and stone buildings. For centuries Bitlis was the seat of a Kurdish princely house whose rulers balanced local authority against the ambitions of the larger states surrounding them. Armenian Christians and Muslims formed part of the town's varied population.

The principality changed hands amid the struggles of the Aq Qoyunlu, Safavids and Ottomans. In 1578 Sultan Murad III restored Sharaf Khan to the hereditary rule of Bitlis. A prince as well as a scholar, he composed the Persian-language Sharafnama in 1597, recording the histories of Kurdish dynasties, including his own. His work preserved accounts of the many rulers and communities of the region. In the seventeenth century the wealthy emir Abdal Khan entertained the Ottoman traveller Evliya Çelebi, who described the court and town. Relations with the Ottoman governor of Van later broke down, and imperial forces moved against the emir. Bitlis remained a centre of local rule and culture amid the rivalries that repeatedly drew armies through its mountain passes.
simp_chinese:
比特利斯位于凡湖西南的一条狭窄河谷中，亚美尼亚高地通往美索不达米亚的道路由此下降。城堡俯瞰着镇上的溪流、桥梁与石砌建筑。数百年来，比特利斯是库尔德诸侯家族的驻地，其统治者在地方权力与周围大国的野心之间周旋。亚美尼亚基督徒和穆斯林都是城镇多元居民的一部分。

在白羊、萨法维与奥斯曼诸势力的争斗中，公国屡次易手。1578年苏丹穆拉德三世恢复了沙拉夫汗对比特利斯的世袭统治。这位既是诸侯又是学者的人于1597年以波斯语写成《沙拉夫史》，记述包括自身家族在内的库尔德王朝历史，为当地众多统治者与社群留下了记录。十七世纪，富有的埃米尔阿卜达勒汗接待了奥斯曼旅行家埃夫利亚·切莱比，后者记述了宫廷和城镇。埃米尔后来与凡城的奥斯曼总督关系破裂，帝国军队向其进攻。在反复引来军队穿越山口的角逐中，比特利斯仍是地方统治与文化的中心。

english:
Bitola stands on the Dragor River at the edge of the Pelagonian plain, beneath the heights of Baba Mountain. Its Slavic name is related to the word for a monastery, recalling the religious houses of the medieval town. Under Ottoman rule it was known as Manastır and grew into a center of commerce, with mosques, inns and a busy bazaar serving the surrounding country.

In 1506 the judge Ishak Çelebi endowed a mosque near the market and the river. His foundation also mentioned the shops of the covered market, or bezisten, where merchants traded valuable goods. In the 17th century the traveler Evliya Çelebi described a substantial town with hundreds of shops. Its merchants and craftsmen drew on the roads through Pelagonia, linking the plain with other cities of the Ottoman Balkans.
simp_chinese:
比托拉位于德拉戈尔河畔、佩拉戈尼亚平原边缘，巴巴山高踞其上。它的斯拉夫语名称与“修道院”一词有关，令人想起中世纪城镇的宗教建筑。奥斯曼统治时期，这里称为马纳斯特尔，发展为商业中心，清真寺、旅舍和繁忙的市集服务于周围地区。

1506年，法官伊沙克·切莱比在市场与河流附近捐建了一座清真寺。他的基金文件还提到有盖市场，也就是贝德斯坦内的店铺，商人在那里买卖贵重货物。17世纪，旅行家埃夫利亚·切莱比描述了一座拥有数百家店铺的大城。商人和工匠利用穿越佩拉戈尼亚的道路，将平原与奥斯曼巴尔干的其他城市连接起来。

english: Bítov Castle rises on a steep promontory above the winding Želetavka in southern Moravia. A fortified Přemyslid settlement stood here in the eleventh century, and in the first half of the thirteenth century it was rebuilt as a Gothic castle guarding the southern frontier. Later lords of Bítov strengthened its defences and occupied it for centuries. The castle was remodelled in Baroque style and, after passing to the counts of Daun, underwent further changes in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 比托夫城堡屹立在摩拉维亚南部一处陡峭岬角上，俯瞰蜿蜒的热莱塔夫卡河。十一世纪，普热米斯尔家族在此设有防御聚落；十三世纪上半叶，它被改建为守卫南部边境的哥特式城堡。后来的比托夫领主加强了防御，在此居住数百年。城堡经过巴洛克式改建，转归道恩伯爵后又在十九世纪初进一步改造。

english: Bitterfeld developed as a German settlement east of an older Slavic village, later growing into a market town with an ordered street plan. It was first recorded in 1224. Its position between the Elbe and Saale regions placed it among the towns contested by the rulers of central Germany. In 1476 the margrave of Meissen captured Bitterfeld, which thereafter belonged to Saxony for more than three centuries. The settlement after the Napoleonic wars transferred it to Prussia in 1815.
simp_chinese: 比特费尔德由一处德意志人聚落发展而来，位于较古老的斯拉夫村庄以东，后来成为街道布局整齐的市场城镇。1224年，此地首次见于文献。它处在易北河与萨勒河地区之间，是中德诸统治者争夺的城镇之一。1476年，迈森藩侯攻占比特费尔德，此后三个多世纪它属于萨克森。拿破仑战争后的安排于1815年将其转交普鲁士。

english: The Bitterroot Valley stretches north between the Bitterroot and Sapphire mountains, with the river of the same name flowing toward the Clark Fork. It is part of the homeland of the Salish, whose journeys took them across the mountains to hunt bison on the plains. In September 1805 Lewis and Clark descended into the southern valley and met a large Salish camp at Ross' Hole. The Salish were travelling to join Shoshone people on a bison hunt, while the expedition continued north along the river.
simp_chinese: 比特鲁特谷地在比特鲁特山脉与蓝宝石山脉之间向北延伸，同名河流流向克拉克福克河。这里是萨利什人的故土，他们曾翻越群山，前往平原猎取野牛。1805年9月，刘易斯与克拉克进入谷地南部，在罗斯洼地遇到一处大型萨利什营地。萨利什人当时正准备与肖肖尼人会合，共同猎取野牛；远征队则继续沿河向北行进。

english: Bitti lies among the hills of northeastern Sardinia, north of Nuoro. Ancient granite structures and temples in the surrounding country testify to settlement in the Nuragic age. The place was recorded as Bitthe in 1170 and became a district centre of the Judicate of Gallura. It later formed part of the Marquisate of Orani, while the village grew around its church dedicated to Saint George.
simp_chinese: 比蒂位于撒丁岛东北部的丘陵中，在努奥罗以北。周围地区的古代花岗岩建筑和神庙见证了努拉吉时代的定居。1170年的记载称此地为比泰，它后来成为加卢拉法官国的地区中心。比蒂随后属于奥拉尼侯国，村落围绕献给圣乔治的教堂发展起来。

english: Bitur lies in the southern lowlands of New Guinea, in the broad country between the Morehead and Fly river systems. Its name identifies a Papuan language of this area, where rivers cross seasonally flooded plains towards the southern coast. The region’s many distinct languages reflect the varied communities established among its waterways and forests.
simp_chinese: 比图尔位于新几内亚南部低地，处在莫尔黑德河与弗莱河水系之间的广阔地带。地名所指的是当地一种巴布亚语言；河流穿过季节性淹水的平原，流向南部海岸。区域内众多不同语言反映了水道与森林之间形成的多样社群。

english:
Biu lies on the plateau south of Bornu, among the lands of the Babur and Bura peoples. Its name is connected with a word meaning high in their language. The surrounding country includes grassland and savanna, where communities raise livestock and cultivate crops including sorghum and millet.

The rulers of the Biu kingdom traced their line to Yamta-ra-Wala, who established his authority in the sixteenth century. Tradition remembers him as a founder who brought together Bura and Babur settlements. His descendants formed rival dynasties at Kogu and Mandaragirau. Around the beginning of the nineteenth century, Mari Watirwa ruled from Kogu near Biu and defeated Fulani attackers from Gombe to the west. The town of Biu itself became a royal seat later in the century.
simp_chinese:
比乌位于博尔努以南的高原上，属于巴布尔人与布拉人的土地。它的名字与这两种语言中“高”的词语有关。周围的草地与稀树草原上，社群饲养牲畜，种植高粱和粟等作物。

比乌王国的统治者将世系追溯至扬塔拉瓦拉，他在十六世纪建立了自己的权力。传说他是联合布拉与巴布尔聚落的开国者。他的后裔分别在科古与曼达拉吉劳形成相互竞争的王朝。十九世纪初前后，马里·瓦蒂尔瓦在比乌附近的科古统治，击败了来自西面贡贝的富拉尼进攻者。比乌镇本身在这一世纪晚些时候才成为王室治所。

english:
Bivona lies among the mountains of western Sicily, a town whose fertile lands supported a sizeable agricultural community under the lordship of the Luna family. First recorded from the twelfth century, it grew from a rural settlement into an important Sicilian feudal centre. Its ducal palace stood as a sign of the family's authority over the town and surrounding estates.

In 1554 Charles V raised the barony of Bivona to a duchy and granted the town the title of city. Pietro de Luna and his wife Isabella de Vega made their residence here, and the palace became the seat of the new duchy. The Lunas' position linked this inland community to the noble and viceregal politics of the Kingdom of Sicily.
simp_chinese:
比沃纳坐落在西西里西部山地，肥沃的土地在卢纳家族统治下养育了相当规模的居民。聚落自十二世纪见于记载，后来从乡村发展为重要的封建中心。公爵宫殿是家族统治城镇及周边领地的象征。

1554年，查理五世将比沃纳男爵领提升为公国，并授予城镇城市称号。彼得罗·德卢纳与妻子伊莎贝拉·德维加在此定居，宫殿成为新公国的驻地。卢纳家族的地位把这处内陆社群与西西里王国贵族和总督的政治联系起来。

english:
Biyang lies in the hills and stream valleys of southern Henan, near the Tongbai range, where the Chu raised a long wall in the Warring States and left gates and ramparts that can still be traced. As Biyang it was a Han county, and from the Sui it was the seat of Tangzhou, a department that took in the neighbouring counties until the Jin.

The Yuan abolished Biyang County in 1266 and ran the district straight from Tangzhou. The Ming restored it in 1380 as Biyang County under Nanyang Prefecture, and the Qing kept the arrangement. The county gazetteer of later years records repairs to the City God temple in the county town, where the god who guarded the walls and the officials' oaths was worshipped.
simp_chinese:
泌阳位于河南南部桐柏山脉附近的丘陵河谷之间，战国时楚国在这一带修筑长城，城门与城垣遗迹至今还可辨认。汉代这里设比阳县，隋代起为唐州治所，唐州管辖周边诸县，直到金代。

元至元三年（1266年），朝廷废比阳县，由唐州直接管理这一带。明洪武十三年（1380年）复置泌阳县，隶南阳府，清代沿袭不变。后来的县志记录了县城重修城隍庙的经过，城隍被视为守护城池、监督官吏誓言的神灵。

sources.title: 泌阳县各级文物保护单位列表

english:
Biysk stands on the Biya River near the point where it joins the Katun to form the Ob. This meeting of rivers lies at the northern edge of the Altai Mountains, where routes from the mountains reach the West Siberian Plain. A Russian fort was ordered here by Peter I to collect tribute and establish farming settlements. The first Bikatun fort was built in 1709.

The frontier was contested. In 1710 Dzungar forces besieged and burned the first fort; a second Bikatun fortress was built in 1718. Biysk became part of the fortified line facing the steppe and mountain country to the south. In 1782 it received the status of a district town, lost it in 1797, and regained it in 1806. Its position near the upper Ob continued to tie the settlement to the rivers and approaches of the Altai.
simp_chinese:
比斯克位于比亚河畔，靠近比亚河与卡通河汇合成鄂毕河的地方。这里处在阿尔泰山北缘，山中道路在此通向西西伯利亚平原。彼得一世下令在此筑堡，以征收贡赋并建立农民聚落；第一座比卡通堡垒于1709年建成。

这片边疆并不安宁。1710年，准噶尔军队围攻并焚毁了第一座堡垒；第二座比卡通堡垒于1718年修建。比斯克成为面向南方草原与山区的防御线一环。1782年它获设为县城，1797年被撤销，1806年又恢复地位。上鄂毕河附近的位置，使这座聚落始终同阿尔泰山的水道和通路紧密相连。

english: Bizerte is a port on the northern coast of Tunisia, at the channel linking the Mediterranean with Lake Bizerte. Its old harbor lies below the walls of the kasbah. The town became a point of contention between European and Ottoman powers in the sixteenth century: forces of Charles V captured it in 1535, and it came under Ottoman control in 1574. Its harbor later served corsairs operating from the Tunisian coast.
simp_chinese: 比塞大是突尼斯北岸的港口，坐落在连接地中海与比塞大湖的水道旁。古港位于卡斯巴城墙下。十六世纪，这座城镇成为欧洲与奥斯曼势力争夺的地点：查理五世的军队于1535年夺取此地，1574年它落入奥斯曼人控制。此后，港湾也供从突尼斯海岸出航的私掠者使用。

english: Bizhbulyak lies in the country of the upper Kyngyr-Meneuz. Its name comes from a Turkic expression interpreted as five shares or plots of land. A surviving agreement of 1767 records that Bashkirs of the Ilkul-Min district granted land called Bizhbulyak to twenty households of newly baptized settlers from the village of Yermolayevo, in return for payment. The agreement included arable land, hay meadows and the use of woodland, setting out the terms on which the newcomers could establish their homes.
simp_chinese: 比日布利亚克位于肯格尔—梅涅乌兹河上游地区。地名源自突厥语，可解释为五份或五块土地。保存下来的1767年协议记载，伊尔库尔—明辖区的巴什基尔人将名为比日布利亚克的土地交给来自叶尔莫拉耶沃村的二十户新受洗者，收取相应款项。协议包括耕地、刈草地和林木使用权，规定了新来者在此安家的条件。

english:
Bjelovar lies near the low hills of Bilogora in central Croatia. Its orderly streets were laid out as the headquarters of regiments of the Varaždin Generalate, part of the Habsburg Military Frontier. Long before the planned town arose, settlements and trading places stood in the surrounding country; during the Ottoman wars the area became part of a fortified borderland.

In 1756 Maria Theresa ordered a new military centre to be established here, with construction directed by Baron Philipp Lewin von Beck. Barracks and other military buildings came first. Two Piarist brothers arrived in 1761 and opened a school, while a parish church dedicated to Saint Teresa of Ávila was completed in 1772. Maria Theresa confirmed Bjelovar's privileges as a military community in 1771, encouraging its population and economy to grow. By the early nineteenth century the town had begun to spread beyond its original plan.
simp_chinese:
别洛瓦尔位于克罗地亚中部，靠近低缓的比洛戈拉山丘。整齐的街道原为瓦拉日丁军区各团的驻地而规划，这片军区属于哈布斯堡军事边疆。规划中的城镇出现以前，周围已有聚落和集市；奥斯曼战争期间，这里成为设防边地的一部分。

1756年，玛丽亚·特蕾莎下令在此设立新的军事中心，由菲利普·莱文·冯·贝克男爵主持建设，兵营和其他军事建筑最先落成。1761年，两名敬虔学校修会修士来到这里，开办了一所学校；供奉阿维拉的圣德肋撒的堂区教堂则于1772年建成。玛丽亚·特蕾莎在1771年确认别洛瓦尔作为军事社区的特权，促进了人口与经济增长。到十九世纪初，城镇已开始向最初规划的范围之外扩展。

english: Bjni lies in the valley of the Hrazdan, below a rocky mesa bearing the remains of a medieval fortress. The stronghold belonged to the Pahlavuni family, and its walls and hidden passages made use of the steep natural defences. Beneath it stands the church of Surb Astvatsatsin, built in 1031. Timur's forces destroyed the village in 1387–1388, during the campaigns that devastated much of Armenia.
simp_chinese: 布尼坐落在赫拉兹丹河谷，一座岩石台地上的中世纪堡垒遗迹俯瞰着村庄。要塞曾属于帕赫拉武尼家族，城墙和隐蔽通道利用了天然陡坡的防御优势。下方是建于1031年的圣母教堂。1387—1388年，帖木儿军队在席卷亚美尼亚广大地区的征战中摧毁了这个村庄。

english: Bjørnafjord is a broad stretch of water between the Bergen peninsula and the islands of Tysnes. Its branches reach towards Fusa and Samnanger, bringing the sea deep into the surrounding country. In the Middle Ages the shores around Os and these inner fjords belonged to the same naval levy district, Framnes. Farms and wooded slopes faced the water, and boats joined communities spread across the fjord basin and its long, narrower arms.
simp_chinese: 比约纳峡湾是一片宽阔水域，位于卑尔根半岛与蒂斯内斯群岛之间。支湾伸向富萨和萨姆南厄尔，将海水引入周围内陆。中世纪时，奥斯与这些内侧峡湾沿岸属于同一海军征发区弗拉姆内斯。农场和森林山坡面向水域，船只连接散布在宽阔湾区及狭长支湾两岸的社群。

english: Björneborg, called Pori in Finnish, stands near the mouth of the Kokemäki River on Finland's western coast. As land rose and navigation became more difficult, the older river towns of Kokemäki and Ulvila lost access to shipping. In 1558 Duke John founded Björneborg closer to the sea and ordered Ulvila's burghers to move there. A riverside shipyard opened in 1572, and a large vessel known as the Porin Kraveli was completed in 1583. Russian troops occupied the town during the Great Northern War; foreign trade suffered, and Björneborg did not regain its staple rights until 1765.
simp_chinese: 比约讷堡在芬兰语中称波里，位于芬兰西岸科凯迈基河口附近。随着土地抬升、航行日益困难，河上较早的科凯迈基和乌尔维拉逐渐失去航运优势。1558年，约翰公爵在更靠近大海的地方建立比约讷堡，并命乌尔维拉市民迁居新城。1572年，河畔造船厂开工；1583年，一艘名为“波里大帆船”的大船在此建成。大北方战争期间，俄军占领城镇，对外贸易受到打击；比约讷堡直到1765年才恢复对外贸易特权。

english: Bkejwanong means “where the waters divide”, a name for the islands and channels where the St Clair River enters Lake St Clair. Marshes, shallow water and the lake shores form a homeland of Anishinaabe peoples, including Ojibwe, Odawa and Potawatomi. In 1790 leaders representing several communities of the region met British representatives at Detroit to make a treaty concerning land along these waterways. The delta remained a place of residence and connection for the peoples whose lives were bound to the river and its islands.
simp_chinese: 布克韦贾农意为“水流分开的地方”，指圣克莱尔河注入圣克莱尔湖时形成的岛屿与水道。沼泽、浅水和湖岸是阿尼希纳贝人的家园，包括奥吉布瓦、渥太华与波塔瓦托米人。1790年，代表这一带多个社群的首领在底特律与英国代表订立涉及水道沿岸土地的条约。三角洲仍是居民生活和彼此联系的地方，他们的生活与河流及岛屿紧密相连。

english: Bla lies south of Ségou in the savanna country of the middle Niger. Its name is linked to the Bamana word for leaving something behind: according to local tradition the place served as a store where the armies of Ségou left grain and weapons for later use. The surrounding villages cultivated the land south of the river, while the kingdom based at Ségou drew upon the resources and labour of the wider region to maintain its warriors.
simp_chinese: 布拉位于塞古以南，处在尼日尔河中游的稀树草原地区。村名与班马纳语中“留下”一词有关：地方传统称，这里曾是塞古军队储藏粮食和武器、以备日后使用的地方。周边村民耕作河流以南的土地，而以塞古为中心的王国则从广大地区获取物资与劳力，供养战士。

english: Black Bay is a broad, shallow inlet on the northern shore of Lake Superior. Its warmer waters support fish that are less common in the deep, cold reaches of the open lake, and the Black Sturgeon River flows into its head from the north. East of the bay, the Nipigon River offers a route inland to the great lake of the same name. Towards the end of the seventeenth century, French traders established posts on Lake Nipigon and at the river mouth, entering a region inhabited by Ojibwe communities.
simp_chinese: 黑湾是苏必利尔湖北岸一处宽阔而水浅的海湾。与冰冷深邃的湖心相比，湾水较为温暖，一些在开阔湖面深水中少见的鱼类在此栖息。黑鲟河从北方流入湾底；海湾以东，尼皮贡河则向内陆延伸，通往广阔的同名湖泊。十七世纪末，法国商人分别在尼皮贡湖和尼皮贡河口设立贸易站，进入奥吉布瓦社群居住的地区。

english: Black Bear Bay cuts into the Labrador coast behind Shoal Bay Island, with the Black Bear River entering at its head. Bed Head separates the bay from its neighbour, Open Bay, while shoals extend offshore around the nearby islands. A small waterfall marks the bay's northern shore; ships can find anchorage within, though navigating it requires local knowledge. Farther south at Battle Harbour, merchants from Poole established a fishing station in the 1770s to serve crews working the cod-rich waters along this coast.
simp_chinese: 黑熊湾深入拉布拉多海岸，湾口外有肖尔湾岛，黑熊河从湾顶注入。贝德角把它与相邻的开阔湾隔开，附近岛屿外散布着浅滩，北岸有一处小瀑布。海湾内部可以为船只提供锚地，但进出时需要熟悉当地水域。更南面的巴特尔港，来自普尔的商人在1770年代设立渔站，服务沿岸鳕鱼渔场的渔民。

english:
Black Lake, Tazen Tuwé in Chipewyan, lies in the boreal forest of northern Saskatchewan. The lake receives the Fond du Lac River at its northwest end and releases it toward Lake Athabasca, making the water part of the principal canoe corridor between the Churchill River country and the far north. Low shores, spruce forest and a short open-water season determined where travellers could camp and move.

Denesuline families used the lake and its surrounding forests for hunting, fishing and trapping, entering the uplands as caribou, moose and fur-bearing animals shifted with the seasons. The lake gave access to water routes but did not support settlement at every point on its shore. Winter travel over ice and snow connected people where canoes could not.

European fur traders reached the northern waterways during the eighteenth century and incorporated them into networks centred on the Athabasca and Churchill systems. Denesuline people guided canoes and supplied food, skins and local knowledge while retaining their own territories and kinship ties. The northwest shore became a regular stopping and trading place because the river outlet linked the lake directly to the far northern route. The lake's identity grew from that combination of forest, seasonal movement and the route to Lake Athabasca.
simp_chinese:
黑湖在奇佩维安语中称“塔曾图韦”，位于萨斯喀彻温省北部的寒温带森林。丰迪拉克河从湖的西北端流入，又继续流向阿萨巴斯卡湖，使黑湖成为丘吉尔河地区通往极北地带的主要独木舟航线之一。湖岸低平，云杉林环绕，短暂的无冰期决定营地位置。

德内苏林家庭利用湖泊及周围森林捕鱼、狩猎和设置陷阱，随着驯鹿、驼鹿及毛皮动物季节迁徙进入高地。湖泊沿岸并非处处适合居住，但水路通向各个猎场。冬季冰面又让独木舟无法到达的地方成为雪橇与步行通道。

十八世纪，欧洲毛皮商沿北方水道建立贸易网络，把黑湖地区纳入丘吉尔河与阿萨巴斯卡系统。德内苏林人担任向导、提供食物和兽皮，同时保留自己的领地和亲属关系。西北岸因河流出口正对北方航道而成为固定停留和交易处。森林、季节移动与通向阿萨巴斯卡湖的水路共同塑造了黑湖的地方身份。

english: The southeastern Black Sea lies off the mountainous Pontic coast, where forested slopes descend toward narrow coastal plains. Trebizond became a major port at the end of routes crossing the mountains from the Iranian plateau. In the later Middle Ages merchants from Genoa and Venice visited its harbour, exchanging goods carried overland for wares arriving by sea. Ships continued westward along the coast or crossed toward Crimea.
simp_chinese: 黑海东南部濒临多山的本都海岸，林木覆盖的山坡向狭窄海岸平原下降。特拉布宗位于穿越山脉、通向伊朗高原的道路尽头，发展为重要港口。中世纪后期，热那亚和威尼斯商人来到其港湾，以陆路运来的货物交换海上商品。船只再沿岸西行，或横渡至克里米亚。

english: The northeastern Black Sea lies off the Caucasian coast and the approaches to the Kerch Strait. The harbour of Matrega on the Taman Peninsula was part of a Genoese network that linked Crimea with the eastern shore. Ships and smaller fishing vessels met there, while merchants dealt with the peoples of the neighbouring coast. Control of the strait mattered to traders travelling onward to the Sea of Azov.
simp_chinese: 黑海东北部濒临高加索海岸和刻赤海峡入口。塔曼半岛上的马特雷加港属于热那亚贸易网络，连接克里米亚与东岸。大船和较小渔船在此相会，商人也与邻近海岸的居民交易。对于继续航往亚速海的商人而言，谁控制海峡十分重要。

english: These open waters lie south of Crimea, between the peninsula and the Anatolian shore. Medieval ships crossed the Black Sea to reach the Crimean ports of Caffa and Sudak, as well as the Kerch Strait and the Sea of Azov beyond. Genoese merchants built a network of trading posts around these shores, while rival Venetian ships also sought access to the markets of the northern Black Sea.
simp_chinese: 这片开阔水域位于克里米亚以南、安纳托利亚海岸以北。中世纪船只横渡黑海，前往克里米亚的卡法和苏达克港，也驶向刻赤海峡及其后的亚速海。热那亚商人在沿岸建立贸易据点网络，竞争的威尼斯人同样寻求进入黑海北岸市场。

english: The open Black Sea separates the coast of Anatolia from the shores of Crimea. Its waters are joined to the Mediterranean by the Bosporus, while rivers bring fresh water from the lands around it. Medieval merchants crossed between ports on opposite shores, carrying goods to and from the Mediterranean. Genoese traders established a strong presence at Caffa in Crimea after gaining access to Black Sea commerce in the thirteenth century.
simp_chinese: 开阔的黑海将安纳托利亚海岸与克里米亚隔开。博斯普鲁斯海峡使其与地中海相连，周围大陆的河流则将淡水注入海中。中世纪商人往来于两岸港口，运输进出地中海的货物。热那亚商人在十三世纪获得黑海贸易权后，于克里米亚的卡法建立了强大的商业据点。

english: The western Black Sea opens between the Bulgarian coast and the waters off Anatolia. Ships sailing north from the Bosporus passed coastal ports before reaching the mouths of the Danube and the trading centres beyond. From the thirteenth century Venetian and Genoese merchants joined the existing traffic across these waters, linking the river lands and the western shore with Constantinople and the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 黑海西部水域位于保加利亚海岸与安纳托利亚近海之间。船只从博斯普鲁斯向北航行，经过沿岸港口，抵达多瑙河口及更远的贸易中心。十三世纪起，威尼斯和热那亚商人加入这些水域已有的航运，将河流腹地和西岸与君士坦丁堡及地中海联系起来。

english: On Crimea's southern side, the Crimean Mountains rise above the Black Sea and overlook one of its deepest stretches. The mountains stand close to the shore, producing a steep coast and a narrow shelf rather than the broad northern platform seen elsewhere. Their slopes frame a sea whose central plain plunges toward 2,212 metres. South of Yalta, the basin reaches its deepest point, beyond the visibility of the mountains above. Greek settlement spread around the Black Sea by about 500 BC, and its shorelines became part of a large Mediterranean trade network. Crimea's coast looked across waters that joined the Balkans, Asia Minor, the Caucasus, and the open steppe to the north. Communities and merchants moved along these routes for many centuries, connecting coastal ports with inland regions. The mountains created bottlenecks and sheltered approaches while the sea offered a continuous route. Below the surface, the basin's physical structure affected what survived. Dense, saline water entering from the Mediterranean lies beneath fresher outflow, and the two layers do not mix freely. Oxygen disappears from the deeper water, so organic material and ship hulls decay much more slowly. The Crimean coast therefore faces both a dramatic mountain backdrop and a seabed holding exceptional traces of ancient commerce.
simp_chinese:
在克里米亚南侧，克里米亚山脉耸立于黑海上，俯瞰海域最深处之一。山体贴近海岸，形成陡岸和狭窄陆架，与黑海北部宽阔的平台不同。山坡框住中央深海平原，海水向二千二百一十二米深处下降，盆地最深点位于雅尔塔以南。

 到公元前五百年左右，希腊聚落已散布黑海沿岸，各岸线被纳入地中海的大贸易网络。克里米亚海岸面对的航路连接巴尔干、小亚细亚、高加索和北方草原。许多世纪间，社群与商人沿这些路线往来，把港口同内陆地区相连。山脉限制了通行地带的宽度，也为部分入口提供遮蔽，海面则提供连续航路。

 在水面之下，盆地的水体结构决定什么能够留存。来自地中海的较咸重水位于较淡出流下方，两层水体不易混合；深水缺氧后，有机物与船体腐朽得极慢。克里米亚海岸因此一面背靠高山，一面面向保存古代商业遗迹的海床。

english: Blackburn lies among the hills of Lancashire, where farming and household weaving long shared the labour of local families. Merchants supplied yarn to handloom weavers and collected the finished cloth for dyeing and sale. In the eighteenth century James Hargreaves, a weaver from nearby Stanhill, developed the spinning jenny, enabling one worker to spin several threads at once. New machinery and mills gradually transformed the textile trade around Blackburn.
simp_chinese: 布莱克本坐落在兰开夏丘陵之间，农耕和家庭织造长期共同支撑当地家庭。商人向手织工供应纱线，收集织好的布匹染色出售。十八世纪，附近斯坦希尔的织工詹姆斯·哈格里夫斯发明珍妮纺纱机，使一名工人能够同时纺出多根纱线。新机器和工厂逐渐改变了布莱克本周围的纺织业。

english:
Blackwater lies in the Sahtu Dene country around Great Bear Lake and the Mackenzie River in the Northwest Territories. The region is a northern expanse of lake, forest, and water routes rather than a single town territory. Sahtu communities include Colville Lake, Deline, Fort Good Hope, Norman Wells, and Tulita. Their shared Dene identity is represented by the Sahtu Dene Council, while close relationships among communities do not erase distinct languages and cultural traditions.

The Sahtu groups include Hare Dene in the Colville Lake and Fort Good Hope areas, Bear Lake Dene centered at Deline, and Mountain Dene at Tulita. The people also call themselves Trap People, a name connected to a way of life shaped by seasonal movement. Around Great Bear Lake, families followed fish and game as conditions changed. Hunting, gathering, trapping, and fishing provided food, materials, and knowledge of the land; traditional lodges and tipis used for smoking meat and fish remain part of that inheritance.

Mackenzie's 1789 voyage provided an early written account of Sahtu cultures, but it was only one outside perspective on societies with their own histories. Métis people descended from Dene and fur-trading families live in all five communities. Blackwater therefore belongs to a living political and cultural landscape defined by Dene communities, water travel, seasonal harvesting, and enduring relationships across the Sahtu Region.
simp_chinese:
黑水位于西北地区大熊湖和马更些河周边的萨图德内地域。这一区域由湖泊、森林与水路组成，并不从属于单一市镇。萨图社区包括科尔维尔湖、德利内、好望堡、诺曼韦尔斯和图利塔。萨图德内议会代表共同的德内身份，不过各社群联系紧密，也保留不同的语言与文化传统。

萨图群体包括科尔维尔湖和好望堡一带的野兔德内人、以德利内为中心的熊湖德内人，以及图利塔的山地德内人。他们也称自己为“设陷阱的人”，这一名称联系着随季节迁徙的生活方式。大熊湖周围家庭会依条件追随鱼群和猎物，狩猎、采集、设陷阱与捕鱼带来食物和材料，也积累土地知识；用于熏肉熏鱼的传统屋舍与帐篷仍属于这一传统。马更些1789年的航行曾留下对萨图文化的早期文字描述，但那只代表外来观察者的一种视角。

德内人与毛皮贸易者后裔形成的梅蒂人也居住在五个社区。黑水因此属于由德内社群、水上交通、季节资源利用与跨区联系共同构成的活态地域。

english: The country around Blackwater Lake lies near the Mackenzie River, north of the mouth of the Willowlake. Shallow lakes and tributaries form part of the fishing grounds used by Dene families in the Mackenzie valley. At the Willowlake and Wrigley rivers, seasonal camps have served people fishing the junctions with the great river; Alexander Mackenzie recorded evidence of fishing camps during his journey down the valley in 1789.
simp_chinese: 黑水湖一带靠近马更些河，位于威洛莱克河口以北。浅湖与支流是马更些河谷迪内人家庭渔场的一部分；在威洛莱克河和里格利河与大河交汇的地方，捕鱼的人们曾设立季节性营地。1789年，亚历山大·马更些沿河谷而下时，记下了捕鱼营地的痕迹。

english: Blagodarnoye lies on the Buyvola in the North Caucasian steppe. The village was established in the later eighteenth century, as the Russian authorities encouraged service families and peasants from the interior to settle along the Buyvola, Kuma and Kalaus. An early name, Soldatskoye, recalled its association with soldiers; Kalmyk and Turkmen pastoralists also moved through the surrounding lands. The name Blagodarnoye, meaning “thankful,” became attached to the growing settlement by the river.
simp_chinese: 布拉戈达尔诺耶位于北高加索草原的布伊沃拉河畔。十八世纪后期，俄罗斯当局鼓励服役家庭和内地农民沿布伊沃拉河、库马河与卡劳斯河定居，村庄在此时期建立。早期的索尔达茨科耶之名反映了它与士兵的联系；卡尔梅克和土库曼牧民也在周围土地迁徙。意为「感谢」的布拉戈达尔诺耶后来成为这座不断成长的河畔聚落的名称。

english: Blain lies north of Nantes beside the River Isac, where the great castle of the Rohans guarded their Breton lands. Its towers and courtyards formed the seat of one of the duchy's most powerful noble families. In the sixteenth century the Rohans embraced Protestantism, and Blain became a refuge and a centre of Reformed worship in the country around Nantes. During the Wars of Religion the castle was besieged by troops fighting for the Catholic League and burned in 1591. Its damaged buildings were later restored by the family.
simp_chinese: 布兰位于南特以北的伊萨克河畔，罗昂家族的宏大城堡守卫其布列塔尼领地。塔楼与庭院构成公国最有权势的贵族家族之一的驻所。十六世纪，罗昂家族接受新教，布兰成为南特周边新教徒的避难所和改革宗礼拜中心。宗教战争期间，效忠天主教同盟的军队围攻城堡，1591年将其焚毁。家族后来修复了受损建筑。

english: Bahía Blanca is a broad estuary on the Atlantic coast at the southern edge of the Pampas. Tidal channels wind among its low islands, mudflats and salt marshes. The Olrog's gull nests on islands in the estuary and feeds its chicks with crabs caught on the flats exposed by the falling tide.
simp_chinese: 布兰卡湾是潘帕南缘大西洋海岸的一片宽阔河口。潮汐水道蜿蜒穿过低平岛屿、泥滩与盐沼。奥尔罗格鸥在河口岛屿上筑巢，从退潮露出的滩地捕捉螃蟹，喂养雏鸟。

english: Blanca Lagoon belongs to Patagonia’s chain of inland waters near the southern end of South America. The regional landscape changes sharply from west to east. Along the Andes are lakes, fjords, temperate rainforests and glaciers; farther east, deserts, tablelands and dry steppes spread across the interior. The lagoon therefore belongs to a broader belt in which mountain drainage, glacial erosion and enclosed basins create scattered water bodies across otherwise severe terrain. Westerly winds drive moisture against the Andean slopes, leaving the Pacific side wet and the eastern plains progressively dry. That rain shadow explains the contrast between dense forest and open steppe, and it also affects how lakes are fed and how quickly exposed shorelines change. In the south, the Strait of Magellan, Beagle Channel and Drake Passage link the two oceans, but the interior lakes form separate refuges and route marks rather than one continuous waterway. Before Spanish arrival, most peoples of Patagonia lived as hunter-gatherers. Groups crossed the eastern plains on foot and used dugout canoes and dalcas through the fjords and channels of the west. Settlement was accordingly mobile and closely tied to grazing land, water and seasonal products. Blanca Lagoon is best understood within this patterned mobility: the water and sheltered ground could attract travellers, while the surrounding steppe, wind and distance between basins framed their routes.
simp_chinese:
布兰卡潟湖属于南美洲南端巴塔哥尼亚的一组内陆水域。这里的自然景观从西向东变化很大：安第斯山区分布着湖泊、峡湾、温带雨林和冰川，更远的东部则展开沙漠、台地与干燥草原。潟湖位于这样一个地带，周围的山地水系、冰川侵蚀和封闭盆地共同在严酷地形中形成了零散水面。

 西风把水汽推向安第斯西坡，使太平洋一侧长期湿润，而越过山岭的东侧平原逐渐干燥。雨影效应既造成森林与草原的分界，也影响湖泊的水量记载和裸露岸线的变化。南部的麦哲伦海峡、比格尔海峡和德雷克海峡沟通两大洋，但内陆湖泊并不是连续航路，而是水系之间相对独立的水源和行进节点。

 西班牙人到来的很久以前，巴塔哥尼亚多数族群以狩猎采集为生。他们徒步穿越东部平原，也在西部的峡湾和岛间水道中使用独木舟。迁徙生活依赖草场、水源和季节资源，聚落因而并不固定。布兰卡潟湖所在的环境正适合放在这一移动网络中理解：水面与避风地可能吸引来往人群，草原、强风和盆地之间的距离则限定着他们的路线。

english: Lake Blanche lies among the dry lake beds of the Lake Eyre basin in arid South Australia. Its waters are intermittent: rain and floods from distant catchments can reach the basin, while long dry periods leave expanses of salt and mud. The surrounding country has long been part of Aboriginal life in the inland waterways.
simp_chinese: 布兰奇湖位于南澳大利亚干旱地区的艾尔湖流域，是一片时有时无的湖水与干涸湖床。远方集水区的降雨和洪水有时流入盆地，漫长旱季则留下大片盐地和泥地。周围土地长久以来是原住民内陆水道生活的一部分。

english: Cabo Blanco marks the southern tip of the Nicoya Peninsula, where the peninsula meets the Pacific near the entrance to the Gulf of Nicoya. Rocky shores and forested hills face the open sea, while the gulf reaches inland behind the headland. The meeting of exposed ocean coast and more sheltered gulf waters gives this promontory a distinctive place on the Pacific shore of Costa Rica.
simp_chinese: 布兰科角位于尼科亚半岛南端，半岛在尼科亚湾入口附近与太平洋相接。岩石海岸和林木覆盖的山丘面向大洋，海湾则从岬角后方向内陆延伸。无遮蔽的大洋海岸与较为避风的海湾水域在此相遇，使这一岬角成为哥斯达黎加太平洋海岸的独特地标。

english: Cabo Blanco projects into the Atlantic near the southern end of the Gulf of San Jorge, on the coast of Patagonia. Its rocky headlands and nearby islands provide resting and breeding places for sea lions and fur seals. The cape stands where the open sea meets the dry Patagonian plateau, a conspicuous landmark along a coast of bays and tidal shores.
simp_chinese: 布兰科角伸入大西洋，位于巴塔哥尼亚圣豪尔赫湾南端附近。岩石岬角和近海岛屿为海狮和毛海狮提供休息与繁殖场所。海角立于开阔海洋与干燥巴塔哥尼亚高原的交界处，是遍布海湾和潮间海岸的沿岸醒目地标。

english: Lake Blanco lies in the interior of Tierra del Fuego, among forests and low mountains south of the northern steppe. It receives the Cochrane River from neighbouring Lake Chico and belongs to the island’s network of lakes and rivers. The surrounding country formed part of the territory of the Selk’nam, whose communities travelled across the island’s forests and open plains. Cold winds and seasonal snow shape the landscape.
simp_chinese: 布兰科湖位于火地岛内陆，处在北方草原以南的森林与低山之间。它接纳来自邻近奇科湖的科克伦河，属于岛上的湖泊河流网络。周围地区曾是塞尔克南人的土地，其社群穿行于岛上森林和开阔平原。寒风与季节积雪塑造着这里的景观。

english: In the mountain country later called Bland, Big Walker Mountain and Brushy Mountain rise on either side of a long valley. Indigenous people built a village near Wolf Creek some five centuries ago, leaving traces of houses and palisades in the valley floor. In the middle of the eighteenth century settlers of Scots-Irish and English descent established communities in the district. The valleys offered ground for their farms, enclosed by the long wooded ridges of southwestern Virginia.
simp_chinese: 在后来称为布兰德的山地，大沃克山和布拉希山分列狭长河谷两侧。约五百年前，原住民在沃尔夫溪附近建立过一座村落，谷底留下了房屋和栅栏的痕迹。十八世纪中叶，苏格兰—爱尔兰及英格兰移民开始在这一地区建立社群。他们在河谷中开辟农地，四周环绕着弗吉尼亚西南部长长的林木山脊。

english:
Blankenburg sits on the northern edge of the Harz, a rugged highland that rises above the North German plain. The range extends for about 110 kilometres across parts of the Brunswick, Saxon and Thuringian lands, reaching its highest point at the Brocken. Its western portion is generally higher and carries fir forest; eastward, the Lower Harz descends into plateaus where meadows and arable ground make agriculture more practical. Blankenburg’s position places it between those wooded heights and the settled country below. The mountains acquired wealth from mining. Silver deposits were discovered near Goslar in 968, and mines spread through the Harz in the following centuries. Ore moved along medieval trade routes reaching as far as Mesopotamia, while dense forest long made many valleys difficult to cross. Settlements expanded where land was cleared, and the suffix “rode” marks places created by woodland clearing. By the early nineteenth century many mines were exhausted, towns lost population.

Blankenburg itself is first recorded in 1123, when Duke Lothair of Supplinburg installed Poppo as count in the castle on the limestone rock above the town. The counts of Blankenburg and Regenstein held the district as a fief of the bishopric of Halberstadt. In 1599 the county passed to the dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg, and in 1707 it was raised to an imperial principality under Duke Louis Rudolf, who built the Little Castle with its terraced garden. Blankenburg belonged to the Kingdom of Westphalia from 1807 to 1813 and then to the Duchy of Brunswick, and a fire in 1836 destroyed much of the town.
simp_chinese:
布兰肯堡位于哈茨山地北缘。哈茨是一处耸立于北德平原之上的崎岖高地，东西绵延约一百一十公里，横跨不伦瑞克、萨克森和图林根的部分地区，最高峰是布罗肯峰。山地西部较高，多见冷杉林；向东逐渐降至下哈茨，台地上的草地和耕地使农业更易开展。布兰肯堡正处在林地高处与其下定居地带之间。矿产曾为山区带来财富。968年，戈斯拉尔附近发现银矿，此后采矿活动在哈茨各地扩展。中世纪矿石沿贸易路线远销，甚至到达美索不达米亚；茂密森林则长期使许多谷地难以通行。聚落随着林地开垦向外扩展，地名中的“罗德”往往表示由清伐林地形成的地点。到十九世纪初，许多矿脉已经枯竭，城镇一度流失人口。

布兰肯堡首见于1123年，当年萨克森公爵洛塔尔·冯·苏普林堡任命波波为伯爵，驻在城镇上方石灰岩崖顶的城堡。布兰肯堡伯爵与雷根施泰因伯爵作为哈尔伯施塔特主教区的封臣统治这一地区。1599年伯国归不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵，1707年在路易·鲁道夫公爵治下升为帝国侯国，他修建了带梯形花园的小城堡。1807年至1813年布兰肯堡属威斯特法伦王国，此后归不伦瑞克公国；1836年的一场大火毁掉了城镇的大部分。

english: The waters around La Blanquilla lie in the south-eastern Caribbean, north of the Venezuelan coast. The island takes its Spanish name from its pale beaches, which stand out against low, dry scrub. Coral reefs around the island supplied material for craft and jewellery, and fishing boats worked the shallow shelves. Winds and currents shaped navigation on the route between the Venezuelan coast and the islands to the north, and the rocky reef edges made local knowledge essential for safe passage.
simp_chinese: 布兰基亚岛周围的海域位于加勒比海东南部，委内瑞拉海岸以北。岛屿因白色沙滩而得西班牙语名称，白沙与低矮干燥的灌丛形成鲜明对比。岛周的珊瑚礁为手工艺品与首饰提供材料，渔船在浅滩上作业。风与洋流决定了委内瑞拉海岸与北方诸岛之间航线的走向，礁石边缘也使熟悉当地水况成为安全通行的前提。

english:
Bled lies on the southern edge of the Karawanks in Upper Carniola, where a small glacial lake meets wooded Alpine plateaus. The island church drew pilgrims, while a rock-top castle commanded the old core; the lake’s southern shore opens toward the Sava Bohinjka and the Julian Alps. Springs and a broken shoreline made the basin suit settlement and travel between the Ljubljana basin and mountain passes.

The place first appears as Ueldes in 1004, when King Henry II granted it to the Bishop of Brixen; a wider estate was added in 1011. For eight centuries absentee prince-bishops governed the distant lordship through ministeriales, castellans, lessees and later governors. The castle watched over scattered farms, woodland, lake fisheries and the routes leading toward the Alpine passes. In the sixteenth century Bled Castle briefly became a Protestant stronghold. The estate passed to lay ownership after secularisation in 1803, then lay within Napoleon’s Illyrian Provinces from 1808 before returning to Austria in 1813. Bled’s identity before the nineteenth century rested less on a single town street than on the castle, church, farms and routes that joined the lake to the surrounding Alps.
simp_chinese:
布莱德位于上卡尼奥拉卡拉万克山南麓，冰川湖与森林覆盖的阿尔卑斯台地在此相接。湖中小岛上的教堂吸引朝圣者，岩丘城堡控制旧地核心，南岸则通向萨瓦·博希尼卡河与朱利安阿尔卑斯山。泉水、低丘和多段湖岸便利定居，也使这里成为卢布尔雅那盆地与山隘之间的通道。

1004年，德意志国王亨利二世把这里授予布里克森主教，文献首次写作“乌埃尔德斯”；1011年又追加一片更广的领地。此后八个世纪，不常驻本地的亲王主教通过家臣、城主、承租者和后来的总督管理这处遥远的领地。城堡监督分散的农庄、林地、湖上渔业和通往阿尔卑斯山口的道路。十六世纪，布莱德城堡一度成为新教徒据点。1803年主教领世俗化后，庄园转入世俗所有；1808年并入拿破仑的伊利里亚省，1813年又归奥地利。十九世纪以前，布莱德的面貌与其说靠一条成形的城镇街道，不如说靠城堡、教堂、农庄和连接湖区与周围阿尔卑斯山的道路。

english:
Bledsoe lies in the northern Sequatchie Valley, a long trough cut through the Cumberland Plateau. The valley was part of Cherokee country until the Treaty of Tellico in 1805, after which American settlers expanded into the area. Some acquired land in return for service during the Revolutionary War, establishing farms between the surrounding ridges.

In 1816 Charles Love sold land beside Sequatchie Creek for a new town, Pikeville, to replace Madison as the local seat of government. Situated on the stage route between Knoxville and Huntsville, Pikeville grew into a place where farmers obtained supplies and traded. By the 1830s it had a courthouse, a hotel and a local academy. The valley provided a natural passage through the plateau, carrying travellers as well as the waters of the Sequatchie southward.
simp_chinese:
布莱德索位于塞夸奇谷地北部，这条狭长谷地切穿坎伯兰高原。这里曾属于切罗基地区，1805年《特利科条约》后，美国移民向这一带扩展。一些人以独立战争中的服役换取土地，在两侧山脊之间建立农场。

1816年，查尔斯·洛夫出售塞夸奇溪畔的土地，供建立新镇派克维尔，以取代麦迪逊成为地方行政中心。派克维尔位于诺克斯维尔至亨茨维尔的驿车路线之上，逐渐成为农民购买补给和交换货物的地方。到十九世纪三十年代，镇上已有法院、旅馆和学校。谷地为穿越高原提供天然通道，旅行者与塞夸奇河水都沿此向南而行。

english: Blekinge Kust faces the Baltic Sea, the largest brackish-water basin in the world. The Baltic is an Atlantic marginal sea enclosed by Scandinavia and the North European Plain. Its only natural outlet runs through the Danish straits toward the Kattegat, and that narrow exchange keeps the basin much less salty than the open ocean. Along the Blekinge coast, fresh river discharge, shallow shelf water and cold winters combine into an environment different from the North Sea beyond Denmark. The basin’s form comes from glaciation as well as tectonics. Several Pleistocene ice sheets eroded an older river landscape into the later sea floor. Land still rises after the weight of the ice was removed, gradually changing shorelines and reducing parts of the basin. The water also preserves populations of arctic species left behind after the ice retreated. This combination of rising land, limited salt exchange and seasonal cold gives Baltic ecology its distinctive character. The sea has long been an economic thoroughfare. Its shores hold a large share of northern Europe’s population, and the coast is especially densely settled. In the early later period, fleets from the Netherlands and England depended on Baltic timber, tar, flax and hemp. Russia and Prussia became the leading powers in the eighteenth century, and Peter the Great founded Saint Petersburg at the Gulf of Finland’s eastern end. Blekinge’s coastal waters share in that maritime story, where sheltered routes joined local livelihoods to a sea governed by narrow straits.
simp_chinese:
布莱金厄海岸面临波罗的海。波罗的海是世界上最大的半咸水海域，被斯堪的纳维亚半岛和北欧平原围住，只有穿过丹麦海峡通向卡特加特的狭窄出口，因而与大西洋的海水交换有限，盐度远低于外海。在布莱金厄沿岸，河水注入、浅水陆架和寒冷冬季共同形成特殊环境，与丹麦以外的北海海况明显不同。

 这片海盆的形状同时来自冰川作用与地壳运动。更新世多次冰盖侵蚀了更古老的河谷，塑造出当时之后的海底。冰层消退后，陆地仍在缓慢抬升，海岸线因此持续变化，部分水域也逐年缩小。海水还保留着冰期退却后遗留的北极物种。陆地上升、盐分交换受限与季节性寒冷共同造就了波罗的海独特的生态。

 这里长期也是北欧的经济通道。沿海地区聚集了大量人口，许多城市紧贴岸线发展。近代早期，荷兰与英国的船队依赖波罗的海的木材、焦油、亚麻和大麻；十八世纪，俄国与普鲁士成为海上的主要力量，彼得大帝还在芬兰湾最东端建立圣彼得堡。布莱金厄海域也属于这一海运传统：受海峡约束的航路把沿岸生计同连接整个北欧的市场和权力网络联系了起来。

english: Block Island Sound separates Block Island from the mainland coast of Rhode Island. Westward, its waters reach the eastern end of Long Island and the approaches to Long Island Sound; to the east they open into Rhode Island Sound. The island was known to its Indigenous inhabitants as Manisses. Dutch navigator Adriaen Block sailed these waters in the early seventeenth century, leaving his name on the island and the channel beside it.
simp_chinese: 布洛克岛海峡将布洛克岛与罗得岛大陆海岸隔开。向西，水域延伸至长岛东端和长岛海峡入口；向东则通往罗得岛海峡。岛上的原住民称其为马尼塞斯。十七世纪初，荷兰航海者阿德里安·布洛克航行于此，他的名字后来留在岛屿与旁边的海峡上。

english:
Blois rises above the right bank of the Loire, beneath the château that was first the seat of its counts and then a royal residence. The county, held by the Thibaldian house for centuries, passed in 1397 when Guy of Châtillon offered it to Louis of Orléans, and in 1498 it joined the crown when Louis II of Orléans became Louis XII. He had been born in the château, and the wing he built in brick and stone started the series of royal buildings that ended with François Mansart's wing for Gaston of Orléans in the 1630s.

In April 1429 Joan of Arc made Blois her base for the relief of Orléans, setting out on the 29th. During the Wars of Religion the town was looted by Catholics in July 1562 and by Protestants in February 1568. In 1588 Henry III called the Estates General to Blois; on 23 December royal guards murdered Henry, Duke of Guise, in the château, and his brother the cardinal was killed the next day. Catherine de' Medici died there in January 1589. Marie de' Medici lived there in exile from 1617 to 1619, and Gaston of Orléans, banished by Louis XIII, stayed until his death in 1660. Blois became a bishopric in 1697, and the Jacques-Gabriel bridge was opened in 1724 after the medieval bridge collapsed in February 1716.
simp_chinese:
布卢瓦位于卢瓦尔河右岸，城堡先是伯爵的治所，后来成为王室住所。布卢瓦伯爵领由蒂博家族掌握了数世纪，1397年，沙蒂永的居伊把它让给奥尔良的路易；1498年，奥尔良的路易二世成为路易十二，伯爵领并入王室。路易十二生于这座城堡，他建造的砖石侧翼开启了一系列王室建筑，直到十七世纪三十年代弗朗索瓦·芒萨尔为奥尔良的加斯东所建的侧翼才告结束。

1429年4月，圣女贞德以布卢瓦为解救奥尔良的基地，并于29日出发。宗教战争期间，城镇1562年7月被天主教徒洗劫，1568年2月又被新教徒洗劫。1588年亨利三世在布卢瓦召开三级会议；12月23日，王室卫士在城堡内杀死吉斯公爵亨利，次日他的兄弟枢机主教也被杀。凯瑟琳·德·美第奇于1589年1月死于此地。玛丽·德·美第奇于1617至1619年流放期间住在这里，被路易十三放逐的奥尔良的加斯东则一直住到1660年去世。布卢瓦于1697年成为主教区，中世纪桥梁在1716年2月倒塌后，雅克-加布里埃尔桥于1724年通车。

english: Blönduós takes its name from the mouth of the Blanda, a glacial river flowing into the sea on Iceland's northern coast. The river divides around the small island of Hrútey before reaching its estuary. Its waters descend from the high interior toward the broad bay of Húnaflói, crossing country where farms were established long before a village arose at the river mouth. The river and the coast provide the defining features of this part of northern Iceland.
simp_chinese: 布伦迪欧斯得名于布兰达河口，这条冰川河流在冰岛北岸汇入大海。河流在入海之前绕过小岛赫鲁泰，分成两道。河水从内陆高地流向宽阔的胡纳湾，经过的土地上早有农场，比河口村落的兴起早得多。河流与海岸共同塑造了冰岛北部这一地区的面貌。

english: Bloobarra Point belongs to the West African shore historically called the Pepper Coast, or Grain Coast. The wider name described the coast between Cape Mesurado and Cape Palmas, enclosing the area of present-day Liberia. Its use by European traders linked a long stretch of shoreline to one especially valuable plant. The narrower “Grain Coast” designation ran from the Saint John River, at later Buchanan, to Harper, while some maps applied the name more broadly to Sierra Leone and Ivory Coast. The name came from melegueta pepper, also known as grains of paradise. Aframomum melegueta grew in the region and became a traded spice, so its availability gave Europeans a convenient label for the coast. That label compressed varied societies, river mouths and landing places into a commercial category. For sailors, the pepper was not merely a curiosity: it gave the coast a recognisable product and helped place it within Atlantic trading routes alongside other named shores of West Africa, such as the Gold and Slave Coasts. A point on this coast therefore sits between local maritime access and a wider history of commodity naming. Canoes and small vessels would have used the shoreline in ways shaped by surf, river outlets and settlements, while overseas merchants approached it through the pepper trade. The Grain Coast name survives as traces of that encounter between African plant geography and European commercial geography.
simp_chinese:
布卢巴拉角属于西非历史上称为胡椒海岸或谷物海岸的沿岸地带。较宽的称谓指梅苏拉多角与帕尔马斯角之间的海岸，覆盖当时之后的利比里亚。欧洲商人在使用这个名称时，把一段漫长岸线与一种价值很高的植物联系起来。范围较窄的“谷物海岸”从圣约翰河、即当时之后的布坎南附近延伸到哈珀，有些地图则把名称扩大到塞拉利昂和科特迪瓦。

 名称来自梅莱盖塔胡椒，也被称为天堂椒。非洲豆蔻生长在这一地区，并进入贸易网络，因此它的分布成为欧洲人命名海岸的直接依据。这个标签把多样的社会、河口和登陆点压缩成一个商品名称。对海员而言，胡椒不只是新奇物，它赋予海岸可辨认的物产，也使这里同黄金海岸、奴隶海岸等西非地名一样进入大西洋贸易的地理体系。

 海岸上的这个岬角同时连接地方的近海通行和更大范围的商品命名史。独木舟与小船会根据浪况、河口和聚落位置利用岸线，远来的商人则通过胡椒贸易认识这里。“谷物海岸”这一名称由此保留了非洲植物分布与欧洲商业地理相遇的痕迹。

english: Bloody Foreland is a headland on the exposed northwestern coast of Donegal, facing the Atlantic near Tory Island. Its name is associated with the reddish light that can fall on the rocks at sunset. The coast's islands and reefs mark dangerous waters for ships approaching from the west. In October 1798 a French squadron sent toward Ireland was intercepted by a British force off this coast. The ensuing Battle of Tory Island ended in defeat for the French, closing another attempt to bring military aid to the Irish rising.
simp_chinese: 血色岬位于多尼戈尔西北部无遮蔽的海岸，面向大西洋，靠近托里岛。岬角的名字与夕阳落在岩石上的红色光芒有关。沿岸岛屿与礁石标示着从西方驶近船只的危险水域。1798年10月，一支驶向爱尔兰的法国分舰队在这段海岸外被英军截击。随后的托里岛海战以法国失败告终，另一次向爱尔兰起义运送军事援助的尝试就此结束。

english: Blossom Bay lies on the rugged coast of Isla de los Estados, east of Tierra del Fuego.
